Color.zh: 选择主色、成功、警告等用途的颜色。未指定时采用主题或组件默认颜色。
Color.en: Choose a color role such as primary, success or warning. An unspecified value uses the theme or component default.

Size.zh: 选择 XS、SM、MD、LG 或 XL。未指定时按所在字段、主题或组件的规则取默认尺寸。
Size.en: Choose XS, SM, MD, LG or XL. An unspecified size follows the field, theme or component’s default rules.

Variant.zh: 选择边框、背景等外观样式。可选值因组件而异。
Variant.en: Choose an appearance such as a border or filled background. Supported variants depend on the component.

Label.zh: 控件的显示标签或供辅助技术读取的名称，具体用途见组件说明。
Label.en: The visible label or the name read by assistive technology, depending on the component.

AccessibleLabel.zh: 供辅助技术读取的名称。纯图标按钮需要用它说明操作用途。
AccessibleLabel.en: The name read by assistive technology. Use it to describe an icon-only button’s action.

Name.zh: 表单字段或对象的名称。
Name.en: Name of the form field or object.

Disabled.en: Disable the component and its interactions.

ReadOnly.zh: 允许查看、选择和复制内容，禁止用户修改。
ReadOnly.en: Allow viewing, selection and copying while preventing edits.

Loading.zh: 显示加载状态；是否阻止操作由组件决定。
Loading.en: Show loading state; whether it blocks actions depends on the component.

Invalid.zh: 将输入标为无效，并显示对应的错误外观。
Invalid.en: Mark the input as invalid and apply its error appearance.

ErrorMessage.zh: 提供控件的错误说明；需要在字段下方显示文字时，设置 FormField.Error。
ErrorMessage.en: Describe the control’s error. Use FormField.Error to display an error below a field.

Placeholder.zh: 没有输入或选择时的占位文字。
Placeholder.en: Placeholder shown when there is no input or selection.

Leading.zh: 内容前方的 SVG 图标。

Trailing.zh: 内容后方的 SVG 图标。

Icon.zh: 组件使用的 SVG 图标。
Icon.en: SVG icon used by the component.

ButtonOptions.Avatar.zh: 前导头像；显式 Leading 或前导加载图标优先。头像未设置 Size 时随按钮尺寸使用 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP，显式 Avatar.Size 保持独立尺寸。
ButtonOptions.Avatar.en: Leading avatar, replaced by an explicit Leading icon or leading loader. Unset avatar Size follows the button at 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP; explicit Avatar.Size keeps its own size.

BadgeOptions.Avatar.zh: 前导头像，显式 Leading 图标优先；Avatar.Size 未设置时按标签 XS–XL 使用 16 / 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 DIP，显式头像尺寸优先。
BadgeOptions.Avatar.en: Leading avatar, replaced by an explicit Leading icon. Unset Avatar.Size follows badge XS–XL at 16 / 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 DIP; explicit avatar size takes precedence.

BadgeOptions.Square.zh: 让四边内边距相同；默认 false，文字为空时自动启用。实例 Root.PaddingX / PaddingY 仍可覆盖。
BadgeOptions.Square.en: Use equal padding on every side. Defaults to false and is enabled automatically for an empty label. Instance Root.PaddingX / PaddingY can still override it.

ButtonOptions.Animate.zh: 控制加载图标旋转；未设置时遵循主题与系统的减少动态效果偏好。false 停止旋转，true 不能覆盖减少动态效果。背景颜色过渡由 Theme.Motion.Transition 控制。
ButtonOptions.Animate.en: Control loader rotation. Unset follows theme and system reduced-motion preferences; false stops rotation and true cannot override reduced motion. Theme.Motion.Transition controls background transitions.

ButtonOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置 root、label、leading、trailing；没有构建的部件为零值 Element。加载图标颜色使用对应 UI 部件的 Foreground，Style.TextColor 不改变自定义绘制颜色。不要保存 Element。
ButtonOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configure root, label, leading and trailing; absent parts are zero Elements. Set loader colors with the corresponding UI part Foreground; Style.TextColor does not change custom drawing colors. Do not retain Elements.

LoadingTrailing.zh: 把加载图标放在内容后方；如果设置了 Leading，优先在前方显示。
LoadingTrailing.en: Place the loading indicator after the content; an explicit Leading icon takes precedence.

EmptyIcon.zh: 评分中尚未选中的星标或其他图标。
EmptyIcon.en: The icon for an unfilled rating item.

Active.zh: 控制激活状态或动态效果是否运行。
Active.en: Control the active state or whether motion is running.

ActiveColor.zh: 组件处于活动状态时使用的颜色。
ActiveColor.en: The color used while the component is active.

ActiveVariant.zh: 组件处于活动状态时使用的外观样式。
ActiveVariant.en: The variant used while the component is active.

Block.en: Make the button fill the available width.

Square.zh: 使用方形按钮或标签的内边距，适合仅显示图标。
Square.en: Use padding suited to a square button or badge, such as an icon-only control.

Neutral.zh: 旧版中性色开关；优先使用 Color: nui.Neutral。
Neutral.en: Legacy neutral-color switch; prefer Color: nui.Neutral.

UI.zh: 按部件名设置文字、图标、面板等区域的样式；只对组件公开的部件生效。
UI.en: Set styles by part name, such as label, icon or panel. Only parts exposed by the component are supported.

Style.zh: 在本次界面构建中直接配置部件元素。回调收到的 Element 不能保存到下次使用。
Style.en: Configure part elements during the current build. Do not retain the supplied Elements for later use.

Animate.zh: 控制动画，并遵守系统的减少动态效果偏好。
Animate.en: Control animation while respecting reduced-motion preferences.

Padding.zh: 容器内边距，单位为 DIP。

ContainerOptions.Padding.zh: 水平内边距，单位为 DIP。未设置时按窗口宽度取 16 / 24 / 32，再乘主题 Density；断点为 640 和 1024 DIP。显式 0 去掉内边距，实例 UI 和 Style 可继续覆盖。
ContainerOptions.Padding.en: Horizontal padding in DIP. Unset uses 16 / 24 / 32 times theme Density at window breakpoints 640 and 1024 DIP. Explicit zero removes padding; instance UI and Style can override it.

ContainerOptions.MaxWidth.zh: 最大宽度，单位为 DIP。未设置时使用 Theme.ContainerWidth，内置主题为 1280；仍受父级可用宽度约束。
ContainerOptions.MaxWidth.en: Maximum width in DIP. Unset uses Theme.ContainerWidth, 1280 in the built-in themes, constrained by the available parent width.

LinkOptions.Color.zh: 激活文字和焦点圈的语义颜色，默认 Primary；未激活时使用 Muted，悬停时使用 Text。
LinkOptions.Color.en: Semantic color for active text and the focus ring, defaulting to Primary. Inactive text uses Muted and hovered text uses Text.

PaddingX.zh: 水平内边距，单位为 DIP。

PaddingY.zh: 垂直内边距，单位为 DIP。

Opacity.zh: 不透明度，通常为 0 到 1。

Shadow.zh: 阴影颜色、模糊和偏移配置。
Shadow.en: Shadow color, blur and offset configuration.

Orientation.zh: 水平或垂直方向；未设置时使用组件默认方向。
Orientation.en: Horizontal or vertical direction; unset uses the component default.

Min.zh: 允许的最小值。Optional 字段可用 nui.Set(0) 明确设置为 0。
Min.en: The minimum allowed value. Use nui.Set(0) to explicitly set zero on an Optional field.

Max.zh: 上界或数量上限，具体含义依组件而定。
Max.en: Upper bound or count limit, depending on the component.

Value.zh: 控件值、字段值或数据读取函数。
Value.en: Control value, field value or data accessor.

Set.zh: 表示 Optional 是否已明确赋值；false 时按未设置处理。
Set.en: Whether the Optional has an explicit value; false means unset.

Clearable.zh: 显示清空操作或允许清除当前值。
Clearable.en: Show a clear action or allow clearing the value.

ClearLabel.zh: 清空操作的可访问名称。
ClearLabel.en: Accessible name for the clear action.

MaxLength.zh: 限制可输入的长度，0 表示不限。原生文本按 UTF-16 单元计数，部分字符占两个单元。
MaxLength.en: Limit input length; 0 means unlimited. Native text counts UTF-16 units, so some characters count as two.

Rows.zh: 输入框显示的基础行数。
Rows.en: The base number of visible text rows.

MaxRows.zh: 自动增高时最多显示的行数；超过后在输入框内滚动。
MaxRows.en: The maximum visible rows when automatically growing; additional content scrolls inside the field.

AutoResize.zh: 随内容自动调整文本域高度。
AutoResize.en: Resize the text area as its content changes.

Required.zh: 显示必填标记，并为支持的控件补充必填说明；实际校验由 Form 或应用完成。
Required.en: Show a required marker and description on supported controls. Form or the application performs validation.

EmptyText.zh: 没有可显示数据时的文案。
EmptyText.en: Text shown when no data is available.

Highlight.zh: 突出显示控件或选中项目。
Highlight.en: Emphasize the control or selected item.

HighlightOnHover.en: Highlight a list item on hover.

Hoverable.zh: 悬停时显示临时评分预览。
Hoverable.en: Show a provisional rating on hover.

Inverted.en: Reverse the value or visual direction.

Indicator.zh: 选择指示器的位置或隐藏策略。
Indicator.en: Placement or visibility of the selection indicator.

SelectionBehavior.zh: SelectionToggle 再次激活可取消选择；SelectionReplace 激活时替换选择。
SelectionBehavior.en: SelectionToggle can deselect on repeated activation. SelectionReplace replaces the selection on activation.

Loop.zh: 键盘导航越过末项后回到首项，反向同理。
Loop.en: Wrap keyboard navigation from the last item to the first and vice versa.

ItemWidth.en: Width of an item in a horizontal list.

SearchInput.zh: 是否显示搜索框；未设置时使用组件默认策略。
SearchInput.en: Whether to show a search input; unset uses the component default.

SearchPlaceholder.zh: 搜索输入框的占位文字。

ExternalFilter.zh: 直接显示应用传入的筛选结果，不再执行组件的本地搜索。
ExternalFilter.en: Display results filtered by the application without applying the component’s local search.

FilterFields.zh: 搜索时匹配的项目字段。
FilterFields.en: Item fields included in search matching.

AllowCustom.zh: 允许提交候选列表之外的文字，应用通过提交回调处理。
AllowCustom.en: Allow text outside the suggestion list to be submitted and handled by the application.

CreateWhenAlways.zh: 存在匹配结果时也可显示创建项；相同值等具体限制见对应组件。
CreateWhenAlways.en: Allow a create item even when results match; exact-value restrictions depend on the component.

CreateAtTop.zh: 将创建操作放在候选列表顶部。
CreateAtTop.en: Place the creation action at the top of the list.

ResetSearchTermOnBlur.zh: 面板关闭或输入失焦时，按该组件的规则重置搜索词。
ResetSearchTermOnBlur.en: Reset the query on dismissal or blur, according to the component’s behavior.

ResetSearchTermOnSelect.zh: 选中项目后重置搜索词。

OpenOnClick.zh: 点击输入框时打开候选列表。
OpenOnClick.en: Open suggestions when the input is clicked.

OpenOnFocus.zh: 输入框获得焦点时打开候选列表。
OpenOnFocus.en: Open suggestions when the input gains focus.

Popup.zh: 配置候选列表弹层的位置、尺寸和样式。
Popup.en: Configure the suggestion popup’s position, dimensions and styles.

Placement.zh: 弹层相对触发控件的位置。
Placement.en: Popup placement relative to its trigger.

Offset.zh: 弹层与触发控件的距离。
Offset.en: Distance between the popup and trigger.

MatchAnchor.zh: 让弹层宽度匹配触发控件。
MatchAnchor.en: Match the popup width to the trigger.

PopoverOptions.Label.zh: 弹层的无障碍名称，不改变按钮文字或面板内容。
PopoverOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the popup; it does not change trigger text or panel content.

PopoverOptions.Placement.zh: 弹层相对触发控件的位置；空间不足时会自动翻转或避让。
PopoverOptions.Placement.en: Placement relative to the trigger; automatically flips or shifts when space is limited.

PopoverOptions.MaxHeight.zh: 面板高度上限，单位 DIP。内容超出时需自行添加滚动区域。
PopoverOptions.MaxHeight.en: The panel height limit in DIP. Add a scrolling area when content exceeds it.

PopoverOptions.MatchAnchor.zh: 默认 false；true 将锚点宽度设为最小宽度，不强制两者相等。
PopoverOptions.MatchAnchor.en: Default false. True uses the anchor width as a minimum, not a fixed width.

PopoverOptions.OpenDelay.zh: 仅 PopoverHover 模式生效；网站输入单位为毫秒（1000 ms = 1 秒），Go 使用 time.Duration。
PopoverOptions.OpenDelay.en: Applies only in PopoverHover mode. The editor uses milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second); Go uses time.Duration.

PopoverOptions.CloseDelay.zh: 仅 PopoverHover 模式下离开触发控件与面板后生效；网站输入单位为毫秒。
PopoverOptions.CloseDelay.en: Delay after leaving both the trigger and panel in PopoverHover mode, in milliseconds in the editor.

PopoverOptions.UI.zh: 仅 Panel 部件生效；背景、字体、颜色、行距和 Gap 直接作用于面板及继承样式的普通内容。
PopoverOptions.UI.en: Only Panel applies. Surface, typography, color, line height and Gap style the panel and inheriting plain content.

PopoverOptions.Style.zh: 最后同步配置 Panel。不要保存构建期元素；原生子控件仍使用局部主题。
PopoverOptions.Style.en: Final synchronous Panel customization. Do not retain the build-time element; native children keep the local theme.

Dismissible.zh: 允许 Escape 或外部点击关闭。
Dismissible.en: Allow Escape or an outside click to dismiss.

CloseLabel.zh: 关闭操作的可访问名称。
CloseLabel.en: Accessible name of the close action.

Overlay.zh: 控制遮罩或边缘渐隐层。
Overlay.en: Control the backdrop or edge-fade overlay.

Fullscreen.en: Make the overlay fill the window.

ReturnFocus.zh: 关闭后将键盘焦点还给这个 Handle 绑定的控件；Handle 需要长期保存。
ReturnFocus.en: Return keyboard focus to the control bound to this persistent Handle after closing.

Header.zh: 在当前构建中创建标题区内容。
Header.en: Build the header content during the current UI build.

Footer.zh: 在当前构建中创建底部内容。
Footer.en: Build the footer content during the current UI build.

Content.zh: 在当前构建中创建正文内容。
Content.en: Build the body content during the current UI build.

Actions.zh: 附加操作或操作区域构建函数。
Actions.en: Additional actions or an action-region builder.

Side.zh: 展开面板所在的窗口边缘。
Side.en: Window edge from which the panel opens.

Extent.zh: 侧边面板的宽度或高度。
Extent.en: Width or height of the side panel.

Kbds.zh: 在提示中显示的快捷键。
Kbds.en: Keyboard shortcuts displayed in the tooltip.

Timeout.zh: 通知显示时长；单位为 Go time.Duration。
Timeout.en: Notification duration as a Go time.Duration.

Close.zh: 操作是否关闭通知，或是否显示关闭控件。
Close.en: Whether an action closes the toast or a close control is shown.

Position.zh: 指示器或通知的显示位置。
Position.en: Display position of the indicator or notification.

Limit.zh: 结果数量或同时显示的项目上限。
Limit.en: Maximum result count or simultaneous items.

KeepMounted.zh: 隐藏时仍构建内容，保留控件的局部状态；内容回调仍会执行。
KeepMounted.en: Keep building hidden content to retain local control state. Content callbacks still run.

Collapsible.zh: 允许再次激活已展开项将其收起；侧栏等组件的具体行为见专用说明。
Collapsible.en: Allow an open section to close when activated again. See component-specific notes for controls such as Sidebar.

Underline.zh: 使用下划线形式标示当前标签页。
Underline.en: Use an underline to mark the selected tab.

ActivationMode.zh: Automatic 用方向键移动时切换内容；Manual 只移动焦点，Enter 或 Space 才切换。
ActivationMode.en: Automatic changes the panel as arrow keys move focus. Manual requires Enter or Space to activate the focused tab.

MaxItems.zh: 允许显示的项目数上限。

SiblingCount.zh: 当前页左右各显示几个相邻页码。用 nui.Set(0) 可明确设为 0。
SiblingCount.en: How many neighboring pages to show on each side of the current page. Use nui.Set(0) for none.

Siblings.zh: 旧版相邻页数量；SiblingCount 优先。
Siblings.en: Legacy neighbor count; SiblingCount takes precedence.

ShowControls.zh: 显示上一页和下一页按钮。

ShowEdges.en: Show first and last page entries.

Linear.zh: 按顺序推进步骤；未设置时通常为 true。
Linear.en: Advance steps in order; unset normally enables linear progression.

Current.zh: 当前项的位置，从 0 开始计数。
Current.en: The current item position, starting at 0.

CurrentID.zh: 当前步骤 ID；优先于索引。
CurrentID.en: Current step ID, taking precedence over the index.

Reverse.zh: 反向移动或反向解释进度。

Separator.zh: 在哪一格后插入分隔符，从 1 开始计数；例如 3 表示第三格后。
Separator.en: Slots after which separators appear, counting from 1; for example, 3 means after the third slot.

SeparatorEvery.zh: 每隔指定格数插入分隔符。
SeparatorEvery.en: Insert a separator after each group of slots.

Separators.zh: 用于拆分标签的分隔字符。

AddOnTab.zh: 按 Tab 时添加标签。

AddOnPaste.zh: 粘贴时解析并添加标签。
AddOnPaste.en: Parse and add tags on paste.

Today.zh: 指定日历用来标记今天的日期，便于测试或展示固定日期。
Today.en: Override the date marked as today for tests or fixed-date demonstrations.

IsDateDisabled.zh: 按日期判断是否禁用的函数。
IsDateDisabled.en: Function deciding whether a date is disabled.

HideCalendar.zh: 隐藏日期输入的日历入口。
HideCalendar.en: Hide the calendar trigger in a date input.

TwelveHour.zh: 选择 12 或 24 小时制；未设置时跟随语言偏好。
TwelveHour.en: Choose a 12- or 24-hour clock; unset follows locale preferences.

ID.zh: 唯一且稳定的业务标识。

Build.zh: 创建当前项目的显示内容。界面更新时可能再次执行，不要在其中无条件启动业务操作。
Build.en: Build the current item’s display content. It may run again on UI updates; do not start application actions unconditionally.

Compare.zh: 比较两个数据项，用返回的负数、0 或正数决定排序先后。
Compare.en: Compare two items; return a negative value, zero or a positive value to determine their order.

Cell.zh: 自定义单元格的同步构建函数。

Fixed.zh: 禁止移动列和调整列宽。水平滚动时该列仍会一起移动。
Fixed.en: Prevent column reordering and resizing. The column still moves during horizontal scrolling.

List.zh: 持久的列表滚动和交互状态。
List.en: Persistent list scrolling and interaction state.

CellBuilds.zh: 记录本次构建创建了多少个单元格，用于检查虚拟列表的构建量。
CellBuilds.en: Count cells built in the current pass to inspect virtual-list work.

Fields.zh: 以字段名称索引的表单状态。
Fields.en: Form state indexed by field name.

Validate.zh: 检查表单值，并返回以字段名为键的错误信息；无错误时返回 nil。
Validate.en: Check form values and return errors keyed by field name, or nil when valid.

Search.zh: 替换默认异步搜索。请求和结果回传由应用实现。
Search.en: Replace the default asynchronous search. The application starts requests and delivers results.

Shortcut.zh: 只显示快捷键文字，不注册按键动作。
Shortcut.en: Display shortcut text without registering a keyboard action.

ShortcutKey.zh: 快捷键中的普通按键，例如 K；Ctrl 等修饰键另用 ShortcutMods 设置。
ShortcutKey.en: The main shortcut key, such as K. Set modifiers such as Ctrl separately with ShortcutMods.

Compact.zh: 使用更省空间的布局，例如只显示导航图标。
Compact.en: Use a more compact layout, such as icon-only navigation.

SnapPoints.zh: 面板可停留的高度，按窗口高度比例填写，必须递增且大于 0、不超过 1。
SnapPoints.en: Allowed panel heights as fractions of the window height. Values must increase and be greater than 0 and at most 1.

DismissDistance.zh: 拖动关闭所需的距离阈值。

DismissVelocity.zh: 拖动关闭所需的速度阈值。

Rules.zh: 文件数量、类型和大小检查规则。
Rules.en: File count, type and size validation rules.

Dialog.zh: 原生文件选择框的配置。

Choose.zh: 在后台选择文件并返回结果；通过 UI 线程更新组件状态。
Choose.en: Choose files in the background and return results; update component state on the UI thread.

Curve.zh: 折线或面积边缘的连接方式，如直线、平滑曲线或阶梯线。
Curve.en: How line or area points connect, such as straight, smooth or stepped segments.

Stack.zh: 柱状图或面积图的叠加方式，如普通堆叠或百分比堆叠。
Stack.en: How bar or area series stack, such as standard or normalized stacking.

InteractiveLegend.zh: 允许点击图例来显示或隐藏数据系列。
InteractiveLegend.en: Allow legend activation to show or hide series.

BarPadding.zh: 柱子之间的留白比例，按每个分类占用的宽度计算。
BarPadding.en: Spacing between bars as a fraction of each category’s allotted width.

DonutInnerRadius.zh: 环形图内半径与外半径的比例。
DonutInnerRadius.en: Donut inner radius as a fraction of its outer radius.

Autoplay.zh: 自动翻页的间隔；零表示不自动翻页。

Wrap.zh: 到边界时允许翻页回到另一端。
Wrap.en: Allow explicit paging to wrap at the ends.

ContentKey.zh: 内容变化时修改这个值，让滚动动画从头开始。
ContentKey.en: Change this value when content changes to restart the scrolling animation.

Percent.zh: 启用后按百分比表示尺寸；关闭时使用 DIP。
Percent.en: Use percentages for dimensions when enabled, or DIP when disabled.

MinStepsBetweenThumbs.zh: 两个滑块的最小距离等于这个值乘以 Step。
MinStepsBetweenThumbs.en: The minimum distance between the two sliders is this value multiplied by Step.

ToggleLabel.zh: 折叠或展开操作的可访问名称。
ToggleLabel.en: Accessible name for the collapse/expand action.

ResizeLabel.zh: 侧栏调宽手柄的可访问名称；默认跟随当前语言。
ResizeLabel.en: Accessible name for the sidebar resize handle; localized by default.

SidebarOptions.Collapsible.zh: 允许用户收起整个侧栏；默认 true，显式 false 关闭收起操作。
SidebarOptions.Collapsible.en: Allow the user to collapse the sidebar; true by default. Explicit false disables collapse actions.

SidebarOptions.Side.zh: SideLeft 默认位于阅读方向起始侧，SideRight 位于结束侧；RTL 时镜像。应用负责调整侧栏在布局中的顺序。
SidebarOptions.Side.en: SideLeft is the leading side by default; SideRight is trailing. Both mirror in RTL. The application places the sidebar in layout order.

SidebarOptions.Mode.zh: 窄窗口模式：SidebarSlideover（默认）、SidebarModal（全屏）或 SidebarDrawer（底部）。
SidebarOptions.Mode.en: Narrow-window mode: SidebarSlideover (default), SidebarModal (fullscreen), or SidebarDrawer (bottom sheet).

SidebarOptions.Toggle.zh: 显示内置收起或窄窗口打开按钮；默认 true。隐藏后可使用外部按钮控制状态。
SidebarOptions.Toggle.en: Show the built-in collapse or narrow-window opener; true by default. An external button can control state when hidden.

SidebarOptions.Width.zh: 未设置 State.Width 时的展开宽度，默认 256 DIP；双击手柄以此值复位。
SidebarOptions.Width.en: Expanded width when State.Width is unset, defaulting to 256 DIP; double-click restores this value.

SidebarOptions.State.zh: 保存这个侧栏的展开宽度和窄窗口打开状态。每个窗口、每个侧栏分别保存一份。
SidebarOptions.State.en: Store this sidebar’s expanded width and narrow-window open state. Keep one state per sidebar in each window.

SidebarState.Width.zh: 记住的展开宽度；未设置时读取 Options.Width。清为未设置可恢复配置宽度。
SidebarState.Width.en: Remembered expanded width; unset reads Options.Width. Clear it to restore the configured width.

SidebarState.Open.zh: 控制窄窗口侧栏是否打开，不改变桌面侧栏的收起状态。
SidebarState.Open.en: Control whether the narrow-window sidebar is open, independently of desktop collapse state.

SidebarScope.Collapsed.zh: 当前内容是否使用收起布局；窄窗口弹层始终为 false。
SidebarScope.Collapsed.en: Whether this content uses collapsed layout; always false in the narrow-window overlay.

SidebarScope.Mobile.zh: 当前窗口宽度是否低于断点，使用弹层布局。
SidebarScope.Mobile.en: Whether the window is below the breakpoint and uses overlay layout.

SidebarScope.Collapse.zh: 在操作回调中请求展开或收起，遵守禁用及 Collapsible 配置。
SidebarScope.Collapse.en: Request expansion or collapse from an action callback, respecting disabled and Collapsible settings.

SidebarScope.SetOpen.zh: 在操作回调中打开或关闭窄窗口侧栏。
SidebarScope.SetOpen.en: Open or close the narrow-window sidebar from an action callback.

Resizable.zh: 允许拖动或使用键盘调整侧栏宽度；默认 false。双击手柄恢复配置宽度。
Resizable.en: Enable pointer and keyboard resizing; false by default. Double-click the handle to restore the configured width.

Breakpoint.zh: 窗口宽度小于此值时改用弹层，单位 DIP；0 或未设置时保持桌面布局。预览中按预览框宽度判断。
Breakpoint.en: Use an overlay below this window width in DIP. Zero or unset keeps desktop layout. The preview uses its frame width.

NavigationKey.zh: 应用的当前页面或活动 ID；变化时默认关闭窄窗口弹层，不解析 URL。
NavigationKey.en: Application page or active ID; changes close the narrow-window overlay by default, without URL parsing.

AutoClose.zh: NavigationKey 变化时关闭窄窗口侧栏；默认 true。
AutoClose.en: Close the narrow-window sidebar when NavigationKey changes; true by default.

HeaderContent.zh: 创建标题区，可根据 Collapsed、Open、Mobile 调整内容；设置后优先于 Header。
HeaderContent.en: Build header content using Collapsed, Open and Mobile state. Takes precedence over Header.

FooterContent.zh: 创建底部内容，可按收起状态调整显示；设置后优先于 Footer。
FooterContent.en: Build footer content that adapts to collapse state. Takes precedence over Footer.

ToggleContent.zh: 自定义侧栏按钮，通过传入 Scope 的 Collapse 或 SetOpen 执行操作。
ToggleContent.en: Build a custom sidebar trigger and use the supplied Scope’s Collapse or SetOpen actions.

OnResize.zh: 用户调宽使展开宽度改变时通知，单位 DIP；收起不会覆盖记住的宽度。
OnResize.en: Notify when user resizing changes the expanded width in DIP; collapse preserves the remembered width.

OnCollapsedChange.zh: 展开/收起操作使状态改变时通知；外部直接赋值不触发。
OnCollapsedChange.en: Notify when collapse actions change state; direct external assignment does not emit.

OnOpenChange.zh: 窄窗口侧栏打开或关闭时通知；外部直接赋值不触发。
OnOpenChange.en: Notify when the narrow-window sidebar is opened or closed; direct external assignment does not emit.

PopupPlacement.zh: 紧凑导航子菜单和提示的位置，默认在阅读方向结束侧；右侧栏可显式改为 LeftStart。
PopupPlacement.en: Compact navigation popup and tooltip placement; defaults to the reading direction's trailing side. Right sidebars can use LeftStart.

Image.en: Bitmap resource owned by the application.

Inset.zh: 将标记放在内容边界内。
Inset.en: Place the indicator inside the content boundary.

Platform.zh: 快捷键显示使用的平台名称。
Platform.en: Platform used for keyboard shortcut display.

Direction.en: Directions supported by the scroll area.

State.zh: 保存控件交互状态的对象，应放在视图函数外并在后续构建中复用。
State.en: An interaction state object kept outside the view function and reused across builds.

Checked.en: Checked state of a menu item.

Radio.zh: 以单选菜单项样式展示。
Radio.en: Display as a radio menu item.

CanSelect.zh: 判断某个步骤是否可以进入。
CanSelect.en: Determine whether a step can be entered.

Open.zh: 应用保存的打开状态，可通过修改这个值打开或关闭组件。
Open.en: The open state owned by the application; change it to open or close the component.

Mode.zh: 组件行为模式或主题明暗模式。
Mode.en: Component behavior mode or theme appearance mode.

Light.zh: 浅色模式使用的主题配置。
Light.en: The theme configuration used in light mode.

Dark.zh: 深色主题配置，或表示是否使用深色模式的标志，具体取决于字段类型。
Dark.en: A dark theme configuration or a flag indicating dark mode, depending on the field type.

Motion.zh: 设置动画时长及减少动态效果的行为。
Motion.en: Configure animation timing and reduced-motion behavior.

HighContrast.zh: 启用高对比度主题处理。

Palettes.zh: 主题各用途的色板，例如主色、成功色和中性色。
Palettes.en: Palettes for theme roles such as primary, success and neutral.

OnAction.zh: 执行通知操作时通知应用的回调。
OnAction.en: Application callback when the notification action runs.

OnActivate.zh: 激活组件时通知应用的回调。
OnActivate.en: Application callback when the component is activated.

OnCancel.zh: 取消任务时通知应用的回调。
OnCancel.en: Application callback when a task is canceled.

OnChange.zh: 值发生变化时通知应用的回调。
OnChange.en: Application callback when the value changes.

OnClear.zh: 清空值时通知应用的回调。
OnClear.en: Application callback when the value is cleared.

OnClose.zh: 关闭组件时通知应用的回调。
OnClose.en: Application callback when the component closes.

OnCommit.zh: 提交一次调整时通知应用的回调。
OnCommit.en: Application callback when an adjustment is committed.

OnComplete.zh: 输入完整值时通知应用的回调。
OnComplete.en: Application callback when input is complete.

OnCreate.zh: 请求创建项目时通知应用的回调。
OnCreate.en: Application callback when creation is requested.

OnLegendChange.zh: 图例可见性改变时通知应用的回调。
OnLegendChange.en: Application callback when legend visibility changes.

OnLoad.zh: 请求加载子节点时通知应用的回调。
OnLoad.en: Application callback when children need loading.

OnNavigate.zh: 激活导航项目时通知应用的回调。
OnNavigate.en: Application callback when a navigation item is activated.

OnQuery.zh: 搜索词变化时通知应用的回调。
OnQuery.en: Application callback when the search query changes.

OnRemove.zh: 移除项目时通知应用的回调。
OnRemove.en: Application callback when an item is removed.

OnRetry.zh: 请求重试时通知应用的回调。
OnRetry.en: Application callback when a retry is requested.

OnSelect.zh: 激活或选择项目时通知应用的回调。
OnSelect.en: Application callback when an item is activated or selected.

OnSnap.zh: 抽屉吸附位置变化时通知应用的回调。
OnSnap.en: Application callback when the drawer snap changes.

OnStateChange.zh: 三态值变化时通知应用的回调。
OnStateChange.en: Application callback when the tri-state value changes.

OnSubmit.zh: 提交表单或输入时通知应用的回调。
OnSubmit.en: Application callback when a form or input is submitted.

OnTagsChange.zh: 标签列表变化时通知应用的回调。

OnValueChange.zh: 解析后的值变化时通知应用的回调。
OnValueChange.en: Application callback when the parsed value changes.

OnValuesChange.zh: 多选值变化时通知应用的回调。
OnValuesChange.en: Application callback when multiple values change.

Primary.zh: 主要操作和重点内容的颜色。
Primary.en: Color for primary actions and emphasis.

Dimmed.zh: 占位文字等较弱提示的颜色。
Dimmed.en: Color for subdued text such as placeholders.

Toned.zh: 介于次要文字与正文之间的文字颜色。
Toned.en: A text color between muted and regular body text.

BorderInverted.zh: 反色背景上使用的边框颜色。
BorderInverted.en: Border color used on an inverted background.

Accented.zh: 需要更明显区分的背景颜色。
Accented.en: A background color for more prominent separation.

Elevated.zh: 需要区分层次的区域背景色。
Elevated.en: A background color for elevated content areas.

InvertedBackground.zh: 与当前明暗模式形成反差的背景色。
InvertedBackground.en: A background color that contrasts with the current light or dark mode.

Type.zh: 分隔线的样式类型，例如实线或虚线。
Type.en: Separator line style, such as solid or dashed.

InputDateOptions.ShowCalendar.zh: 显式显示日历按钮和弹层；默认 false，仅显示分段日期输入。
InputDateOptions.ShowCalendar.en: Show the calendar button and popover explicitly; false by default, leaving a segmented date field.

InputDateOptions.HideCalendar.zh: 兼容旧调用的关闭开关；优先于 ShowCalendar，并收起已打开的日历。
InputDateOptions.HideCalendar.en: Compatibility switch that overrides ShowCalendar and closes an open calendar.

InputDateOptions.Calendar.zh: 日期边界、禁用/不可用谓词和范围限制同时用于输入与日历；其他外观与导航配置仅用于弹层。Range 和内部关闭回调由输入组件管理。OnChange 在范围中保留兼容通知，单日中只通知日历操作。
InputDateOptions.Calendar.en: Bounds, disabled/unavailable predicates and range constraints apply to edits and calendar selection. Appearance and navigation settings apply to the popup. The input manages Range and closing. OnChange remains a legacy range notification and reports calendar actions for a single date.

InputTimeOptions.TwelveHour.zh: 未设置时跟随窗口语言及系统区域小时制；true 为 12 小时，false 为 24 小时。切换保留业务值和草稿。
InputTimeOptions.TwelveHour.en: Unset follows the window locale and regional hour cycle; true selects 12 hours and false selects 24. Switching preserves values and drafts.

InputTimeOptions.Seconds.zh: Granularity 未设置时显示秒；隐藏后仍保留原秒值。
InputTimeOptions.Seconds.en: Shows seconds when Granularity is unset; hidden seconds retain their value.

InputDateOptions.Placeholder.zh: 不适用于分段输入；各段占位符使用组件语言目录中的 Placeholder 键。
InputDateOptions.Placeholder.en: Not used by segmented inputs; segment placeholders come from the component locale catalog.

InputDateOptions.Password.zh: 不适用于分段日期／时间输入，不会遮罩字段。
InputDateOptions.Password.en: Not used by segmented date/time inputs; segments are not masked.

InputDateOptions.MaxLength.zh: 不适用于分段输入；各段按日期／时间范围限制位数和值。
InputDateOptions.MaxLength.en: Not used by segmented inputs; each segment restricts its digits and value to date/time bounds.

InputDateOptions.Style.zh: 同步接收 root、editor、leading、trailing；editor 是第一个可聚焦分段，不是原生文本编辑器。
InputDateOptions.Style.en: Synchronously receives root, editor, leading and trailing; editor is the first focusable segment, not a native text editor.

InputDateOptions.UI.zh: Root、Editor、Segment、Leading、Trailing 控制外框、分段和配件；日期范围还支持 SeparatorSlot。
InputDateOptions.UI.en: Root, Editor, Segment, Leading and Trailing style the field and its parts; date ranges also support SeparatorSlot.

InputDateOptions.OnChange.zh: 草稿变化时回调；返回规范格式的草稿或被拒绝的粘贴原文，未完成的输入不会提交业务值。
InputDateOptions.OnChange.en: Called when the draft changes, with canonical draft text or rejected pasted text. Incomplete input does not commit a value.

InputTimeOptions.Placeholder.zh: 不适用于分段输入；各段占位符使用组件语言目录中的 Placeholder 键。
InputTimeOptions.Placeholder.en: Not used by segmented inputs; segment placeholders come from the component locale catalog.

InputTimeOptions.Password.zh: 不适用于分段日期／时间输入，不会遮罩字段。
InputTimeOptions.Password.en: Not used by segmented date/time inputs; segments are not masked.

InputTimeOptions.MaxLength.zh: 不适用于分段输入；各段按日期／时间范围限制位数和值。
InputTimeOptions.MaxLength.en: Not used by segmented inputs; each segment restricts its digits and value to date/time bounds.

InputTimeOptions.Style.zh: 同步接收 root、editor、leading、trailing；editor 是第一个可聚焦分段，不是原生文本编辑器。
InputTimeOptions.Style.en: Synchronously receives root, editor, leading and trailing; editor is the first focusable segment, not a native text editor.

InputTimeOptions.UI.zh: Root、Editor、Segment、Leading、Trailing 控制外框、分段和配件；日期范围还支持 SeparatorSlot。
InputTimeOptions.UI.en: Root, Editor, Segment, Leading and Trailing style the field and its parts; date ranges also support SeparatorSlot.

InputTimeOptions.OnChange.zh: 草稿变化时回调；返回规范格式的草稿或被拒绝的粘贴原文，未完成的输入不会提交业务值。
InputTimeOptions.OnChange.en: Called when the draft changes, with canonical draft text or rejected pasted text. Incomplete input does not commit a value.

PropagateSelect.zh: 多选时同步选择或取消已加载的子孙节点；遇到禁用节点时停止向下联动。
PropagateSelect.en: In multiple mode, select or deselect loaded descendants, stopping propagation at disabled nodes.

BubbleSelect.zh: 多选时根据可用子节点的选择更新祖先；部分子节点选中时显示半选状态。
BubbleSelect.en: In multiple mode, update ancestors from their enabled children, showing a mixed state when only some are selected.

ExpandOnClick.zh: 默认 true；点击行同时选择并展开/折叠，false 时使用箭头或左右键。Enter/Space 只选择。
ExpandOnClick.en: Defaults to true: row clicks select and toggle. When false, use the arrow or Left/Right. Enter/Space only select.

ExpandedIcon.zh: 展开分支的默认前导图标，默认为 FolderOpen；节点 Icon 优先。
ExpandedIcon.en: Default leading icon for expanded branches: FolderOpen. Node Icon takes precedence.

CollapsedIcon.zh: 折叠分支的默认前导图标，默认为 Folder；节点 Icon 优先。
CollapsedIcon.en: Default leading icon for collapsed branches: Folder. Node Icon takes precedence.

DefaultExpanded.zh: TreeState 首次加入此 ID 时应用；更新已有 ID 不会重新打开已折叠分支。
DefaultExpanded.en: Applied when this ID first enters TreeState; updating an existing ID does not reopen it.

OnToggle.zh: 展开/折叠前调用一次；TreeEvent.PreventDefault 可取消，节点回调覆盖全局回调。
OnToggle.en: Called once before toggling; TreeEvent.PreventDefault cancels it. A node handler overrides the global handler.

TreeOptions.OnSelect.zh: 选择操作前调用，未改变值时也调用；PreventDefault 可取消。
TreeOptions.OnSelect.en: Called before selection, including unchanged activations; PreventDefault cancels it.

TreeOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户操作实际改变选择集合后通知一次；外部赋值、展开和方向键高亮不通知。回调后从 Selection 读取 ID。
TreeOptions.OnChange.en: Notifies once after a user action changes selection. External edits, expansion and highlight movement are silent. Read selected IDs from Selection.

TreeOptions.Build.zh: 替换前导图标之后的正文，接收当前节点状态；应提供非交互内容并自行控制增长和截断。部分选中遵循 Multiple 与联动选项。
TreeOptions.Build.en: Replaces content after the leading icon using the current item state. Provide non-interactive content and control growth/truncation. Mixed state follows Multiple and linkage options.

TreeOptions.Nested.zh: 默认 true：显示祖先竖线，子项背景和点击区域随层级缩进；false 使用整行背景和点击区域，内容仍缩进。两种模式均保持原生虚拟化。
TreeOptions.Nested.en: Defaults to true: show ancestor guides and inset child backgrounds/hit areas. False uses full-width rows with indented content. Both modes remain natively virtualized.

CheckboxOptions.Loading.zh: Checkbox 不使用此字段；它来自与 Switch 共用的选项类型。保留此字段以兼容已有配置，不显示加载状态。
CheckboxOptions.Loading.en: Not used by Checkbox. This field belongs to the options shared with Switch and is retained for configuration compatibility; it does not show loading.

CheckboxOptions.LoadingIcon.zh: Checkbox 不使用此字段；加载图标仅对 Switch 生效。
CheckboxOptions.LoadingIcon.en: Not used by Checkbox; the loading icon applies to Switch only.

CheckboxOptions.UncheckedIcon.zh: Checkbox 不使用此字段；未选中时不显示图标。此字段用于 Switch。
CheckboxOptions.UncheckedIcon.en: Not used by Checkbox; its unchecked indicator has no icon. This field is used by Switch.

CheckboxOptions.Variant.zh: 默认 ChoiceList，可选 ChoiceCard。ChoiceTable 是 Go 原生扩展；Nuxt UI 的单个 Checkbox 不提供 table 样式。
CheckboxOptions.Variant.en: Defaults to ChoiceList; ChoiceCard is also supported. ChoiceTable is a Go native extension, not a variant of the upstream standalone Checkbox.

SwitchOptions.Loading.zh: 显示加载图标，并禁止鼠标、键盘和关联字段标签切换值。默认 false。
SwitchOptions.Loading.en: Show the loading icon and prevent changes through the pointer, keyboard and associated field label. Defaults to false.

SwitchOptions.LoadingIcon.zh: Loading 为 true 时使用的图标；未设置时使用 LoaderCircle。
SwitchOptions.LoadingIcon.en: Icon used while Loading is true; defaults to LoaderCircle when unset.

SwitchOptions.CheckedIcon.zh: Switch 开启时显示在滑块内的图标；未设置时不显示图标。
SwitchOptions.CheckedIcon.en: Icon inside the thumb while the Switch is on; no icon is shown when unset.

SwitchOptions.UncheckedIcon.zh: Switch 关闭时显示在滑块内的图标；未设置时不显示图标。
SwitchOptions.UncheckedIcon.en: Icon inside the thumb while the Switch is off; no icon is shown when unset.

SwitchOptions.Variant.zh: Go 原生扩展：默认 ChoiceList，可用 ChoiceCard 或 ChoiceTable 为开关添加外框。Nuxt UI Switch 没有此参数。
SwitchOptions.Variant.en: Go native extension: defaults to ChoiceList; ChoiceCard and ChoiceTable add an outer container. Nuxt UI Switch has no corresponding prop.

SwitchOptions.Indicator.zh: Go 原生扩展：默认 IndicatorStart，可将开关移到文字末尾或隐藏；隐藏时仍保留选择状态和焦点交互。
SwitchOptions.Indicator.en: Go native extension: defaults to IndicatorStart; move the switch after its text or hide it while preserving selection and focus interaction.

CheckboxGroupOptions.Max.zh: 未设置时不限制选中数量；显式 0 禁止新增选择。达到上限后，未选项仍可聚焦，已选项仍可取消。
CheckboxGroupOptions.Max.en: Unset allows any number of selections; explicit zero prevents additional selections. At the limit, unchecked items remain focusable and selected items can still be cleared.

CheckboxGroupOptions.Variant.zh: 默认 ChoiceList，可选 ChoiceCard 或 ChoiceTable；ChoiceTable 将相邻选项的边框连在一起。三者均对应上游选项组样式。
CheckboxGroupOptions.Variant.en: Defaults to ChoiceList; ChoiceCard and ChoiceTable are also supported. ChoiceTable joins adjacent borders. All three correspond to upstream group variants.

RadioGroupOptions.Max.zh: RadioGroup 不使用此字段；它只允许单选。Max 来自与 CheckboxGroup 共用的选项类型，保留用于配置兼容。
RadioGroupOptions.Max.en: Not used by RadioGroup, which only selects one item. Max belongs to the shared CheckboxGroup options and is retained for configuration compatibility.

RadioGroupOptions.Variant.zh: 默认 ChoiceList，可选 ChoiceCard 或 ChoiceTable；三者均对应上游单选组样式。
RadioGroupOptions.Variant.en: Defaults to ChoiceList; ChoiceCard and ChoiceTable are also supported. All three correspond to upstream radio group variants.

CheckboxTriOptions.Loading.zh: Checkbox 不使用此字段；它来自与 Switch 共用的选项类型。保留此字段以兼容已有配置，不显示加载状态。
CheckboxTriOptions.Loading.en: Not used by Checkbox. This field belongs to the options shared with Switch and is retained for configuration compatibility; it does not show loading.

CheckboxTriOptions.LoadingIcon.zh: Checkbox 不使用此字段；加载图标仅对 Switch 生效。
CheckboxTriOptions.LoadingIcon.en: Not used by Checkbox; the loading icon applies to Switch only.

CheckboxTriOptions.UncheckedIcon.zh: Checkbox 不使用此字段；未选中时不显示图标。此字段用于 Switch。
CheckboxTriOptions.UncheckedIcon.en: Not used by Checkbox; its unchecked indicator has no icon. This field is used by Switch.

CheckboxTriOptions.Variant.zh: 默认 ChoiceList，可选 ChoiceCard。ChoiceTable 是 Go 原生扩展；Nuxt UI 的单个 Checkbox 不提供 table 样式。
CheckboxTriOptions.Variant.en: Defaults to ChoiceList; ChoiceCard is also supported. ChoiceTable is a Go native extension, not a variant of the upstream standalone Checkbox.

CheckboxTriOptions.IndeterminateIcon.zh: 部分选中且指示器可见时使用的图标；未设置时使用减号。隐藏指示器时只使用显式 CheckedIcon 作为标签图标。
CheckboxTriOptions.IndeterminateIcon.en: Icon used for a visible indeterminate indicator; defaults to a minus. A hidden indicator uses only an explicit CheckedIcon above the label.

CheckboxOptions.CheckedIcon.zh: 选中时替换默认勾号；隐藏指示器时，显式图标显示在标签上方，不随选中状态消失。未设置时，隐藏模式不显示图标。
CheckboxOptions.CheckedIcon.en: Replace the default check when checked. With a hidden indicator, an explicit icon stays above the label regardless of state; no icon is shown when unset.

CheckboxTriOptions.CheckedIcon.zh: 选中时替换默认勾号；隐藏指示器时，显式图标显示在标签上方，不随选中状态消失。未设置时，隐藏模式不显示图标。
CheckboxTriOptions.CheckedIcon.en: Replace the default check when checked. With a hidden indicator, an explicit icon stays above the label regardless of state; no icon is shown when unset.

CheckboxGroupOptions.Loop.zh: 方向键到首尾是否循环；未设置时为 false，显式 Set(false) 停止在边界。
CheckboxGroupOptions.Loop.en: Wrap arrow navigation at either boundary. Unset defaults to false; explicit Set(false) stops at the edge.

RadioGroupOptions.Loop.zh: 方向键到首尾是否循环；未设置时为 true，显式 Set(false) 停止在边界。
RadioGroupOptions.Loop.en: Wrap arrow navigation at either boundary. Unset defaults to true; explicit Set(false) stops at the edge.

ChoiceGroupOptions.Loop.zh: 方向键循环设置；CheckboxGroup 默认 false，RadioGroup 默认 true。
ChoiceGroupOptions.Loop.en: Arrow wrapping: CheckboxGroup defaults to false, RadioGroup to true.

AlertOptions.Avatar.zh: 可选头像，优先于 Icon；Size 未设置时直径为 44 DIP，显式头像尺寸优先。
AlertOptions.Avatar.en: Optional avatar, preceding Icon; defaults to 44 DIP unless Avatar.Size is explicit.

AlertOptions.Close.zh: 关闭按钮配置；非 nil 或 OnClose 非 nil 时显示。默认 MD、Neutral、LinkVariant 和零内边距，显式 ButtonOptions 覆盖默认值。
AlertOptions.Close.en: Close-button options; shown when Close or OnClose is non-nil. Defaults to MD, Neutral, LinkVariant and zero padding, with explicit ButtonOptions taking precedence.

AlertOptions.CloseIcon.zh: 关闭图标，默认 X；Close.Leading 显式设置时优先使用该图标。
AlertOptions.CloseIcon.en: Close icon, defaulting to X. Explicit Close.Leading takes precedence.

AlertOptions.OnClose.zh: 关闭按钮激活时通知一次；组件不会自行隐藏，由应用更新可见状态。
AlertOptions.OnClose.en: Called once per close activation; the component does not hide itself. The application owns visibility.

AlertOptions.Orientation.zh: 默认 Vertical，操作区位于正文下方；Horizontal 放在正文旁边，关闭按钮保持在尾端。
AlertOptions.Orientation.en: Defaults to Vertical, with actions below the body. Horizontal puts them beside the body; close stays at the trailing edge.

AlertOptions.Actions.zh: 同步构建操作区，默认按钮尺寸由调用者设置；与上游示例一致时使用 XS。切换方向保留子控件身份。
AlertOptions.Actions.en: Builds the action area synchronously. The caller chooses button sizes; use XS to match upstream defaults. Child identity is preserved across orientation changes.

AlertOptions.UI.zh: 部件为 Root、Body、Leading、Label、Description、Actions、Trailing；Body 对应文字容器，Trailing 对应关闭按钮。
AlertOptions.UI.en: Parts: Root, Body, Leading, Label, Description, Actions and Trailing. Body is the text wrapper; Trailing is the close button.

AlertOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建的上述部件，应用于 UI 之后；不得保存 Element 或在延迟回调中使用。
AlertOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures these current-build parts after UI. Do not retain Elements or use them from deferred callbacks.

AvatarOptions.Image.zh: 已解码的位图，优先于 Icon、Text 和 Alt；nil 时使用回退内容。图片填满根容器并居中裁剪，可通过 Body 部件样式调整。
AvatarOptions.Image.en: Decoded bitmap, preceding Icon, Text and Alt. A nil image uses fallback content. It fills the root with centered cover cropping; Body styles customize the image.

AvatarOptions.Alt.zh: 可访问名称；没有图片、图标和 Text 时，从空格分词的首字符中取前两个作为回退，保留大小写。
AvatarOptions.Alt.en: Accessible name; without an image, icon or Text, uses the first two initials from space-separated words, preserving case.

AvatarOptions.Text.zh: 原样显示的回退文字，优先于 Alt 首字母；没有 Alt 时也用作可访问名称。
AvatarOptions.Text.en: Literal fallback text, preceding initials from Alt. Also supplies the accessible name when Alt is empty.

AvatarOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD；XS、SM、MD、LG、XL 直径为 24、28、32、36、40 DIP，并遵循文字缩放。
AvatarOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD. XS, SM, MD, LG and XL diameters are 24, 28, 32, 36 and 40 DIP and follow text scaling.

AvatarOptions.UI.zh: 部件为 Root、Body（位图）、Leading（图标）和 Label（回退文字）。
AvatarOptions.UI.en: Parts are Root, Body (bitmap), Leading (icon) and Label (fallback text).

AvatarOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建的 Root、Body、Leading 或 Label，应用于 UI 之后；Body 仅在有位图时存在。
AvatarOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build Root, Body, Leading or Label after UI. Body exists only for a bitmap.

AvatarGroupOptions.Max.zh: 未设置或小于等于 0 时显示全部；正数限制普通头像数量，另用 +n 表示剩余人数。
AvatarGroupOptions.Max.en: Unset or non-positive values show all avatars. A positive limit counts regular avatars; an additional +n avatar represents hidden members.

AvatarGroupOptions.Overlap.zh: 默认重叠距离随 Size 为 2 / 6 / 6 / 6 / 8 DIP；显式 0 取消重叠，负数产生间距。Root.Gap 可进一步覆盖。
AvatarGroupOptions.Overlap.en: Default overlap is 2 / 6 / 6 / 6 / 8 DIP by Size. Explicit zero disables overlap; a negative value adds spacing. Root.Gap can override it.

AvatarGroupOptions.UI.zh: Root 配置容器，Item 配置普通与溢出头像根。Item.BorderWidth / BorderColor 对应外侧分隔环，显式宽度 0 移除分隔环。
AvatarGroupOptions.UI.en: Root styles the container; Item styles regular and overflow avatar roots. Item.BorderWidth and BorderColor control the outer ring; explicit width zero removes it.

AvatarGroupOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建的 Root 和 Item；Item 在各头像自身样式之后应用，包括溢出头像。
AvatarGroupOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build Root and Item. Item applies after each avatar’s own styles, including overflow.

ChipOptions.Position.zh: 默认 TopRight；四个角按物理左右定位，RTL 不镜像。
ChipOptions.Position.en: Defaults to TopRight. Corners use physical left/right and do not mirror in RTL.

ChipOptions.Hidden.zh: 默认 false；只隐藏角标，主体内容和交互保留。对应上游 show 的反值。
ChipOptions.Hidden.en: Defaults to false. Hides only the marker, preserving the host and its interaction. Inverse of upstream show.

ChipOptions.Inset.zh: 默认 false，角标中心位于主体角点；true 将角标放在主体边界内。独立角标不应用偏移。
ChipOptions.Inset.en: Defaults to false, centering the marker on the host corner. True keeps it inside the host. Standalone chips have no offset.

ChipOptions.UI.zh: Root 配置外层，Indicator 配置角标；文字宽度使用合并后的 Font、FontSize、Weight 和 PaddingX。
ChipOptions.UI.en: Root styles the wrapper; Indicator styles the marker. Text width uses the merged Font, FontSize, Weight and PaddingX.

ChipOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建的 Root 或 Indicator。Style 在宽度测量后执行；修改文字尺寸时需自行设置相应宽高。
ChipOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build Root or Indicator after width measurement. Set suitable dimensions when changing text size here.

ChipOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；Neutral 使用主题 InvertedBackground，其余语义色使用对应色值，文字为 Inverted。
ChipOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary. Neutral uses the theme’s InvertedBackground; other semantic colors use their color values. Text uses Inverted.

SeparatorOptions.Avatar.zh: 内容优先级最低；默认直径 20 DIP，显式 Avatar.Size 优先。Leading 配置头像根。
SeparatorOptions.Avatar.en: Lowest content priority; defaults to 20 DIP unless Avatar.Size is explicit. Leading styles its root.

SeparatorOptions.Content.zh: 同步构建内容，优先于 Label、Icon 和 Avatar；切换位置与方向保留内容容器身份。
SeparatorOptions.Content.en: Synchronously builds content before Label, Icon and Avatar in priority. Content-container identity persists across position and orientation changes.

SeparatorOptions.Label.zh: 没有 Content 时显示；优先于图标和头像。横向单行，纵向允许在受限宽度中换行。
SeparatorOptions.Label.en: Shown when Content is nil; precedes icon and avatar. Single-line horizontally, wrapping within constrained widths vertically.

SeparatorOptions.UI.zh: 部件为 Root、Body、Label、Leading、Indicator；虚线和点线的笔画颜色使用 Indicator.Background。
SeparatorOptions.UI.en: Parts: Root, Body, Label, Leading and Indicator. Indicator.Background controls dashed and dotted strokes.

ButtonOptions.Color.zh: 选择主色、成功、警告等用途的颜色。未指定时采用主题或组件默认颜色。 Neutral / Solid 使用 InvertedBackground 背景和 Inverted 文字。
ButtonOptions.Color.en: Choose a color role such as primary, success or warning. An unspecified value uses the theme or component default. Neutral / Solid uses InvertedBackground for its background and Inverted for text.

BadgeOptions.Color.zh: 选择主色、成功、警告等用途的颜色。未指定时采用主题或组件默认颜色。 Neutral / Solid 使用 InvertedBackground 背景和 Inverted 文字。
BadgeOptions.Color.en: Choose a color role such as primary, success or warning. An unspecified value uses the theme or component default. Neutral / Solid uses InvertedBackground for its background and Inverted for text.

AlertOptions.Color.zh: 选择主色、成功、警告等用途的颜色。未指定时采用主题或组件默认颜色。 Neutral / Solid 使用 InvertedBackground 背景和 Inverted 文字。
AlertOptions.Color.en: Choose a color role such as primary, success or warning. An unspecified value uses the theme or component default. Neutral / Solid uses InvertedBackground for its background and Inverted for text.

KbdOptions.Color.zh: 选择主色、成功、警告等用途的颜色。未指定时采用主题或组件默认颜色。 Neutral / Solid 使用 InvertedBackground 背景和 Inverted 文字。
KbdOptions.Color.en: Choose a color role such as primary, success or warning. An unspecified value uses the theme or component default. Neutral / Solid uses InvertedBackground for its background and Inverted for text.

KbdOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD；SM / MD / LG 的高度为 16 / 20 / 24 DIP。XS 和 XL 是兼容的 SM、LG 尺寸别名，尺寸和字号遵循文字缩放。
KbdOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD. SM / MD / LG heights are 16 / 20 / 24 DIP. XS and XL are compatible aliases for SM and LG; dimensions and fonts follow text scaling.

KbdOptions.Platform.zh: 默认当前 GOOS。darwin 使用 macOS 修饰键标签，其他值使用现有桌面标签；command / win 始终为 ⌘ / ⊞。不注册快捷键。
KbdOptions.Platform.en: Defaults to the current GOOS. darwin uses macOS modifier labels; other values use existing desktop labels. command / win always map to ⌘ / ⊞. Does not register shortcuts.

KbdOptions.UI.zh: Label 对应各按键的完整外框和文字样式，Root 配置外层组合行；对应上游 ui.base 的是 Label。
KbdOptions.UI.en: Label styles each complete key surface and its text; Root styles the outer row. Upstream ui.base corresponds to Label.

SkeletonOptions.Width.zh: 原生尺寸扩展，单位 DIP，未设置时为 160；显式 0 保留。可在返回元素上调用 FillWidth 适应父级宽度。
SkeletonOptions.Width.en: Native dimension in DIP; defaults to 160. Explicit zero is preserved. Call FillWidth on the returned element to use the parent width.

SkeletonOptions.Height.zh: 原生尺寸扩展，单位 DIP。未设置时为 16 并遵循文字缩放；显式值保持原尺寸，0 不使用默认高度。
SkeletonOptions.Height.en: Native dimension in DIP. Unset height is 16 with text scaling; explicit values keep their size, including zero.

SkeletonOptions.Animate.zh: 原生动画开关，默认启用。主题或系统减少动态效果优先于显式 true。背景透明度在 0.5–1 之间变化；移出可见区后停止请求帧。
SkeletonOptions.Animate.en: Native animation switch, enabled by default. Theme or system reduced motion takes precedence over explicit true. Background opacity pulses from 0.5 to 1; offscreen instances stop requesting frames.

SkeletonOptions.UI.zh: Root 对应上游 ui.base；Background 设置脉冲颜色，Radius 设置圆角。全局组件样式、实例 UI、Style 依次应用。
SkeletonOptions.UI.en: Root corresponds to upstream ui.base. Background sets the pulse color and Radius sets the corner radius. Component defaults, instance UI and Style apply in that order.

SkeletonOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置 Root；Radius 可覆盖 UI 圆角。Background 仅改变底层表面，自绘脉冲颜色请用 UI.Root.Background。
SkeletonOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures Root; Radius overrides the UI radius. Background affects the underlying surface only. Use UI.Root.Background for the drawn pulse color.

ProgressOptions.Max.zh: 默认 100；显式值必须是有限正数，否则 panic。只接受数值，没有上游步骤数组形式。
ProgressOptions.Max.en: Defaults to 100; explicit values must be finite and positive or panic. Numeric maxima only; no upstream step-array form.

ProgressOptions.Indeterminate.zh: 忽略完成量，显示半条轨道长的未知进度指示器；默认两秒轮播，减少动态效果时居中静止。
ProgressOptions.Indeterminate.en: Ignores the amount and shows a half-track unknown-progress indicator. Uses a two-second carousel, centered and still under reduced motion.

ProgressOptions.Inverted.zh: 反转填充或未知进度移动方向。水平方向先遵循 LTR / RTL；纵向默认从顶部填充。
ProgressOptions.Inverted.en: Reverses fill or unknown-progress motion. Horizontal progress follows LTR / RTL first; vertical progress fills from the top by default.

ProgressOptions.Vertical.zh: 兼容的原生方向开关；true 或 Orientation=Vertical 任一成立即为纵向。
ProgressOptions.Vertical.en: Compatible native orientation switch; either true or Orientation=Vertical enables vertical progress.

ProgressOptions.Label.zh: 原生可访问名称，不直接显示在轨道上。工作单位等值说明可用返回元素的 Value 设置。
ProgressOptions.Label.en: Native accessible name, not visible track text. Set work-unit value text with Value on the returned element.

ProgressOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；Neutral 填充使用 InvertedBackground。任意填充色可通过 Indicator.Background 设置。
ProgressOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary; Neutral uses InvertedBackground. Set Indicator.Background for an arbitrary fill color.

ProgressOptions.Animate.zh: 默认启用；控制 200ms 数值过渡与两秒未知进度轮播，系统或主题减少动态效果优先。没有其他 CSS 动画预设。
ProgressOptions.Animate.en: Enabled by default. Controls the 200ms value transition and two-second unknown-progress carousel. System or theme reduced motion takes precedence; other CSS animation presets are not provided.

ProgressOptions.UI.zh: Root 是进度轨道，对应上游 base；Indicator 读取 Background 作为自绘填充色，其他 Indicator 字段不生效。
ProgressOptions.UI.en: Root is the track, corresponding to upstream base. Indicator reads Background for the drawn fill color; other Indicator fields do not apply.

ProgressSegment.ID.zh: 唯一、非空的稳定项目标识。重排时保留分段和自定义图例控件的身份。
ProgressSegment.ID.en: Unique non-empty stable item identity; preserves segment and custom legend identity when reordered.

ProgressSegment.Icon.zh: 图例图标；未设置时显示色点。有图标且无标签也会显示图例，Build 优先于默认图标和文字。
ProgressSegment.Icon.en: Legend icon; falls back to a dot. An icon without a label still creates the legend. Build replaces default icon and text content.

ProgressSegment.Build.zh: 同步构建整行图例内容，优先于默认图标、标签和百分比。不要保存 Context 或本次构建的 Element；隐藏图例时不调用。
ProgressSegment.Build.en: Synchronously builds the complete legend row instead of its default icon, label and percentage. Do not retain Context or current-build Elements. Not called while the legend is hidden.

ProgressSegment.UI.zh: 项目局部样式，支持 Segment、Item、Leading、Label、Trailing，覆盖同一部件的组级 UI。Segment.Background 可指定任意分段颜色。
ProgressSegment.UI.en: Item styles for Segment, Item, Leading, Label and Trailing, overriding group UI for the same part. Segment.Background supports arbitrary fill colors.

ProgressGroupOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary，只给未显式设置颜色的项目提供默认值。Neutral 分段和色点使用 InvertedBackground，Neutral 图标使用 Highlighted。
ProgressGroupOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary for items without an explicit color. Neutral segments and dots use InvertedBackground; neutral icons use Highlighted.

ProgressGroupOptions.Size.en: XS–XL track thickness: 2/4/8/12/16 DIP. Legend font: 12/14/14/14/16; icons: 12/16/16/16/20; dots: 6/8/8/8/10. Legend dimensions follow text scaling.

ProgressGroupOptions.Max.zh: 默认 100；显式值必须是有限正数，否则 panic。每段先限制到 0–Max，再按总量计算显示比例。
ProgressGroupOptions.Max.en: Defaults to 100; explicit maxima must be finite and positive or panic. Each value is clamped to 0–Max before computing displayed proportions.

ProgressGroupOptions.Height.zh: 原生纵向轨道高度，单位 DIP；≤0 使用 160。水平布局不读取此字段。
ProgressGroupOptions.Height.en: Native vertical track height in DIP; values≤0 use 160. Ignored in horizontal layout.

ProgressGroupOptions.UI.zh: Root 为外层，Indicator 为整个轨道，Segment 为分段，List 为图例列表，Item 为图例行，Leading / Label / Trailing 为默认图例内容。
ProgressGroupOptions.UI.en: Root is the outer layout; Indicator is the full track; Segment is a segment; List is the legend; Item is its row; Leading / Label / Trailing style default legend content.

EmptyOptions.Avatar.zh: 可选头像，Image 优先于图标；未显式设置 Size 时随 Empty 使用 32/36/40/44/48 DIP。显式 Avatar.Icon 优先于 Empty.Icon / LoadingIcon。
EmptyOptions.Avatar.en: Optional avatar. Image takes precedence over icons. Unset Size uses Empty dimensions of 32/36/40/44/48 DIP; explicit Avatar.Icon overrides Empty.Icon / LoadingIcon.

EmptyOptions.Header.zh: 同步构建整个页头，替换默认前导内容、标题和描述。
EmptyOptions.Header.en: Synchronously builds the complete header, replacing leading content, title and description.

EmptyOptions.Leading.zh: 同步构建前导内容，优先于 Avatar、Icon 与加载图标；Header 非空时不调用。
EmptyOptions.Leading.en: Synchronously builds leading content instead of Avatar, Icon or the loading icon. Not called when Header is provided.

EmptyOptions.Body.zh: 同步构建正文，替换默认 Actions 区域；Footer 仍可独立显示。
EmptyOptions.Body.en: Synchronously builds the body instead of the default Actions area. Footer remains independent.

EmptyOptions.Actions.zh: 同步构建操作按钮或其他控件；Body 非空时不调用。按钮尺寸、禁用与动作由应用配置。
EmptyOptions.Actions.en: Synchronously builds actions or other controls. Not called when Body is provided. The application configures button size, disabled state and actions.

EmptyOptions.Loading.zh: 默认 false；使用加载图标并旋转，但头像图片仍优先显示，自定义 Header / Leading 可以替换默认前导区域。不会自动禁用操作。
EmptyOptions.Loading.en: Defaults to false; shows a spinning loading icon, while avatar images retain priority. Custom Header / Leading can replace the leading area. Does not automatically disable actions.

EmptyOptions.Title.zh: 默认标题文字，提供二级标题语义；Header 非空时不显示。
EmptyOptions.Title.en: Default title text, exposed as a level-two heading. Hidden when Header is provided.

EmptyOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Header、Leading、Label、Description、Body、Actions、Footer。Leading 对应默认图标或自定义前导容器；头像外观通过 Avatar.UI 配置。
EmptyOptions.UI.en: Parts: Root, Header, Leading, Label, Description, Body, Actions and Footer. Leading is the default icon or custom leading container; configure the avatar surface with Avatar.UI.

UserOptions.Avatar.zh: 全为空时不显示头像。未提供 Alt 时使用 Name，Size 始终由 User.Size 决定，嵌套 Avatar.Size 不生效。
UserOptions.Avatar.en: Empty options show no avatar. Missing Alt falls back to Name. User.Size always controls size; nested Avatar.Size is ignored.

UserOptions.Chip.zh: 仅在默认头像存在时显示。User.Size 覆盖 Chip.Size，Inset 固定为 true；其他颜色、文字、位置和隐藏配置沿用 Chip。Leading 自定义内容自行管理角标。
UserOptions.Chip.en: Shown only with the default avatar. User.Size overrides Chip.Size and Inset is forced true. Other color, text, position and hidden options follow Chip. Custom Leading content manages its own chip.

UserOptions.Orientation.zh: 默认 Horizontal；设置 Vertical 或兼容字段 Vertical=true 任一成立即为纵向。
UserOptions.Orientation.en: Defaults to Horizontal. Either Orientation=Vertical or the legacy Vertical=true enables vertical layout.

UserOptions.Vertical.zh: 兼容的原生方向开关。true 时启用纵向；也可使用 Orientation。
UserOptions.Vertical.en: Compatible native orientation switch; true enables vertical layout. Orientation is also supported.

UserOptions.Leading.zh: 同步构建头像区域，替换默认 Avatar 和 Chip；不自动应用头像缩放。
UserOptions.Leading.en: Synchronously builds the leading area instead of the default Avatar and Chip; avatar scaling is not applied automatically.

UserOptions.Body.zh: 同步替换默认姓名和说明，wrapper 的样式通过 Body 部件配置。可激活项仍应提供 Name 作为可访问名称。
UserOptions.Body.en: Synchronously replaces default name and description. Style its wrapper through Body. Interactive entries should still provide Name as an accessible name.

UserOptions.OnActivate.zh: 提供后使用原生按钮，支持点击、Enter、Space；每次激活通知一次。禁用或父级禁用时不触发，路由和 URL 打开由应用处理。
UserOptions.OnActivate.en: Creates a native button for clicks, Enter and Space, with one callback per activation. Disabled entries or disabled parents block it. The application handles routing and URL opening.

UserOptions.UI.zh: Root 为外层，Body 对应文字 wrapper，Label / Description 对应默认文字，Leading 对应默认头像或自定义前导容器。
UserOptions.UI.en: Root is the outer layout; Body is the text wrapper; Label / Description style default text; Leading is the default avatar or custom leading container.

InputOptions.Avatar.zh: 前导头像；显式 Leading 或前导加载图标优先。Avatar.Size 未设置时按输入尺寸使用 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP，显式头像尺寸优先。
InputOptions.Avatar.en: Leading avatar, replaced by an explicit Leading icon or leading loader. Unset Avatar.Size follows input size at 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP; an explicit avatar size takes precedence.

TextareaOptions.Avatar.zh: 前导头像；显式 Leading 或前导加载图标优先。Avatar.Size 未设置时按输入尺寸使用 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP，显式头像尺寸优先。
TextareaOptions.Avatar.en: Leading avatar, replaced by an explicit Leading icon or leading loader. Unset Avatar.Size follows input size at 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP; an explicit avatar size takes precedence.

InputNumberOptions.Avatar.zh: 前导头像；显式 Leading 或前导加载图标优先。Avatar.Size 未设置时按输入尺寸使用 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP，显式头像尺寸优先。
InputNumberOptions.Avatar.en: Leading avatar, replaced by an explicit Leading icon or leading loader. Unset Avatar.Size follows input size at 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP; an explicit avatar size takes precedence.

InputMenuOptions.Avatar.zh: 前导头像；显式 Leading 或前导加载图标优先。Avatar.Size 未设置时按输入尺寸使用 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP，显式头像尺寸优先。
InputMenuOptions.Avatar.en: Leading avatar, replaced by an explicit Leading icon or leading loader. Unset Avatar.Size follows input size at 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP; an explicit avatar size takes precedence.

InputTagsOptions.Avatar.zh: 前导头像；显式 Leading 或前导加载图标优先。Avatar.Size 未设置时按输入尺寸使用 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP，显式头像尺寸优先。
InputTagsOptions.Avatar.en: Leading avatar, replaced by an explicit Leading icon or leading loader. Unset Avatar.Size follows input size at 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP; an explicit avatar size takes precedence.

InputOptions.Loading.zh: 显示加载图标，输入仍可编辑；需要禁止编辑时另设 Disabled 或 ReadOnly。
InputOptions.Loading.en: Show a loader while allowing editing. Set Disabled or ReadOnly separately to prevent editing.

InputOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置 root、editor、leading、trailing；缺少的部件为零值 Element。通过 editor 绑定持久 Handle；加载颜色使用相应 UI 部件的 Foreground，Style.TextColor 不改变自定义绘制颜色。
InputOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configure root, editor, leading and trailing; absent parts are zero Elements. Bind persistent handles to editor. Set loader colors through the relevant UI part Foreground; Style.TextColor does not change custom drawing colors.

InputOptions.Highlight.zh: 强制显示颜色边框，包含 None 样式；错误状态优先。默认 false。
InputOptions.Highlight.en: Force a colored ring, including the None variant. Errors take priority. Defaults to false.

TextareaOptions.Loading.zh: 显示加载图标，输入仍可编辑；需要禁止编辑时另设 Disabled 或 ReadOnly。
TextareaOptions.Loading.en: Show a loader while allowing editing. Set Disabled or ReadOnly separately to prevent editing.

TextareaOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置 root、editor、leading、trailing；缺少的部件为零值 Element。通过 editor 绑定持久 Handle；加载颜色使用相应 UI 部件的 Foreground，Style.TextColor 不改变自定义绘制颜色。
TextareaOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configure root, editor, leading and trailing; absent parts are zero Elements. Bind persistent handles to editor. Set loader colors through the relevant UI part Foreground; Style.TextColor does not change custom drawing colors.

TextareaOptions.Highlight.zh: 强制显示颜色边框，包含 None 样式；错误状态优先。默认 false。
TextareaOptions.Highlight.en: Force a colored ring, including the None variant. Errors take priority. Defaults to false.

InputDateOptions.Avatar.zh: 没有前缀图标和前缀加载图标时显示头像；默认直径跟随字段图标尺寸。
InputDateOptions.Avatar.en: Shown when there is no leading icon or leading loader; its default diameter follows the field icon size.

InputDateOptions.LoadingTrailing.zh: 将加载图标放到尾部；显式 Leading 仍优先使用前缀加载。
InputDateOptions.LoadingTrailing.en: Places the loader at the trailing edge; an explicit Leading icon keeps loading at the leading edge.

InputTimeOptions.Avatar.zh: 没有前缀图标和前缀加载图标时显示头像；默认直径跟随字段图标尺寸。
InputTimeOptions.Avatar.en: Shown when there is no leading icon or leading loader; its default diameter follows the field icon size.

InputTimeOptions.LoadingTrailing.zh: 将加载图标放到尾部；显式 Leading 仍优先使用前缀加载。
InputTimeOptions.LoadingTrailing.en: Places the loader at the trailing edge; an explicit Leading icon keeps loading at the leading edge.

TextareaOptions.Password.zh: 继承的共享字段；多行输入不支持密码显示，设置后不生效。
TextareaOptions.Password.en: Inherited shared field; multiline input does not support password masking, so this setting has no effect.

TextareaOptions.OnSubmit.zh: 原生多行输入不会自动提交；Enter 和 Shift+Enter 插入换行，不触发此回调。需要提交时使用独立按钮或应用快捷键。
TextareaOptions.OnSubmit.en: Multiline input does not submit automatically. Enter and Shift+Enter insert a line without invoking this callback. Use a separate button or an application shortcut to submit.

TextareaOptions.Rows.zh: 基础行数，≤0 时为 3；关闭 AutoResize 时固定使用该行数。
TextareaOptions.Rows.en: Base rows; ≤0 uses 3. Without AutoResize, this is the fixed visible row count.

TextareaOptions.MaxRows.zh: 仅 AutoResize=true 时生效；≤0 不限，小于 Rows 时按 Rows 处理，达到上限后内部滚动。
TextareaOptions.MaxRows.en: Applies only with AutoResize=true. Values ≤0 are unlimited, values below Rows use Rows, and content scrolls internally at the cap.

FormFieldOptions.Required.zh: 显示标签旁的必填星号，并给绑定控件附加必填说明；无标签时不单独显示星号。此字段不执行校验。
FormFieldOptions.Required.en: Show a required mark beside the label and add a required description to the bound control. Without a label, no isolated mark is drawn. This does not validate values.

FormFieldOptions.Error.zh: 显式错误文字，优先于 Help；为空时可显示已触碰字段的 Form 错误。字符串字段不能表达上游 error=true 的仅强调或 error=false 的隐藏错误。
FormFieldOptions.Error.en: Explicit error text, taking priority over Help. Empty may show the Form error for a touched field. This string cannot express upstream error=true for highlight only or error=false to hide errors.

FormFieldOptions.Orientation.zh: 默认 Vertical；Set(Horizontal) 横向排列并按首行文字基线对齐，Set(Vertical) 明确恢复纵向。
FormFieldOptions.Orientation.en: Defaults to Vertical. Set(Horizontal) aligns the regions by their first text baseline; Set(Vertical) explicitly restores vertical layout.

FormFieldOptions.Hint.zh: 标签右侧提示；原生也允许没有 Label 时独立显示。
FormFieldOptions.Hint.en: Hint beside the label. The native field also allows a hint without Label.

FormFieldOptions.UI.zh: Root 为整个字段，Header 为标签、Hint 和 Description 区域，Body 为控件及帮助/错误区域；Label、Description、Hint、Help、Error 分别配置对应内容。
FormFieldOptions.UI.en: Root styles the whole field; Header contains label, hint and description; Body contains controls and help/error text. Label, Description, Hint, Help and Error style their respective content.

SliderOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；Neutral 使用 InvertedBackground。FormField 错误优先使用 Error，显式 UI.Indicator.Background 仍可覆盖。
SliderOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary; Neutral uses InvertedBackground. FormField errors select Error, while explicit UI.Indicator.Background can still override it.

SliderOptions.Step.zh: 0 使用步长 1；必须非负且有限。用户操作按相对 Min 的步长取值，并按 Min 和 Step 的十进制精度消除浮点尾数。
SliderOptions.Step.en: Zero uses step 1; values must be finite and nonnegative. User actions snap relative to Min and remove floating-point tails at the decimal precision of Min and Step.

SliderOptions.Tooltip.zh: 默认 false；悬停滑块或聚焦时立即显示数值，Escape 隐藏，离开悬停和焦点后可重新显示。布尔字段不接受 TooltipOptions，也不继承 ComponentTooltip 的部件样式。
SliderOptions.Tooltip.en: Defaults to false. Immediately show a value on thumb hover or focus. Escape hides it until hover and focus leave. This boolean does not accept TooltipOptions or inherit ComponentTooltip part styles.

SliderOptions.UI.zh: Root 配置外层；Indicator.Background 配置选中轨道和圆点边框，Thumb.Background 配置圆点填色。其他 Indicator / Thumb 样式字段不生效；普通轨道颜色来自 Theme.Accented。
SliderOptions.UI.en: Root styles the outer element. Indicator.Background colors the selected track and thumb ring; Thumb.Background colors the thumb fill. Other Indicator / Thumb fields are unused; the unfilled track uses Theme.Accented.

SliderOptions.Style.zh: 同步接收 Root 元素；轨道和圆点通过绘图回调绘制，没有独立的 Indicator / Thumb Element。不要保存构建期 Element。
SliderOptions.Style.en: Synchronously receives the Root element. Track and thumbs use custom painting and have no separate Indicator / Thumb Elements. Do not retain build-time Elements.

SliderOptions.OnCommit.zh: 有变化的键盘操作或拖拽结束时通知一次；禁用组件或其父级会取消拖拽，不提交。普通受控重建不通知。
SliderOptions.OnCommit.en: Notify once after a changed keyboard action or drag completion. Disabling the control or its parent cancels the drag without committing. Ordinary controlled rebuilds do not notify.

RangeSliderOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；Neutral 使用 InvertedBackground。FormField 错误优先使用 Error，显式 UI.Indicator.Background 仍可覆盖。
RangeSliderOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary; Neutral uses InvertedBackground. FormField errors select Error, while explicit UI.Indicator.Background can still override it.

RangeSliderOptions.Step.zh: 0 使用步长 1；必须非负且有限。用户操作按相对 Min 的步长取值，并按 Min 和 Step 的十进制精度消除浮点尾数。
RangeSliderOptions.Step.en: Zero uses step 1; values must be finite and nonnegative. User actions snap relative to Min and remove floating-point tails at the decimal precision of Min and Step.

RangeSliderOptions.Tooltip.zh: 默认 false；悬停滑块或聚焦时立即显示数值，Escape 隐藏，离开悬停和焦点后可重新显示。布尔字段不接受 TooltipOptions，也不继承 ComponentTooltip 的部件样式。
RangeSliderOptions.Tooltip.en: Defaults to false. Immediately show a value on thumb hover or focus. Escape hides it until hover and focus leave. This boolean does not accept TooltipOptions or inherit ComponentTooltip part styles.

RangeSliderOptions.UI.zh: Root 配置外层；Indicator.Background 配置选中轨道和圆点边框，Thumb.Background 配置圆点填色。其他 Indicator / Thumb 样式字段不生效；普通轨道颜色来自 Theme.Accented。
RangeSliderOptions.UI.en: Root styles the outer element. Indicator.Background colors the selected track and thumb ring; Thumb.Background colors the thumb fill. Other Indicator / Thumb fields are unused; the unfilled track uses Theme.Accented.

RangeSliderOptions.Style.zh: 同步接收 Root 元素；轨道和圆点通过绘图回调绘制，没有独立的 Indicator / Thumb Element。不要保存构建期 Element。
RangeSliderOptions.Style.en: Synchronously receives the Root element. Track and thumbs use custom painting and have no separate Indicator / Thumb Elements. Do not retain build-time Elements.

RangeSliderOptions.OnCommit.zh: 有变化的键盘操作或拖拽结束时通知一次；禁用组件或其父级会取消拖拽，不提交。普通受控重建不通知。
RangeSliderOptions.OnCommit.en: Notify once after a changed keyboard action or drag completion. Disabling the control or its parent cancels the drag without committing. Ordinary controlled rebuilds do not notify.

SliderOptions.Label.zh: 显式名称优先，其次使用 FormField 标签；都为空时使用本地化的 Slider / 滑块，不绘制可见文字。
SliderOptions.Label.en: Explicit accessible name, then the FormField label. If both are empty, use localized Slider text. This does not draw a visible label.

SliderOptions.Min.zh: 未设置时为 0，Set(0) 为显式 0；必须有限且小于 Max。
SliderOptions.Min.en: Unset uses 0; Set(0) is explicit zero. Must be finite and less than Max.

SliderOptions.Max.zh: 未设置时为 100，显式 0 可用于负数范围；必须有限且大于 Min。
SliderOptions.Max.en: Unset uses 100. Explicit zero works with a negative range. Must be finite and greater than Min.

RangeSliderOptions.Min.zh: 范围下界，默认 0。Min 和 Max 都为 0 时使用 0–100；两者必须有限且 Max>Min。
RangeSliderOptions.Min.en: Lower bound, default 0. When Min and Max are both zero, use 0–100. Both must be finite with Max>Min.

RangeSliderOptions.Max.zh: 范围上界；Min 和 Max 同为 0 时回退为 100，其他情况下 0 是实际边界值。
RangeSliderOptions.Max.en: Upper bound. Falls back to 100 only when both Min and Max are zero; otherwise zero is the actual bound.

RangeSliderOptions.MinStepsBetweenThumbs.zh: 最小距离为 Step × 步数；默认 0，负数按 0 处理。超过整个范围会 panic；不满足间隔的操作被拒绝，不触发变更或提交。
RangeSliderOptions.MinStepsBetweenThumbs.en: Minimum distance is Step times this count. Defaults to 0 and negative counts use 0. A gap larger than the range panics; rejected moves do not report changes or commits.

SelectOptions.Leading.zh: 触发器前置图标，优先于 Avatar；加载时由前置加载图标替换。
SelectOptions.Leading.en: Leading trigger SVG, ahead of Avatar; replaced by the leading loader during loading.

SelectOptions.Trailing.zh: 触发器尾部图标，未设置时为 ChevronDown；尾部加载会替换它。
SelectOptions.Trailing.en: Trailing trigger SVG, default ChevronDown; trailing loading replaces it.

SelectOptions.Avatar.zh: 没有前置图标或前置加载图标时显示的头像。未指定头像 Size 时采用输入图标尺寸。
SelectOptions.Avatar.en: Avatar when no leading icon or loader is active. Unset avatar Size follows the input icon size.

SelectOptions.Loading.zh: 显示加载图标，不禁用选择；禁止操作时同时设置 Disabled。
SelectOptions.Loading.en: Shows a loader without disabling selection. Set Disabled to block interaction.

SelectOptions.LoadingTrailing.zh: 默认 false，加载显示在前侧。true 时移到尾部；显式 Leading 仍优先使用前侧加载。
SelectOptions.LoadingTrailing.en: Default false places loading at the leading side. True moves it to the trailing side unless Leading is explicitly provided.

SelectOptions.LoadingIcon.zh: 加载时的 SVG，默认 LoaderCircle；继承所在 Leading 或 Trailing 部件的颜色。
SelectOptions.LoadingIcon.en: Loading SVG, default LoaderCircle, using the active Leading or Trailing part foreground.

SelectOptions.SelectedIcon.zh: 选项选中标记，默认 Check；单选和多选使用同一配置。
SelectOptions.SelectedIcon.en: Selected item marker, default Check, shared by single and multiple selection.

SelectOptions.Highlight.zh: 失焦时也显示当前颜色的边框，包括 None 样式；错误边框优先。
SelectOptions.Highlight.en: Keeps the colored border when unfocused, including None. Invalid state takes precedence.

SelectOptions.Open.zh: 可选的持久 bool 指针；应用赋值或组件操作都会更新打开状态。nil 使用内部状态。开关本身不触发 OnChange。
SelectOptions.Open.en: Optional persistent bool pointer, writable by the application and component. Nil uses internal state. Opening and closing do not call OnChange.

SelectOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户操作实际改变选择时通知一次。外部赋值、相同单选值及开关面板不通知。
SelectOptions.OnChange.en: Called once when a user changes selection, not for external assignments, reselecting the same single value or toggling the popup.

SelectOptions.Popup.zh: 面板位置、宽高、偏移、关闭策略和样式。默认底部起点、偏移 8 DIP、最大高 240 DIP，至少与触发器同宽。MatchAnchor 固定启用；单选不使用 Mode / OpenDelay / CloseDelay，多选保留 SelectMenu 的原生悬停扩展。
SelectOptions.Popup.en: Panel placement, dimensions, offset, dismissal and styling. Defaults to bottom start, 8 DIP offset, maximum height 240 DIP and at least the trigger width. MatchAnchor is forced on. Single Select ignores Mode / OpenDelay / CloseDelay; multiple selection retains the SelectMenu native hover extension.

InputMenuOptions.Open.zh: 可选的持久打开状态。nil 使用内部状态，外部打开会聚焦输入；禁用或只读时关闭。
InputMenuOptions.Open.en: Optional persistent open state. Nil uses internal state; external opening focuses the input. Disabled or read-only closes it.

InputMenuOptions.OpenOnClick.zh: 默认 false。点击只聚焦，输入、方向键或尾部按钮打开；显式 true 允许点击打开。SearchSelect 保留旧的 true。
InputMenuOptions.OpenOnClick.en: Default false. Clicking focuses; typing, arrows or the trailing button open. Explicit true enables click-to-open. SearchSelect keeps its legacy true.

InputMenuOptions.OpenOnFocus.zh: 默认 false；true 时首次聚焦打开，仍受只读和禁用限制。
InputMenuOptions.OpenOnFocus.en: Default false. True opens on entering focus, subject to disabled and read-only state.

InputMenuOptions.Loop.zh: 默认 false，方向键在首尾停止；true 循环并跳过禁用项。
InputMenuOptions.Loop.en: Default false stops arrows at either end; true wraps and skips disabled items.

InputMenuOptions.HighlightOnHover.zh: 默认 true。false 时指针移入不改变高亮，仍可点击选项。
InputMenuOptions.HighlightOnHover.en: Default true. False prevents hover from moving the highlight while clicks still select.

InputMenuOptions.ResetModelValueOnClear.zh: 默认 true，清空按钮同时重置选中值；false 保留选中值并清空草稿。Autocomplete 不使用此字段。普通文字删除不会清除选中 ID。
InputMenuOptions.ResetModelValueOnClear.en: Default true resets selection with the clear button; false clears only the draft. Not used by Autocomplete. Deleting typed text does not clear selected IDs.

InputMenuOptions.SelectedIcon.zh: 普通模式的选中项图标，默认 Check；Autocomplete 不显示选中标记。
InputMenuOptions.SelectedIcon.en: Selected-item SVG, default Check, omitted in Autocomplete mode.

InputMenuOptions.DeleteIcon.zh: 多选标签删除图标，默认 X；单选和 Autocomplete 不使用。
InputMenuOptions.DeleteIcon.en: Tag removal SVG, default X; unused in single selection and Autocomplete.

InputMenuOptions.ClearIcon.zh: 清空按钮 SVG，默认 X。已有选中值时，草稿为空也能清空。
InputMenuOptions.ClearIcon.en: Clear button SVG, default X. A selected model can be cleared even with an empty draft.

InputMenuOptions.ResetSearchTermOnSelect.zh: 默认 true；单选回填标签，多选清空草稿。Autocomplete 始终回填选中的建议文字，忽略此字段。
InputMenuOptions.ResetSearchTermOnSelect.en: Default true restores the selected label or clears a multiple draft. Autocomplete always fills the chosen suggestion and ignores this option.

InputMenuOptions.Popup.zh: 定位、宽高、偏移及关闭策略。默认最大高 240 DIP、至少与输入框同宽。MatchAnchor 固定启用；Mode、OpenDelay、CloseDelay 不使用。Dismissible=false 保持列表和输入焦点，显式 Open=false 仍可关闭。
InputMenuOptions.Popup.en: Placement, size, offset and dismissal. Default maximum height is 240 DIP and minimum width matches the input. MatchAnchor is forced on; Mode and delays are unused. Dismissible=false retains the list and input focus, while explicit Open=false can close it.

PopoverOptions.Mode.zh: 默认 PopoverClick，开关由锚点动作修改持久状态；PopoverHover 按悬停或键盘焦点自动开关。非法枚举会 panic。
PopoverOptions.Mode.en: Default PopoverClick leaves toggling to the anchor action; PopoverHover follows hover or keyboard focus. Invalid modes panic.

ScrollAreaOptions.Direction.zh: 默认纵向；横向自动使用行布局，双向使用列布局。不识别的值沿用纵向。
ScrollAreaOptions.Direction.en: Default vertical; horizontal uses a row and both-axis uses a column. Unknown values fall back to vertical.

ScrollAreaOptions.State.zh: 可选持久 ui.ScrollState。独立实例使用独立状态；读取或设置 X / Y，MaxX / MaxY 由布局计算，超界值被限制。
ScrollAreaOptions.State.en: Optional persistent ui.ScrollState, one per instance. Read or set X / Y; layout computes MaxX / MaxY and clamps out-of-range values.

ScrollAreaOptions.ScrollbarWidth.zh: 原生扩展，默认 6 DIP。未设置或小于等于 0 都使用默认宽度；拖动时额外加宽 2 DIP。
ScrollAreaOptions.ScrollbarWidth.en: Native extension, default 6 DIP. Unset or nonpositive uses the default; dragging widens the thumb by another 2 DIP.

ScrollAreaOptions.ScrollbarColor.zh: 原生扩展，默认 BorderAccented；显式透明只隐藏绘制，不移除滚动条命中区域。
ScrollAreaOptions.ScrollbarColor.en: Native extension, default BorderAccented. Explicit transparency hides drawing without removing the scrollbar hit region.

ScrollAreaOptions.UI.zh: Root 控制外层视口和圆角裁剪，Body 控制实际滚动容器及内容内边距、间距。
ScrollAreaOptions.UI.en: Root styles the wrapper viewport and rounded clipping; Body styles the actual scroll container, content padding and gap.

TooltipOptions.DelayDuration.zh: 未设置时使用 600ms；显式 0 或负值立即显示。仅控制悬停，键盘聚焦立即显示；连续提示保留 400ms 快速切换窗口。参数编辑器以毫秒输入。
TooltipOptions.DelayDuration.en: Unset uses 600ms; explicit zero or a negative value shows immediately. Hover only; keyboard focus is immediate. Consecutive tips keep a 400ms warm-switch window. The editor accepts milliseconds.

TooltipOptions.MaxWidth.zh: 默认 320 DIP。文字单行省略，快捷键保持自身宽度；过小的最大宽度可能无法容纳全部快捷键。
TooltipOptions.MaxWidth.en: Defaults to 320 DIP. Text truncates on one line; keys keep their own width. Very small widths may not fit every key.

TooltipOptions.Open.zh: 可选持久布尔指针，初始 true 可直接打开；悬停、键盘焦点、点击、失焦和 Escape 同步写回。外部 false 抑制当前悬停或焦点下的重开。
TooltipOptions.Open.en: Optional persistent boolean pointer. Initial true opens directly; hover, keyboard focus, presses, blur and Escape update it. External false suppresses reopening for the current hover or focus.

TooltipOptions.Kbds.zh: 按平台格式化的快捷键，默认 SM、间距 2 DIP；仅快捷键时也可显示，并追加到锚点 Description。不会注册快捷键动作。
TooltipOptions.Kbds.en: Platform-formatted keys, SM by default and 2 DIP apart. Keys-only tooltips are valid and also describe the anchor. No shortcut action is registered.

TooltipOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用时关闭并将 Open 写为 false。无文字且无快捷键、无效锚点或禁用锚点也会关闭。
TooltipOptions.Disabled.en: Closes and writes false to Open. Empty text plus empty keys, an invalid anchor or a disabled anchor also closes.

TooltipOptions.Placement.zh: 未设置时下方居中；支持 12 个位置，顶底的 Start/End 随阅读方向变化。窗口边界处理使用 MyGo AttachTo。
TooltipOptions.Placement.en: BottomCenter when unset. Supports 12 placements; top/bottom Start and End follow reading direction. MyGo AttachTo handles window edges.

TooltipOptions.Offset.zh: 默认 8 DIP，可显式设为 0；仅默认值跟随主题间距比例。
TooltipOptions.Offset.en: Defaults to 8 DIP and accepts explicit zero. Only the default follows theme spacing scale.

TooltipOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Panel、Label、Trailing；Trailing 为快捷键及分隔点容器，Panel.Gap 控制正文与该容器的间距。
TooltipOptions.UI.en: Supports Panel, Label and Trailing. Trailing contains keys and the separator; Panel.Gap separates it from the text.

TooltipOptions.Style.zh: 在各部件样式合并后同步调用，可配置 Panel、Label、Trailing。
TooltipOptions.Style.en: Runs synchronously after part-style merging for Panel, Label and Trailing.

ModalOptions.Transition.zh: 默认 true；false 立即显示。Modal 关闭始终立即完成，Slideover 关闭时也会跳过过渡。恢复 true 不重播已经完成的入场。
ModalOptions.Transition.en: Defaults to true. False shows immediately; Modal always unmounts immediately on close, and Slideover also skips its exit. Re-enabling does not replay a completed entrance.

ModalOptions.Close.zh: 可选关闭按钮配置，默认 MD / Neutral / Ghost。CloseButton=false 时不创建按钮；禁用或加载状态阻止按钮关闭。
ModalOptions.Close.en: Optional close-button options, defaulting to MD / Neutral / Ghost. CloseButton=false omits it; disabled or loading states prevent button dismissal.

ModalOptions.CloseIcon.zh: 默认 X；仅 Close.Leading 未指定时生效。
ModalOptions.CloseIcon.en: Defaults to X and applies only when Close.Leading is unset.

ModalOptions.OnClosePrevent.zh: Dismissible=false 时，Escape 或外部点击被阻止后调用一次；关闭按钮和应用直接修改 open 不触发。
ModalOptions.OnClosePrevent.en: Called once when Dismissible=false blocks Escape or an outside click. The close button and direct application state changes do not trigger it.

ModalOptions.OnClose.zh: 组件关闭按钮、允许的 Escape 或外部点击关闭时调用一次。应用直接修改 open、Footer 自行关闭不触发。
ModalOptions.OnClose.en: Called once for the close button or allowed Escape/outside dismissal. Direct application changes to open and custom Footer actions do not trigger it.

ModalOptions.CloseLabel.zh: 关闭按钮的可访问名称；优先于 Close.AccessibleLabel，均为空时使用本地化关闭名称。
ModalOptions.CloseLabel.en: Accessible close-button name, overriding Close.AccessibleLabel. Empty values use the localized close label.

ModalOptions.Header.zh: 替换标题与说明的内容区；关闭按钮仍按 CloseButton 创建，与上游整体 header 插槽替换不同。
ModalOptions.Header.en: Replaces the title/description content area; the CloseButton remains independently controlled, unlike replacing the complete upstream header slot.

ModalOptions.Overlay.zh: 默认 true；false 隐藏遮罩背景，保留模态焦点限制和外部点击关闭策略。Backdrop 显式样式仍可覆盖颜色。
ModalOptions.Overlay.en: Defaults to true. False hides the backdrop color while retaining modal focus and outside-dismissal policy. Explicit Backdrop styles can still override the color.

SlideoverOptions.Transition.zh: 默认 true；false 立即显示。Modal 关闭始终立即完成，Slideover 关闭时也会跳过过渡。恢复 true 不重播已经完成的入场。
SlideoverOptions.Transition.en: Defaults to true. False shows immediately; Modal always unmounts immediately on close, and Slideover also skips its exit. Re-enabling does not replay a completed entrance.

SlideoverOptions.Close.zh: 可选关闭按钮配置，默认 MD / Neutral / Ghost。CloseButton=false 时不创建按钮；禁用或加载状态阻止按钮关闭。
SlideoverOptions.Close.en: Optional close-button options, defaulting to MD / Neutral / Ghost. CloseButton=false omits it; disabled or loading states prevent button dismissal.

SlideoverOptions.CloseIcon.zh: 默认 X；仅 Close.Leading 未指定时生效。
SlideoverOptions.CloseIcon.en: Defaults to X and applies only when Close.Leading is unset.

SlideoverOptions.OnClosePrevent.zh: Dismissible=false 时，Escape 或外部点击被阻止后调用一次；关闭按钮和应用直接修改 open 不触发。
SlideoverOptions.OnClosePrevent.en: Called once when Dismissible=false blocks Escape or an outside click. The close button and direct application state changes do not trigger it.

SlideoverOptions.OnClose.zh: 组件关闭按钮、允许的 Escape 或外部点击关闭时调用一次。应用直接修改 open、Footer 自行关闭不触发。
SlideoverOptions.OnClose.en: Called once for the close button or allowed Escape/outside dismissal. Direct application changes to open and custom Footer actions do not trigger it.

SlideoverOptions.CloseLabel.zh: 关闭按钮的可访问名称；优先于 Close.AccessibleLabel，均为空时使用本地化关闭名称。
SlideoverOptions.CloseLabel.en: Accessible close-button name, overriding Close.AccessibleLabel. Empty values use the localized close label.

SlideoverOptions.Header.zh: 替换标题与说明的内容区；关闭按钮仍按 CloseButton 创建，与上游整体 header 插槽替换不同。
SlideoverOptions.Header.en: Replaces the title/description content area; the CloseButton remains independently controlled, unlike replacing the complete upstream header slot.

SlideoverOptions.Overlay.zh: 默认 true；false 隐藏遮罩背景，保留模态焦点限制和外部点击关闭策略。Backdrop 显式样式仍可覆盖颜色。
SlideoverOptions.Overlay.en: Defaults to true. False hides the backdrop color while retaining modal focus and outside-dismissal policy. Explicit Backdrop styles can still override the color.

DrawerOptions.Transition.zh: 默认 true，出入场沿用 Slideover 的 200 毫秒过渡；false 或减少动态效果时跳过，吸附高度即时切换。
DrawerOptions.Transition.en: Defaults to true with Slideover’s 200 ms entrance/exit. False or reduced motion skips it; snap heights change immediately.

DrawerOptions.Close.zh: 关闭按钮配置，默认 MD / Neutral / Ghost；非空时隐式启用，CloseButton=false 可隐藏。
DrawerOptions.Close.en: Close-button options, default MD/Neutral/Ghost. A non-nil value enables the button unless CloseButton=false.

DrawerOptions.CloseIcon.zh: 默认 X；仅 Close.Leading 未指定时生效。
DrawerOptions.CloseIcon.en: Defaults to X and applies only when Close.Leading is unset.
