DrawerOptions.OnClosePrevent.zh: Dismissible=false 阻止关闭拖拽、Escape 或外部点击时通知一次；手柄仍可调整停靠位置。
DrawerOptions.OnClosePrevent.en: Called once when Dismissible=false prevents a closing drag, Escape or outside click. The handle can still adjust snap position.

DrawerOptions.OnClose.zh: 允许的拖拽、Escape、外部点击和关闭按钮触发一次；应用直接修改 Open 或自定义 Done 不通知。
DrawerOptions.OnClose.en: Called once for allowed drag, Escape, outside or close-button dismissal. Direct Open changes and custom Done actions are silent.

DrawerOptions.CloseLabel.zh: 关闭按钮的可访问名称；优先于 Close.AccessibleLabel，均为空时使用本地化关闭名称。
DrawerOptions.CloseLabel.en: Accessible close-button name, overriding Close.AccessibleLabel. Empty values use the localized close label.

DrawerOptions.Header.zh: 替换标题与说明，独立手柄仍由 Handle 控制，关闭按钮仍由 CloseButton 控制。
DrawerOptions.Header.en: Replaces title/description; Handle and CloseButton independently control the handle and close button.

DrawerOptions.Overlay.zh: 默认 true；false 隐藏遮罩背景，保留模态焦点限制和外部点击关闭策略。Backdrop 显式样式仍可覆盖颜色。
DrawerOptions.Overlay.en: Defaults to true. False hides the backdrop color while retaining modal focus and outside-dismissal policy. Explicit Backdrop styles can still override the color.

ModalOptions.UI.zh: 部件为 Backdrop、Panel、Header、Label、Description、Close、Body、Footer。Panel.Gap 分隔实际区域，默认 0；正文默认独立滚动。
ModalOptions.UI.en: Parts: Backdrop, Panel, Header, Label, Description, Close, Body and Footer. Panel.Gap separates actual regions and defaults to zero; the body scrolls independently.

ModalOptions.MaxHeight.zh: 默认窗口高度减 64 DIP；显式值进一步限制高度。Fullscreen 忽略该限制。标题和 Footer 过高时正文可用空间会缩小。
ModalOptions.MaxHeight.en: Defaults to window height minus 64 DIP; explicit values further constrain it. Fullscreen ignores the limit. Tall headers and footers reduce the body space.

SlideoverOptions.Inset.zh: 默认 false；true 在四周保留 16 DIP（随主题间距比例）并使用 8 DIP 圆角。Extent 在减去边距后限制到可用空间，退出位移包含边距。
SlideoverOptions.Inset.en: Defaults to false. True adds a 16 DIP margin scaled by theme spacing and 8 DIP corners. Extent is clamped after margins; exit displacement includes them.

SlideoverOptions.Extent.zh: 左右默认 448 DIP；上下未设置时按内容高度。显式 0 保持 0，负值按 0，超过窗口可用空间时截断。空正文仍创建带内边距的 Body。
SlideoverOptions.Extent.en: Left/right default to 448 DIP; top/bottom fit content when unset. Explicit zero stays zero; negatives clamp to zero, and oversized values clamp to available space. Empty content still creates a padded Body.

SlideoverOptions.Width.zh: 继承字段，Slideover 不读取；位置和尺寸由 Side、Extent、Inset 决定。
SlideoverOptions.Width.en: Inherited but unused by Slideover; Side, Extent and Inset determine placement and size.

SlideoverOptions.MaxHeight.zh: 继承字段，Slideover 不读取；位置和尺寸由 Side、Extent、Inset 决定。
SlideoverOptions.MaxHeight.en: Inherited but unused by Slideover; Side, Extent and Inset determine placement and size.

SlideoverOptions.Fullscreen.zh: 继承字段，Slideover 不读取；位置和尺寸由 Side、Extent、Inset 决定。
SlideoverOptions.Fullscreen.en: Inherited but unused by Slideover; Side, Extent and Inset determine placement and size.

SlideoverOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Backdrop、Panel、Header、Label、Description、Close、Body、Footer。Backdrop 背景覆盖参与入退场淡化；最终 Style 可继续覆盖。Backdrop.Opacity 也会影响其子面板。
SlideoverOptions.UI.en: Supports Backdrop, Panel, Header, Label, Description, Close, Body and Footer. Backdrop background overrides fade on enter/exit; final Style can override them. Backdrop.Opacity also affects its child panel.

ToastOptions.ID.zh: 空值自动生成；同 ID 替换内容和配置、重置时长，不调用旧项 OnClose。返回值可交给 CloseToast。
ToastOptions.ID.en: Empty generates an ID. The same ID replaces content/configuration and resets the timeout without calling the previous OnClose. Pass the returned ID to CloseToast.

ToastOptions.Timeout.zh: 默认 5 秒：0 使用默认值，负值常驻。与 Nuxt UI duration=0 表示常驻不同。悬停，或窗口有焦点时通知内的焦点，会暂停整个队列；窗口在后台或隐藏时计时继续。
ToastOptions.Timeout.en: Zero uses the five-second default; negative values persist. This differs from Nuxt UI duration=0. Hover, or focus in the viewport while the window has focus, pauses the whole queue; it keeps running while the window is in the background or hidden.

ToastOptions.Avatar.zh: 可选头像，优先于 Icon。未设置 Size 时直径 44 DIP，显式尺寸沿用 Avatar。发布时复制配置及 UI。
ToastOptions.Avatar.en: Optional avatar preceding Icon. Unset Size gives a 44 DIP diameter; explicit sizes use Avatar sizing. Configuration and UI are copied at publication.

ToastOptions.Icon.zh: 默认不显示图标；设置 Avatar 时使用头像。图标默认 20 DIP，并随文字比例变化。
ToastOptions.Icon.en: No icon by default. Avatar takes precedence. Icons are 20 DIP by default and follow text scaling.

ToastOptions.Close.zh: 默认 true；false 隐藏关闭按钮，不改变超时、Escape 或动作关闭。按钮配置使用 CloseOptions。
ToastOptions.Close.en: Defaults to true. False hides the close button without changing timeout, Escape or action dismissal. Configure the button through CloseOptions.

ToastOptions.CloseOptions.zh: 可选按钮配置，默认 MD / Neutral / Link，默认去掉内边距。AccessibleLabel 未设置时关闭名称随当前语言变化；发布时复制配置。
ToastOptions.CloseOptions.en: Optional button configuration, defaulting to MD / Neutral / Link with no padding. An unset AccessibleLabel follows the current locale. Configuration is copied when published.

ToastOptions.CloseIcon.zh: 默认 X；显式 CloseOptions.Leading 优先。
ToastOptions.CloseIcon.en: Defaults to X; explicit CloseOptions.Leading takes precedence.

ToastOptions.Progress.zh: 默认 true；常驻通知不显示倒计时条。减少动态效果时仍定时更新数值，但不插值。
ToastOptions.Progress.en: Defaults to true. Persistent notices omit the countdown bar. Reduced motion still updates the value periodically without interpolation.

ToastOptions.ProgressOptions.zh: 配置倒计时颜色和 Progress 部件 UI；默认颜色继承通知，尺寸固定 SM。
ToastOptions.ProgressOptions.en: Configures countdown color and Progress part UI. Color inherits the toast by default; size is fixed to SM.

ToastProgressOptions.Color.zh: 未设置时继承通知颜色，显式 Neutral 使用 Progress 的反色进度。
ToastProgressOptions.Color.en: Inherits the toast color when unset; explicit Neutral uses the progress component’s inverted fill.

ToastProgressOptions.UI.zh: 传给 Progress 的 Root / Indicator 样式；Indicator.Background 可覆盖进度颜色。发布时复制。
ToastProgressOptions.UI.en: Root / Indicator styles passed to Progress. Indicator.Background overrides the fill color. Copied when published.

ToastOptions.Orientation.zh: 默认 Vertical：动作位于正文下方，间距 10 DIP。Horizontal 将文字与操作垂直居中排列。更新方向时保留已聚焦动作。
ToastOptions.Orientation.en: Defaults to Vertical, placing actions below text with a 10 DIP gap. Horizontal centers text and actions vertically. Replacing the orientation retains the focused action.

ToastOptions.Action.zh: 兼容的单动作文字，执行 OnAction 后关闭；可与 Actions 同时使用，排在其前面。
ToastOptions.Action.en: Legacy single-action label. Runs OnAction then closes; it may coexist with Actions and appears before them.

ToastOptions.OnAction.zh: 仅对应单个 Action；Actions 列表项使用自己的 OnAction。
ToastOptions.OnAction.en: Applies only to the single Action; entries in Actions use their own OnAction.

ToastOptions.OnClose.zh: 到期、关闭按钮、Escape、自动关闭动作或 CloseToast 时调用一次；同 ID 替换不调用旧回调。
ToastOptions.OnClose.en: Called once on timeout, close, Escape, closing actions or CloseToast. Same-ID replacement does not invoke the old callback.

ToastOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Panel、Body、Leading、Label、Description、Actions、Close。Actions 配置动作容器；单个按钮使用 ToastActionOptions.UI。Root 属于 ToastViewport。
ToastOptions.UI.en: Supports Panel, Body, Leading, Label, Description, Actions and Close. Actions styles the action container; individual buttons use ToastActionOptions.UI. Root belongs to ToastViewport.

ToastActionOptions.ID.zh: 可选稳定标识，非空时在同一通知内必须唯一。重排时使用 ID 保留按钮焦点；省略时按静态列表位置识别。原生扩展。
ToastActionOptions.ID.en: Optional stable ID, unique when nonempty within a notice. Use it to retain button focus during reordering; omitted IDs use static list positions. A native extension.

ToastActionOptions.Close.zh: 默认 true，动作执行后关闭；false 可保留通知。
ToastActionOptions.Close.en: Defaults to true and closes after the action; false keeps the notice open.

ToastViewportOptions.Position.zh: 默认右下，支持六个物理位置；RTL 不交换左右。顶部最新项在最上方，底部最新项在最下方。
ToastViewportOptions.Position.en: Defaults to bottom-right across six physical positions; RTL does not swap sides. Newest notices are nearest the selected top or bottom edge.

ToastViewportOptions.Width.zh: 默认 384 DIP，再限制到视口扣除内边距后的可用宽度。
ToastViewportOptions.Width.en: Defaults to 384 DIP, further constrained by the viewport width after padding.

ToastViewportOptions.Limit.zh: 1–3 有效，0、负数或大于 3 使用 3。仅限制可见项；隐藏项仍计时，也可能在较新通知关闭后重新显示。
ToastViewportOptions.Limit.en: Accepts 1–3; zero, negative values and values above three use three. Limits visible items only. Hidden notices still time out and may return after newer ones close.

ToastViewportOptions.UI.zh: 仅 Root，控制整个视口的内边距、间距等；不配置单条通知。
ToastViewportOptions.UI.en: Root only, controlling viewport padding and spacing rather than individual notices.

ToastViewportOptions.Style.zh: 样式合并后同步配置 Root；元素只在当前构建有效。
ToastViewportOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures Root after style merging. The element is valid only for the current build.

MenuOptions.Label.zh: 菜单面板的无障碍名称；不显示为标题。
MenuOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the menu panel; not a visible heading.

MenuOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD，继承组件主题；XS–XL 同时调整项目、分组、头像、图标和快捷键尺寸。
MenuOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD with component-theme inheritance. XS–XL sizes rows, headings, avatars, icons and keyboard badges.

MenuOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用菜单并关闭当前面板；DropdownMenu 同时禁用锚点，ContextMenu 保留锚点自身功能。外部变化不触发 OnOpenChange。
MenuOptions.Disabled.en: Disables and closes the menu. DropdownMenu also disables its anchor; ContextMenu preserves the target’s own behavior. External changes do not emit OnOpenChange.

MenuOptions.Loop.zh: 默认 false，方向键在首尾停止；true 时循环并跳过禁用项。
MenuOptions.Loop.en: Defaults to false: arrows stop at the ends. True wraps and skips disabled items.

MenuOptions.CheckedIcon.zh: 选中指示图标，默认 Check；适用于 Checked=true 的菜单项。
MenuOptions.CheckedIcon.en: Checked indicator, default Check; applies to items with Checked=true.

MenuOptions.LoadingIcon.zh: 加载图标，默认 LoaderCircle；优先于项目 Icon 和 Avatar，减少动态效果时不旋转。
MenuOptions.LoadingIcon.en: Loading icon, default LoaderCircle. Takes priority over item Icon and Avatar; rotation stops under reduced motion.

MenuOptions.Width.zh: 未设置时按内容宽度，至少 128 DIP；指定值仍受最小宽度及窗口边界限制。
MenuOptions.Width.en: Unset uses content width with a 128 DIP minimum. Explicit width remains subject to the minimum and window bounds.

MenuOptions.MaxHeight.zh: 默认 320 DIP，限制到窗口高度减 24 DIP；长菜单滚动。显式 0 收起可见内容。
MenuOptions.MaxHeight.en: Defaults to 320 DIP and is capped at window height minus 24 DIP. Long menus scroll; explicit zero collapses visible content.

MenuOptions.Placement.zh: DropdownMenu 根菜单默认 BottomStart，ContextMenu 默认 RightStart；子菜单按阅读方向向外打开。ContextMenu 的位置覆盖为原生扩展。
MenuOptions.Placement.en: DropdownMenu roots default to BottomStart and ContextMenu roots to RightStart. Submenus open outward with text direction. ContextMenu placement overrides are a native extension.

MenuOptions.Offset.zh: 根间隔：DropdownMenu 默认 8 DIP，ContextMenu 默认 2 DIP；子菜单默认 3 DIP，显式 0 不留间隔。
MenuOptions.Offset.en: Root gap defaults to 8 DIP for DropdownMenu and 2 DIP for ContextMenu. Submenus default to 3 DIP; explicit zero removes the gap.

MenuOptions.Filter.zh: 默认 false；开启后显示原生筛选输入，初次打开根菜单时聚焦输入。子级通过 Content.Filter 单独启用。
MenuOptions.Filter.en: Defaults to false. Shows a native filter input and focuses it when the root opens. Enable child inputs separately with Content.Filter.

MenuOptions.FilterFields.zh: 默认仅 label；支持 label、description、id、shortcut，使用不区分大小写的包含匹配并保留原顺序。
MenuOptions.FilterFields.en: Defaults to label. Supports label, description, id and shortcut, using case-insensitive substring matching and preserving order.

MenuOptions.IgnoreFilter.zh: Filter=true 时保留完整传入列表，由应用结合查询自行过滤。
MenuOptions.IgnoreFilter.en: With Filter=true, keeps the supplied list unchanged so the application can filter it.

MenuOptions.SearchTerm.zh: 可选的持久查询指针；nil 使用 MenuState.Query。外部赋值不触发搜索变化通知。
MenuOptions.SearchTerm.en: Optional persistent query pointer; nil uses MenuState.Query. External assignments do not emit search-change notifications.

MenuOptions.FilterInput.zh: 可选 InputOptions，默认当前尺寸、None 样式和本地化搜索名称；支持输入外观和回调，不能跨构建保留 Style 的元素。
MenuOptions.FilterInput.en: Optional InputOptions, defaulting to the current size, None variant and a localized search name. Supports input styling and callbacks; never retain Style elements across builds.

MenuOptions.OnSearchTermChange.zh: 用户编辑、清空或 Escape 清除查询时通知；不因外部赋值、无输入重建或关闭而通知。
MenuOptions.OnSearchTermChange.en: Notifies on user editing, clearing or Escape clearing. External assignments, idle rebuilds and closing do not emit.

MenuOptions.OnOpenChange.zh: 用户打开、选择关闭、Escape、Tab 或外部点击关闭时通知一次；直接修改 MenuState.Open 不通知。
MenuOptions.OnOpenChange.en: Emits once for user opening or closing through selection, Escape, Tab or outside press. Direct changes to MenuState.Open do not emit.

MenuOptions.UI.zh: 面板、分组、项目、正文、前后缀、文字、指示器、分隔符、筛选输入和空状态样式；Root 不适用。
MenuOptions.UI.en: Styles the panel, headings, rows, body, accessories, text, indicators, separators, filter input and empty state. Root is not used.

MenuOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建的菜单部件；筛选输入的精细配置使用 FilterInput.Style。
MenuOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build menu parts; use FilterInput.Style for individual input parts.

MenuItem.ID.zh: 整棵菜单树内唯一且稳定的业务 ID；分组标题和分隔符同样需要 ID。
MenuItem.ID.en: Stable business ID, unique across the entire menu tree, including headings and separators.

MenuItem.Label.zh: 显示文字，也是键盘前缀导航和无障碍名称；自定义 Build 时仍需提供。
MenuItem.Label.en: Visible text, typeahead value and accessible name; still required with custom Build content.

MenuItem.Description.zh: 可选说明，与标签同字号显示在下一行；图标和快捷键对齐首行。
MenuItem.Description.en: Optional description below the label at the same text size; icons and keyboard badges align with the first line.

MenuItem.Shortcut.zh: 仅显示快捷键，不注册命令；按 + 拆分，Ctrl++ 的末尾 + 表示加号键。
MenuItem.Shortcut.en: Displays keys without registering commands. Splits on +; the final + in Ctrl++ represents the plus key.

MenuItem.Kind.zh: MenuAction（默认）、MenuLabel 或 MenuSeparator；标题和分隔符不可聚焦或选择。
MenuItem.Kind.en: MenuAction (default), MenuLabel or MenuSeparator. Headings and separators cannot be focused or selected.

MenuItem.Icon.zh: 行首图标；Loading 优先，其次 Icon，再次 Avatar。
MenuItem.Icon.en: Leading icon. Priority is Loading, then Icon, then Avatar.

MenuItem.Avatar.zh: 可选头像；默认直径随菜单尺寸为 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP，显式 Avatar.Size 优先。
MenuItem.Avatar.en: Optional avatar. Default diameter follows menu size: 16 / 16 / 20 / 20 / 24 DIP; explicit Avatar.Size takes priority.

MenuItem.Loading.zh: 显示加载图标；不会自动禁用项目，禁止操作需设置 Disabled。
MenuItem.Loading.en: Displays a loading icon without disabling the item. Set Disabled to prevent interaction.

MenuItem.Disabled.zh: 禁用项目，键盘导航跳过，鼠标和快捷操作均不触发选择。
MenuItem.Disabled.en: Disables the item, skips it in keyboard navigation and prevents activation.

MenuItem.Color.zh: 默认和 Neutral 使用普通文字色；其他语义颜色为项目文字、图标及高亮背景着色。
MenuItem.Color.en: Default and Neutral use ordinary text colors; semantic colors tint the text, icon and highlighted background.

MenuItem.Checked.zh: 未设置时是普通动作；显式 false/true 使用复选菜单项语义和对应指示状态。值由应用保存。
MenuItem.Checked.en: Unset is an ordinary action. Explicit false/true uses checkbox-menu semantics and the corresponding indicator; the application owns the value.

MenuItem.Radio.zh: 原生扩展；须同时设置 Checked。使用单选语义，互斥关系由应用维护。
MenuItem.Radio.en: Native extension requiring Checked. Uses radio semantics; the application maintains mutual exclusion.

MenuItem.Close.zh: 叶项默认 true，选择后关闭；false 保留菜单。父项始终打开子菜单，不执行叶项回调。
MenuItem.Close.en: Leaf items default to true and close on selection; false keeps the menu open. Parents open a submenu without leaf callbacks.

MenuItem.OnCheckedChange.zh: 已设置 Checked 的叶项激活时通知新值一次，Radio 始终通知 true；随后执行 OnSelect。
MenuItem.OnCheckedChange.en: Emits the next value once for an activated leaf with Checked set. Radio emits true, then OnSelect runs.

MenuItem.OnSelect.zh: 可用叶项激活一次调用一次；默认先关闭并请求恢复焦点，再通知勾选变化和选择。
MenuItem.OnSelect.en: Called once per enabled leaf activation. By default closes and requests focus restoration before checked-change and selection callbacks.

MenuItem.Children.zh: 子菜单项目，最多 32 层，ID 在整棵树中唯一；不自动查找子级的搜索结果。
MenuItem.Children.en: Submenu items, up to 32 levels, with IDs unique across the tree. Root filtering does not recursively search child results.

MenuItem.Content.zh: 单个子菜单的尺寸、位置、循环、筛选和部件覆盖；未设置时继承根尺寸和样式，但不继承根筛选框。
MenuItem.Content.en: Overrides one submenu’s bounds, placement, looping, filtering and parts. Defaults inherit root sizing and styles, but not the root filter input.

MenuItem.UI.zh: 覆盖本项目的实际部件，优先于组件和 MenuOptions.UI；子菜单面板用 Content.UI。
MenuItem.UI.en: Overrides this item’s parts after component and MenuOptions.UI styles; use Content.UI for its submenu panel.

MenuItem.Build.zh: 同步绘制项目正文，标签仍用于名称和前缀导航；内容应为非交互展示，不保留构建元素。
MenuItem.Build.en: Synchronously builds non-interactive item content. Label still supplies its name and typeahead value; do not retain build elements.

MenuContentOptions.Label.zh: 菜单面板的无障碍名称；不显示为标题。
MenuContentOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the menu panel; not a visible heading.

MenuContentOptions.Width.zh: 未设置时继承根菜单宽度；指定值仍受 128 DIP 最小宽度及窗口边界限制。
MenuContentOptions.Width.en: Inherits root width when unset. Explicit values remain subject to the 128 DIP minimum and window bounds.

MenuContentOptions.MaxHeight.zh: 未设置时继承根菜单上限，最终默认 320 DIP；显式 0 收起可见内容。
MenuContentOptions.MaxHeight.en: Inherits the root height limit when unset, ultimately defaulting to 320 DIP. Explicit zero collapses visible content.

MenuContentOptions.Offset.zh: 默认子菜单间隔 3 DIP，显式 0 不留间隔。
MenuContentOptions.Offset.en: Submenu gap defaults to 3 DIP; explicit zero removes the gap.

MenuContentOptions.Placement.zh: 默认向阅读方向外侧打开，LTR 为 RightStart、RTL 为 LeftStart；显式值覆盖此行为。
MenuContentOptions.Placement.en: Defaults outward: RightStart in LTR and LeftStart in RTL; an explicit value overrides this.

MenuContentOptions.Filter.zh: 默认 false，不继承根 Filter；开启后显示本层独立的筛选输入。
MenuContentOptions.Filter.en: Defaults to false without inheriting root Filter; enables an independent input for this level.

MenuContentOptions.FilterFields.zh: nil 时继承根菜单，空列表回退 label；支持 label、description、id、shortcut。
MenuContentOptions.FilterFields.en: Nil inherits root fields; an empty list falls back to label. Supports label, description, id and shortcut.

MenuContentOptions.IgnoreFilter.zh: 未设置时继承根菜单，显式 false 恢复本层内置过滤。
MenuContentOptions.IgnoreFilter.en: Inherits the root when unset; explicit false restores built-in filtering at this level.

MenuContentOptions.SearchTerm.zh: 可选持久查询指针；nil 使用该子菜单按稳定 ID 保存的独立查询。
MenuContentOptions.SearchTerm.en: Optional persistent query pointer; nil uses a separate draft stored under this submenu’s stable ID.

MenuContentOptions.FilterInput.zh: 可选 InputOptions，默认当前尺寸、None 样式和本地化搜索名称；支持输入外观和回调，不能跨构建保留 Style 的元素。
MenuContentOptions.FilterInput.en: Optional InputOptions, defaulting to the current size, None variant and a localized search name. Supports input styling and callbacks; never retain Style elements across builds.

MenuContentOptions.OnSearchTermChange.zh: 用户编辑、清空或 Escape 清除查询时通知；不因外部赋值、无输入重建或关闭而通知。
MenuContentOptions.OnSearchTermChange.en: Notifies on user editing, clearing or Escape clearing. External assignments, idle rebuilds and closing do not emit.

MenuContentOptions.UI.zh: 覆盖当前子菜单及其后代的部件；保留根 UI 中未覆盖的样式。
MenuContentOptions.UI.en: Overrides parts in this submenu and its descendants, preserving root styles not overridden here.

MenuContentOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建的菜单部件；筛选输入的精细配置使用 FilterInput.Style。
MenuContentOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build menu parts; use FilterInput.Style for individual input parts.

MenuContentOptions.Loop.zh: 未设置时继承根菜单；显式 false/true 控制本层首尾是否循环。
MenuContentOptions.Loop.en: Inherits the root when unset. Explicit false/true controls looping at this level.

TabsOptions.Label.zh: 标签列表的无障碍名称，不显示为额外标题。
TabsOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the tab list, not an extra visible title.

TabsOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；活动背景或下划线使用语义色，Neutral 使用 InvertedBackground，正文不随此字段着色。
TabsOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary. Colors the active surface or underline; Neutral uses InvertedBackground. Does not recolor panel content.

TabsOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD，继承组件主题；XS–XL 调整触发器字号、行高、内边距、图标和默认头像。
TabsOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD with component-theme inheritance. XS–XL controls trigger text, line height, padding, icons and default avatars.

TabsOptions.Underline.zh: false 为 pill；true 对应 Nuxt 的 link 样式，水平底边或纵向起始边显示指示线。
TabsOptions.Underline.en: False uses pill styling; true maps to Nuxt’s link variant, with an underline at the bottom or vertical start edge.

TabsOptions.Vertical.zh: 默认 false。true 时纵向排列标签，与正文居中对齐，使用上下方向键；横向使用左右方向键，随 RTL 交换。
TabsOptions.Vertical.en: Defaults to false. True stacks tabs and centers the list beside the panel, using Up/Down. Horizontal tabs use Left/Right with RTL direction.

TabsOptions.KeepMounted.zh: 默认 false；true 时继续构建隐藏正文以保留编辑器等局部状态。Content=false 或删除项目仍会卸载。
TabsOptions.KeepMounted.en: Defaults to false. True keeps building hidden panels to preserve local state. Content=false or removing an item still unmounts it.

TabsOptions.Content.zh: 默认 true。显式 false 不构建任何正文，不改变选中值；隐藏正在聚焦的正文时返回当前标签。
TabsOptions.Content.en: Defaults to true. Explicit false omits all panels without changing selection, returning focus from a hidden panel to its tab.

TabsOptions.ActivationMode.zh: 默认 ActivationAutomatic，方向键导航同时选择；ActivationManual 只移动焦点，用 Enter/Space 激活。默认循环并跳过禁用项。
TabsOptions.ActivationMode.en: ActivationAutomatic selects on arrow navigation. ActivationManual moves focus and uses Enter/Space to activate. Navigation loops and skips disabled items.

TabsOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户选到不同 ID 时通知一次；应用赋值、无效值回退和无输入重建不通知。
TabsOptions.OnChange.en: Emits once when a user selects a different ID. External assignments, invalid-value fallback and idle rebuilds do not emit.

TabsOptions.UI.zh: Root、List、Trigger、Leading、Label、Trailing、Indicator、Body 的部件样式；Indicator 只绘制当前活动项。
TabsOptions.UI.en: Styles Root, List, Trigger, Leading, Label, Trailing, Indicator and Body. Indicator is rendered only for the active item.

TabsOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建部件，不保留元素。正文使用可聚焦的原生 group，当前没有独立 tabpanel 角色。
TabsOptions.Style.en: Synchronously styles current-build parts; do not retain elements. Panels use focusable native groups rather than a dedicated tabpanel role.

TabItem.ID.zh: 必需的稳定业务 ID，在同一 Tabs 内唯一；用于选择和重排身份，不使用位置索引。
TabItem.ID.en: Required stable business ID, unique within Tabs; identifies selection and state across reorder.

TabItem.Label.zh: 显示文字及标签的无障碍名称；建议始终提供，图标和徽标不自动替代名称。
TabItem.Label.en: Visible text and accessible tab name. Supply it explicitly; icons and badges do not replace the name.

TabItem.Icon.zh: 可选前导图标，优先于 Avatar；尺寸随 TabsOptions.Size。
TabItem.Icon.en: Optional leading icon, taking priority over Avatar and following TabsOptions.Size.

TabItem.Avatar.zh: 可选头像；默认直径随 XS–XL 为 16/16/20/20/24 DIP，显式 Avatar.Size 优先。
TabItem.Avatar.en: Optional avatar. Default XS–XL diameter is 16/16/20/20/24 DIP; explicit Avatar.Size takes priority.

TabItem.Badge.zh: 徽标文字，空值默认不显示；字符串 0 正常显示。BadgeOptions 非 nil 时也会构建徽标。
TabItem.Badge.en: Badge text; empty normally hides it. String 0 is displayed. Non-nil BadgeOptions also creates a badge.

TabItem.BadgeOptions.zh: 默认 SM、Neutral、Outline，可覆盖颜色、尺寸、图标和 UI；徽标尺寸不随标签尺寸变化。
TabItem.BadgeOptions.en: Defaults to SM, Neutral and Outline. Overrides colors, size, icons and UI; badge size does not automatically follow tab size.

TabItem.Disabled.zh: 禁止聚焦和激活。当前项被禁用时回退首个可用项；全部禁用时保留业务值但无活动正文。
TabItem.Disabled.en: Prevents focus and activation. Disabling the active item falls back to the first enabled item; all-disabled lists retain the business value without an active panel.

TabItem.Content.zh: 同步构建正文。默认只调用活动项；KeepMounted=true 时隐藏项也会调用，Content=false 时均不调用。应用数据由调用者保存。
TabItem.Content.en: Synchronously builds the panel. Normally runs only for the active item; KeepMounted also builds hidden panels, while Content=false builds none. Application data remains caller-owned.

TabItem.UI.zh: 覆盖本项目 Trigger、Leading、Label、Trailing、Indicator、Body；优先于 TabsOptions.UI。原生扩展支持单项 Indicator。
TabItem.UI.en: Overrides this item’s Trigger, Leading, Label, Trailing, Indicator and Body after TabsOptions.UI. Per-item Indicator styling is a native extension.

CollapsibleOptions.Label.zh: 原生内置标题文字及无障碍名称；Nuxt 对应组件使用自定义触发器插槽。
CollapsibleOptions.Label.en: Text and accessible name of the native built-in heading; Nuxt uses a trigger slot.

CollapsibleOptions.Icon.zh: 可选前导图标，默认 20 DIP 并随文字缩放；原生扩展。
CollapsibleOptions.Icon.en: Optional leading icon, 20 DIP before text scaling; a native extension.

CollapsibleOptions.TrailingIcon.zh: 尾部图标，默认 ChevronDown，展开时旋转 180 度；原生内置触发器扩展。
CollapsibleOptions.TrailingIcon.en: Trailing icon, defaulting to ChevronDown and rotating 180 degrees when open; a native trigger extension.

CollapsibleOptions.Disabled.zh: 只禁用触发器，不禁用已展开正文中的控件；外部仍可修改打开状态。
CollapsibleOptions.Disabled.en: Disables only the trigger, not controls inside an open body. External state assignments remain allowed.

CollapsibleOptions.KeepMounted.zh: 默认 false，关闭动画结束后卸载正文。true 时立即隐藏但继续构建正文，保留局部控件状态。
CollapsibleOptions.KeepMounted.en: Defaults to false, unmounting after the closing animation. True hides immediately but keeps building content and preserving local widget state.

CollapsibleOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户切换时通知新状态一次；应用赋值和静态重建不通知。
CollapsibleOptions.OnChange.en: Emits the new state once after user toggling; external assignments and idle rebuilds do not emit.

CollapsibleOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Trigger、Leading、Label、Trailing、Body。Body 是正文布局容器，外层动画裁剪容器不单独暴露。
CollapsibleOptions.UI.en: Styles Root, Trigger, Leading, Label, Trailing and Body. Body is the content layout; the animation clipping wrapper has no separate part.

CollapsibleOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建部件；不要保存 Element。默认触发器外观为 Go 原生扩展。
CollapsibleOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build parts; do not retain Element values. The default trigger appearance is a native Go extension.

AccordionOptions.Multiple.zh: 默认 false，只保留展开列表的首项；true 允许多项。切换模式导致的修正不通知。
AccordionOptions.Multiple.en: Defaults to false and retains only the first open ID. True permits multiple items. Mode normalization does not emit.

AccordionOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用所有标题，不改变展开列表，不连带禁用正文控件。
AccordionOptions.Disabled.en: Disables all headings without changing open IDs or disabling body controls.

AccordionOptions.KeepMounted.zh: 默认 false。true 时隐藏正文继续构建以保留局部状态；删除项目仍会卸载。
AccordionOptions.KeepMounted.en: Defaults to false. True keeps hidden content built to preserve local state; removing an item still unmounts it.

AccordionOptions.TrailingIcon.zh: 默认 ChevronDown；作为所有项目的尾部图标，单项 TrailingIcon 优先。
AccordionOptions.TrailingIcon.en: Defaults to ChevronDown for all items. An item’s TrailingIcon takes priority.

AccordionOptions.Collapsible.zh: 默认 true；单开模式显式 false 禁止再次激活关闭当前项。多开模式忽略此选项。
AccordionOptions.Collapsible.en: Defaults to true. Explicit false prevents closing the current item in single mode. Ignored in multiple mode.

AccordionOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户改变展开列表时通知一次，回调读取绑定的 ID 列表；外部赋值和模式修正不通知。
AccordionOptions.OnChange.en: Emits once after a user changes the open IDs; read the bound list in the callback. External assignments and mode normalization do not emit.

AccordionOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Item、Header、Trigger、Leading、Label、Trailing、Body；单项 UI 优先。
AccordionOptions.UI.en: Styles Root, Item, Header, Trigger, Leading, Label, Trailing and Body; item UI takes priority.

AccordionOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建部件；正文布局和动画裁剪不提供两个独立样式入口。
AccordionOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build parts. Body layout and animation clipping do not expose two separate styling entries.

AccordionItem.ID.zh: 必需且在同一 Accordion 内唯一的稳定 ID，用于展开状态、焦点及正文身份。
AccordionItem.ID.en: Required stable ID, unique within the Accordion, for open state, focus and content identity.

AccordionItem.Label.zh: 标题文字和触发器的无障碍名称。
AccordionItem.Label.en: Heading text and accessible trigger name.

AccordionItem.Icon.zh: 可选前导图标，默认 20 DIP 并随文字缩放。
AccordionItem.Icon.en: Optional leading icon, 20 DIP before text scaling.

AccordionItem.TrailingIcon.zh: 覆盖组件尾部图标；nil 继承 AccordionOptions.TrailingIcon，再回退 ChevronDown。
AccordionItem.TrailingIcon.en: Overrides the shared trailing icon. Nil inherits AccordionOptions.TrailingIcon, then falls back to ChevronDown.

AccordionItem.Disabled.zh: 只禁用本项标题并跳过键盘导航，不禁用已展开的正文。
AccordionItem.Disabled.en: Disables this heading and skips it during keyboard navigation without disabling its open body.

AccordionItem.Content.zh: 同步构建正文。nil 时不创建正文或底部留白；隐藏保留模式仍执行，应用数据由调用者持有。
AccordionItem.Content.en: Synchronously builds the body. Nil creates no body or bottom padding. Kept hidden content still runs; application data remains caller-owned.

AccordionItem.UI.en: Overrides this item’s Item, Header, Trigger, Leading, Label, Trailing and Body after AccordionOptions.UI.

BreadcrumbOptions.Label.zh: 导航组的无障碍名称；空值使用本地化的当前位置名称。
BreadcrumbOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the path group; empty uses the localized breadcrumb name.

BreadcrumbOptions.MaxItems.zh: 原生扩展。小于 2 不截断；否则保留首项及末尾项目，省略号不计入上限且不可操作。
BreadcrumbOptions.MaxItems.en: Native extension. Values below 2 do not truncate. Otherwise retains the first and trailing items; the inert ellipsis is not counted toward the limit.

BreadcrumbOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary，继承组件主题；用于活动文字及焦点轮廓，Neutral 的活动文字使用 Highlighted。
BreadcrumbOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary with component-theme inheritance. Colors active text and focus outlines; Neutral active text uses Highlighted.

BreadcrumbOptions.SeparatorIcon.zh: 默认 ChevronRight，RTL 下默认 ChevronLeft；显式图标保持原样，尺寸为 20 DIP 并随文字缩放。
BreadcrumbOptions.SeparatorIcon.en: Defaults to ChevronRight, or ChevronLeft in RTL. Explicit icons remain unchanged; the 20 DIP size follows text scaling.

BreadcrumbOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、List、Item、Trigger、Leading、Label、SeparatorSlot、Ellipsis。Root/List 及 Item/Trigger 分别共用原生节点。
BreadcrumbOptions.UI.en: Styles Root, List, Item, Trigger, Leading, Label, SeparatorSlot and Ellipsis. Root/List and Item/Trigger respectively share native nodes.

BreadcrumbOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建部件。分隔符使用前一项目的 UI；末项 Active=true 时补充当前页说明。
BreadcrumbOptions.Style.en: Synchronously styles current-build parts. Separators use the preceding item’s UI. An active final item receives the current-page description.

BreadcrumbItem.ID.zh: 必需的稳定 ID，在同一路径内非空且唯一。
BreadcrumbItem.ID.en: Required stable ID, non-empty and unique within the path.

BreadcrumbItem.Label.zh: 路径文字，保持单行并在可用宽度不足时截断；可操作项同时以此作为无障碍名称。
BreadcrumbItem.Label.en: Single-line path text truncated to available width; also names actionable items accessibly.

BreadcrumbItem.Icon.zh: 可选前导图标，优先于 Avatar，默认 20 DIP 并随文字缩放。
BreadcrumbItem.Icon.en: Optional leading icon, taking priority over Avatar; 20 DIP before text scaling.

BreadcrumbItem.Avatar.zh: 可选头像，默认直径 20 DIP；显式 Avatar.Size 优先。
BreadcrumbItem.Avatar.en: Optional avatar with a default 20 DIP diameter; explicit Avatar.Size takes priority.

BreadcrumbItem.Active.zh: 未设置时仅末项激活；显式 true/false 可覆盖样式，激活不改变项目顺序或自动触发导航。
BreadcrumbItem.Active.en: Only the final item is active by default. Explicit true/false overrides styling without reordering items or navigating.

BreadcrumbItem.Disabled.zh: 禁止本项聚焦和激活，并降低不透明度；同样适用于末项。
BreadcrumbItem.Disabled.en: Prevents focus and activation and reduces opacity, including for the final item.

BreadcrumbItem.OnSelect.zh: 有回调时项目可通过点击或 Enter/Space 操作，包括末项；nil 为静态文字。路由和 URL 打开由应用负责。
BreadcrumbItem.OnSelect.en: A callback makes the item actionable by click or Enter/Space, including the final item. Nil renders static text. Routing and URL opening belong to the application.

BreadcrumbItem.UI.zh: 覆盖本项 Item、Trigger、Leading、Label 及后面的 SeparatorSlot，优先于组件 UI。
BreadcrumbItem.UI.en: Overrides this item’s Item, Trigger, Leading, Label and following SeparatorSlot after component UI.

PaginationOptions.Label.zh: 分页控件组的无障碍名称，不额外显示标题。
PaginationOptions.Label.en: Accessible group name, without an extra visible heading.

PaginationOptions.Total.zh: 总条数；小于等于 0 仍保留第 1 页。总数变化会静默限制绑定页码。
PaginationOptions.Total.en: Total item count. Non-positive values retain page 1. Changes silently clamp the bound page.

PaginationOptions.PageSize.zh: 每页条数；小于等于 0 使用默认 10。
PaginationOptions.PageSize.en: Items per page; non-positive values use the default 10.

PaginationOptions.Siblings.zh: 兼容字段，小于等于 0 使用默认 2，最大 10；显式 0 使用 SiblingCount。
PaginationOptions.Siblings.en: Legacy field. Non-positive values use 2, capped at 10. Use SiblingCount for explicit zero.

PaginationOptions.SiblingCount.zh: 覆盖 Siblings；支持显式 0，限制为 0–10。
PaginationOptions.SiblingCount.en: Overrides Siblings, supports explicit zero and is bounded to 0–10.

PaginationOptions.ShowControls.zh: 默认 true，控制首页、上一页、下一页和末页四个按钮。
PaginationOptions.ShowControls.en: Defaults to true and controls all four first/previous/next/last buttons.

PaginationOptions.ShowEdges.zh: 默认 false；true 时保留首末页数字，必要时显示不可操作的省略号。
PaginationOptions.ShowEdges.en: Defaults to false. True retains edge page numbers and inert ellipses where needed.

PaginationOptions.Color.zh: 普通按钮颜色，默认 Neutral，可继承组件主题。
PaginationOptions.Color.en: Normal button color, defaulting to Neutral with component-theme inheritance.

PaginationOptions.ActiveColor.zh: 当前页按钮颜色，默认 Primary，独立于普通按钮颜色。
PaginationOptions.ActiveColor.en: Current-page button color, defaulting to Primary independently of normal controls.

PaginationOptions.Variant.zh: 普通按钮样式，默认 Outline；支持 Button 的六种公开样式。
PaginationOptions.Variant.en: Normal button variant, defaulting to Outline; supports the six public Button variants.

PaginationOptions.ActiveVariant.zh: 当前页按钮样式，默认 Solid，不被 Selected 状态强制覆盖。
PaginationOptions.ActiveVariant.en: Current-page button variant, defaulting to Solid without a Selected-state fill override.

PaginationOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD，XS–XL。数字按钮至少为方形，长页码可按文字宽度扩展。
PaginationOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD, supporting XS–XL. Number controls are at least square and can expand for long page numbers.

PaginationOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用所有按钮；仍响应外部页码和总数更新。
PaginationOptions.Disabled.en: Disables all buttons while still accepting external page and total updates.

PaginationOptions.FirstIcon.zh: 首页图标；默认双左箭头，RTL 下默认双右箭头。显式图标不镜像。
PaginationOptions.FirstIcon.en: First-page icon; defaults to double-left, or double-right in RTL. Explicit icons are not mirrored.

PaginationOptions.PrevIcon.zh: 上一页图标；默认左箭头，RTL 下默认右箭头。显式图标不镜像。
PaginationOptions.PrevIcon.en: Previous-page icon; defaults to left, or right in RTL. Explicit icons are not mirrored.

PaginationOptions.NextIcon.zh: 下一页图标；默认右箭头，RTL 下默认左箭头。显式图标不镜像。
PaginationOptions.NextIcon.en: Next-page icon; defaults to right, or left in RTL. Explicit icons are not mirrored.

PaginationOptions.LastIcon.zh: 末页图标；默认双右箭头，RTL 下默认双左箭头。显式图标不镜像。
PaginationOptions.LastIcon.en: Last-page icon; defaults to double-right, or double-left in RTL. Explicit icons are not mirrored.

PaginationOptions.EllipsisIcon.zh: 省略图标，默认 Ellipsis；始终不可操作。
PaginationOptions.EllipsisIcon.en: Ellipsis icon, defaulting to Ellipsis; always inert.

PaginationOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户切到不同页时通知一次；点击当前页、外部赋值和边界修正不通知。
PaginationOptions.OnChange.en: Emits once when a user selects a different page. Current-page activation, external assignments and clamping do not emit.

PaginationOptions.UI.zh: Root/List 共用布局；Item 兼容覆盖所有按钮，First/Previous/Next/Last 进一步覆盖控制按钮；Ellipsis、Leading、Label 可独立配置。
PaginationOptions.UI.en: Root/List share layout. Item retains styling for all buttons, with First/Previous/Next/Last providing more specific overrides. Ellipsis, Leading and Label are independent parts.

PaginationOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建部件；当前页与禁用语义由组件处理，不保存 Element。
PaginationOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build parts; the component owns current-page and disabled semantics. Do not retain Element values.

StepperOptions.Label.zh: 步骤组名称，空值使用本地化默认名称。
StepperOptions.Label.en: Step group name; empty uses the localized default.

StepperOptions.Vertical.zh: 默认 false；true 时步骤列表纵向排列，正文放在列表旁边。
StepperOptions.Vertical.en: Defaults to false. True stacks step headings and places the body beside the list.

StepperOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用步骤标题，不禁用当前步骤正文中的控件。
StepperOptions.Disabled.en: Disables step headings without disabling controls in the current body.

StepperOptions.Linear.zh: 默认 true，只允许返回或进入紧邻的下一步；false 可选择任何可用步骤。
StepperOptions.Linear.en: Defaults to true, allowing previous steps or the immediately following step. False permits any available step.

StepperOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；活动和已完成圆点、连接线使用该颜色，Neutral 使用 InvertedBackground。
StepperOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary for active/completed indicators and connectors; Neutral uses InvertedBackground.

StepperOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD，XS–XL 圆点直径为 24/32/40/48/56 DIP，并调整图标、标题和间距。
StepperOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD. XS–XL indicator diameters are 24/32/40/48/56 DIP, with corresponding icons, text and spacing.

StepperOptions.CanSelect.zh: 原生扩展，在用户激活时判断是否允许该 ID；不限制应用直接赋值。
StepperOptions.CanSelect.en: Native guard evaluated on user activation; does not restrict external assignments.

StepperOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户选择不同 ID 时通知一次；直接赋值、重排和禁用不通知。
StepperOptions.OnChange.en: Emits once for a user selection of a different ID. External assignments, reorder and disabling do not emit.

StepperOptions.UI.zh: Root 为整体，List 为步骤列表，Header 为单项圆点及连线容器，Body 为标题说明，Panel 为当前步骤正文。
StepperOptions.UI.en: Root is the whole component, List the step list, Header each indicator/connector container, Body the title/description wrapper and Panel the active content.

StepperOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建部件；单项 UI 先覆盖组件样式，Style 最后执行。
StepperOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build parts after per-item UI overrides component styling.

StepItem.ID.zh: 必需的稳定业务 ID，非空且唯一；未知绑定值表示尚未开始。
StepItem.ID.en: Required stable, non-empty and unique business ID. An unknown bound value means not started.

StepItem.Title.zh: 可见标题及步骤按钮名称；空值不创建标题文字。
StepItem.Title.en: Visible title and accessible step-button name; empty omits the title text.

StepItem.Description.zh: 可选说明，附加到步骤按钮的辅助说明。
StepItem.Description.en: Optional description, also attached to the step button’s accessible description.

StepItem.Icon.zh: 可选圆点图标；未设置时显示从 1 开始的序号，完成后仍保留原图标或序号。
StepItem.Icon.en: Optional indicator icon; otherwise shows a one-based number. Completed steps retain their icon or number.

StepItem.Disabled.zh: 禁用该步骤的用户激活和焦点；不自动跨过线性流程中的禁用步骤。
StepItem.Disabled.en: Disables user activation and focus; linear flows do not automatically skip disabled steps.

StepItem.UI.en: Overrides this item’s Item, Header, Trigger, Indicator, Leading, SeparatorSlot, Body, Label and Description.

StepItem.Content.zh: 同步构建当前步骤正文；切换步骤会卸载旧正文，同一 ID 的重排或方向切换保留正文身份。
StepItem.Content.en: Synchronously builds the active step body. Changing steps unmounts the previous body; reordering or changing orientation with the same ID preserves identity.

TimelineOptions.Label.zh: 时间线列表的无障碍名称。
TimelineOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the timeline list.

TimelineOptions.Horizontal.zh: 默认 false，使用纵向布局；true 将标记与连接线放在正文上方，各项等分宽度。
TimelineOptions.Horizontal.en: Defaults to vertical. True places markers/connectors above the text and gives items equal widths.

TimelineOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；活动、完成标记和连接线着色，Neutral 使用 InvertedBackground。
TimelineOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary for active/completed markers and connectors; Neutral uses InvertedBackground.

TimelineOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD，原生提供 XS–XL 五档，与 Avatar 的对应尺寸相同。
TimelineOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD. Native sizes are XS–XL, matching the corresponding Avatar sizes.

TimelineOptions.Current.zh: 从 0 开始的可选索引；未设置或超出范围时不高亮。Reverse=true 时按末尾计数。
TimelineOptions.Current.en: Optional zero-based index; unset or out-of-range values highlight nothing. Reverse=true counts from the end.

TimelineOptions.CurrentID.zh: 非空时优先于 Current；找不到该 ID 时不高亮，也不回退到索引。
TimelineOptions.CurrentID.en: Non-empty values override Current. An unmatched ID highlights nothing and does not fall back to the index.

TimelineOptions.Reverse.zh: 改变已完成项目与连接线的判断，不反转传入项目顺序；CurrentID 不受索引换算影响。
TimelineOptions.Reverse.en: Changes completed-item and connector interpretation without reordering data. CurrentID is not transformed as an index.

TimelineOptions.OnSelect.zh: 项目激活时通知 ID，不自动修改当前进度；提供回调后支持点击、Tab 聚焦及 Enter/Space。
TimelineOptions.OnSelect.en: Emits the activated item ID without updating progress automatically. A callback enables click, Tab focus and Enter/Space.

TimelineOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Item、Header（标记和连接线容器）、Indicator、SeparatorSlot、Body、DateSlot、Label、Description。
TimelineOptions.UI.en: Styles Root, Item, Header (marker/connector container), Indicator, SeparatorSlot, Body, DateSlot, Label and Description.

TimelineOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建部件；项目 UI 覆盖组件 UI 后再执行 Style。
TimelineOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build parts after item UI overrides component UI.

TimelineItem.ID.zh: 必需的稳定业务 ID，在同一时间线内非空且唯一。
TimelineItem.ID.en: Required stable business ID, non-empty and unique within the timeline.

TimelineItem.Title.zh: 可选标题；空值不创建文字，交互项目应提供可读名称。
TimelineItem.Title.en: Optional title; empty omits text. Interactive items should have a readable name.

TimelineItem.Description.zh: 可选说明，默认 14/20 DIP 字号与行高。
TimelineItem.Description.en: Optional description, defaulting to 14/20 DIP text and line height.

TimelineItem.Time.zh: 应用格式化后的日期或时间字符串，对应上游 date；默认 12/20 DIP，使用 DateSlot 配置。
TimelineItem.Time.en: Application-formatted date/time string, mapping to upstream date. Defaults to 12/20 DIP and is styled through DateSlot.

TimelineItem.Icon.zh: 标记的图标；Avatar 中显式配置的图标优先。
TimelineItem.Icon.en: Marker icon, overridden by an explicit icon in Avatar.

TimelineItem.Avatar.zh: 标记头像配置；未设置 Size 时继承时间线尺寸。Indicator 样式在 Avatar 样式后应用。
TimelineItem.Avatar.en: Marker avatar configuration; unset Size inherits the timeline size. Indicator styling is applied after Avatar styling.

TimelineItem.Color.zh: 原生扩展，覆盖本项活动标记及后续连接线的颜色；未设置时继承组件。
TimelineItem.Color.en: Native override for this item’s active marker and following connector, inheriting the component color when unset.

TimelineItem.UI.en: Overrides this item’s Item, Header, Indicator, SeparatorSlot, Body, DateSlot, Label and Description.

TimelineItem.Content.zh: 原生扩展，在文字之后同步构建附加内容，不替换日期、标题或说明。
TimelineItem.Content.en: Native extension that synchronously appends content after the text, without replacing the date, title or description.

BannerOptions.Title.zh: 通知标题及辅助名称，单行截断；空值不创建标题文字。
BannerOptions.Title.en: Banner title and accessible name, truncated to one line; empty omits title text.

BannerOptions.Description.zh: 原生扩展，标题旁的附加说明，单行截断。
BannerOptions.Description.en: Native extension for extra text beside the title, truncated to one line.

BannerOptions.CloseLabel.zh: 关闭按钮名称；空值使用本地化默认值，Close.AccessibleLabel 优先。
BannerOptions.CloseLabel.en: Close-button name. Empty uses the localized default; Close.AccessibleLabel takes priority.

BannerOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；背景采用语义色，Neutral 使用 InvertedBackground，文字使用 Inverted。
BannerOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary. Uses the semantic background, or InvertedBackground for Neutral, with Inverted text.

BannerOptions.Icon.zh: 可选前导图标，20 DIP 并随文字缩放。
BannerOptions.Icon.en: Optional leading icon, 20 DIP before text scaling.

BannerOptions.Actions.zh: 同步构建操作区，默认向其中的 Button 提供 Neutral / XS；按钮事件与整条通知激活独立。
BannerOptions.Actions.en: Synchronously builds actions, supplying Neutral / XS Button defaults. Inner actions remain independent from banner activation.

BannerOptions.CloseButton.zh: 未设置时，传入 open 状态或 Close 配置即显示关闭按钮；显式 false 优先。nil 状态且显式 true 时使用组件内开关状态。
BannerOptions.CloseButton.en: When unset, an open binding or Close configuration shows the button. Explicit false wins. Explicit true with a nil binding uses local visibility state.

BannerOptions.Close.zh: 关闭按钮配置，默认 MD / Neutral / Ghost；非 nil 也会启用关闭按钮，受 CloseButton=false 限制。
BannerOptions.Close.en: Close-button options, defaulting to MD / Neutral / Ghost. Non-nil also enables closing unless CloseButton=false.

BannerOptions.CloseIcon.zh: 默认 X；Close.Leading 非 nil 时优先使用该图标。
BannerOptions.CloseIcon.en: Defaults to X. A non-nil Close.Leading takes priority.

BannerOptions.OnSelect.zh: 可选整条通知动作，支持点击和键盘；内部按钮不会同时触发此回调。应用自行处理导航。
BannerOptions.OnSelect.en: Optional banner action for click and keyboard. Inner buttons do not also invoke it. Navigation remains application-owned.

BannerOptions.OnClose.zh: 用户关闭可见通知后调用一次；外部设为关闭或重新显示不通知。
BannerOptions.OnClose.en: Called once after a user dismisses a visible banner. External closing or showing does not emit.

BannerOptions.UI.zh: Root 为背景，Body 为限宽容器，Header 为中央内容，Trailing 为关闭区域；另有 Leading、Label、Description、Actions、Close。
BannerOptions.UI.en: Root styles the background, Body the bounded container, Header the central content and Trailing the close region, with Leading, Label, Description, Actions and Close parts.

BannerOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前部件。窗口宽度达到 1024 DIP 后居中；Body 默认按窗口宽度使用 16/24/32 DIP 水平内边距。
BannerOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current parts. Content is centered from 1024 DIP; Body uses 16/24/32 DIP horizontal padding according to window width.

ErrorOptions.Status.zh: 可选状态码字符串，对应上游 statusCode/status；默认 16/24 DIP、半粗体、Primary，可通过 StatusSlot 配置。
ErrorOptions.Status.en: Optional status-code string, mapping to upstream statusCode/status. Defaults to 16/24 DIP, semibold and Primary, styled through StatusSlot.

ErrorOptions.Title.zh: 错误标题，空值不显示；窗口宽度小于 640 DIP 时字号 36 DIP，否则为 48 DIP，使用二级标题语义。
ErrorOptions.Title.en: Error title, omitted when empty. Uses 36 DIP below a 640 DIP window width and 48 DIP otherwise, with level-two heading semantics.

ErrorOptions.Description.zh: 错误说明；与 Title 相同时省略，默认 18/28 DIP、Muted，最大宽度 480 DIP。
ErrorOptions.Description.en: Error description, omitted when identical to Title. Defaults to 18/28 DIP, Muted, with a 480 DIP width limit.

ErrorOptions.Icon.zh: 可选前导图标，40 DIP 并随文字缩放，不自动添加错误图标。
ErrorOptions.Icon.en: Optional leading icon, 40 DIP before text scaling. No icon is added automatically.

ErrorOptions.RetryLabel.zh: 默认操作文字；空值使用本地化的重试。
ErrorOptions.RetryLabel.en: Default action label; empty uses the localized retry text.

ErrorOptions.Clear.zh: 默认 true，允许显示默认操作，但仍需提供 OnRetry；false 隐藏默认操作，不隐藏自定义 Actions。不自动清除错误。
ErrorOptions.Clear.en: Defaults to true and permits the default action, still requiring OnRetry. False hides it without hiding custom Actions. Does not clear error state automatically.

ErrorOptions.Retry.zh: 默认操作的 ButtonOptions，默认 LG / Primary / Solid；不单独创建没有 OnRetry 的按钮。
ErrorOptions.Retry.en: Default action ButtonOptions, falling back to LG / Primary / Solid. Does not create a button without OnRetry.

ErrorOptions.OnRetry.zh: 用户激活默认按钮时调用；应用负责重试、清理错误和导航。
ErrorOptions.OnRetry.en: Called on default-button activation. The application owns retries, error cleanup and navigation.

ErrorOptions.Actions.zh: 同步替换整个操作区，优先于默认按钮，即使 Clear=false 仍显示；默认操作间距为 24 DIP。
ErrorOptions.Actions.en: Synchronously replaces the action area, taking priority over the default button and remaining visible with Clear=false. Default action spacing is 24 DIP.

ErrorOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Leading、StatusSlot、Label、Description、Actions；不强制占满窗口，保留原生嵌入布局。
ErrorOptions.UI.en: Styles Root, Leading, StatusSlot, Label, Description and Actions. Retains native embedded layout rather than forcing full-window height.

ErrorOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建部件，不保留 Element；可通过 Label 调整嵌入式标题的大小和层级。
ErrorOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build parts without retaining Element values. Label can customize title size and heading level for embedding.

FormOptions.Label.zh: 原生表单组的无障碍名称，不额外显示标题。
FormOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the native form group; does not add a visible heading.

FormOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用表单控件并从 Values 排除其字段；禁用期间的提交请求直接丢弃。
FormOptions.Disabled.en: Disables form controls and excludes their fields from Values. Submissions requested while disabled are discarded.

FormOptions.LoadingAuto.zh: 默认 true。BeginAsync 后禁用表单内控件，但保留字段快照；false 允许编辑，编辑会使旧结果失效。两种模式都阻止重复提交。
FormOptions.LoadingAuto.en: Defaults to true. BeginAsync disables controls without removing values. False permits editing, which invalidates old results. Both modes prevent duplicate submissions.

FormOptions.Validate.zh: 同步业务校验，接收可见且启用字段的字符串快照。空名称或未注册名称的错误同样阻止提交；字段错误由 FormField 显示。
FormOptions.Validate.en: Synchronous business validation over visible, enabled string values. Errors with empty or unregistered names also block submission; FormField displays registered field errors.

FormOptions.OnSubmit.zh: 有效提交调用一次；回调内可调用 BeginAsync 开始异步工作。禁止重入和异步期间重复提交，成功后清理当前字段 Dirty。
FormOptions.OnSubmit.en: Called once for a valid submission. Call BeginAsync inside it for async work. Reentrant and pending submissions are ignored; success clears current fields’ Dirty state.

FormOptions.OnError.zh: 提交校验失败时调用一次，参数是独立错误快照；显式 Validate、SetErrors 和 CompleteAsync 不自动触发此事件。
FormOptions.OnError.en: Called once when submit validation fails with an independent error snapshot. Explicit Validate, SetErrors and CompleteAsync do not emit this event.

FormOptions.UI.zh: 仅 Root 部件有效；默认纵向间距 16 DIP，继承主题字体和文字颜色。
FormOptions.UI.en: Only Root is styled; the default vertical gap is 16 DIP with the theme font and foreground.

FormOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建的 Root，先于正文构建执行；不得保留 Element。
FormOptions.Style.en: Synchronously styles the current Root before building content; do not retain the Element.

InputNumberOptions.Min.zh: 可选最小值；未设置时没有下界，显式 0 有效。步长网格以 Min 或 0 为起点。
InputNumberOptions.Min.en: Optional minimum; unset means no lower bound and explicit zero is meaningful. The step grid starts at Min or zero.

InputNumberOptions.Max.zh: 可选最大值；未设置时没有上界。步长对齐时，最大可达值是范围内的网格值。
InputNumberOptions.Max.en: Optional maximum; unset means no upper bound. With snapping, the last reachable value is an in-range grid value.

InputNumberOptions.Step.zh: 增减步长；0 使用默认 1，其余必须为有限正数。PageUp / PageDown 使用十步。
InputNumberOptions.Step.en: Step amount; zero uses 1 and other values must be finite and positive. PageUp / PageDown use ten steps.

InputNumberOptions.StepSnapping.zh: 默认 true。增减按方向到达相邻网格；Enter 对有效输入就近对齐。false 在当前值上直接加减 Step；AllowInvalid 保留手工输入。
InputNumberOptions.StepSnapping.en: Defaults to true. Stepping aligns in the requested direction; Enter snaps valid input to the nearest grid. False adds/subtracts Step directly. AllowInvalid retains typed values.

InputNumberOptions.StartingValue.zh: 空值或不能解析的草稿首次增减时使用；显式起始值只限制到上下界，不按步长取整。未设置时从 Min 或 0 开始。
InputNumberOptions.StartingValue.en: Used for the first step from empty or unparseable text. An explicit value is clamped without snapping; unset starts from Min or zero.

InputNumberOptions.AllowInvalid.zh: 允许有限数值超出范围，且 Enter 不按步长改写手工值；仍拒绝非法文字、NaN 和 Inf。增减始终限制范围和方向。
InputNumberOptions.AllowInvalid.en: Allows finite out-of-range values and prevents Enter from snapping typed values. Invalid text, NaN and Infinity remain rejected. Stepping still respects bounds and direction.

InputNumberOptions.FocusOnChange.zh: 默认 true，增减后聚焦输入框并在指针操作时保留编辑焦点。false 允许按钮保留焦点；外部赋值不主动聚焦。
InputNumberOptions.FocusOnChange.en: Defaults to true and focuses the editor after stepping, retaining its focus during pointer input. False allows a control to keep focus. External assignments do not request focus.

InputNumberOptions.DisableWheelChange.zh: 默认 false；仅编辑器聚焦且纵向滚动量大于横向时处理滚轮。true 将滚动交回父级。
InputNumberOptions.DisableWheelChange.en: Defaults to false. Handles wheel input only while the editor is focused and vertical movement dominates. True leaves scrolling to the parent.

InputNumberOptions.InvertWheelChange.zh: 默认 false，向下滚动增加数值；true 反转该方向。仅滚轮改值开启时有效。
InputNumberOptions.InvertWheelChange.en: Defaults to false: scrolling down increases the value. True reverses direction while wheel changes are enabled.

InputNumberOptions.Increment.zh: 默认 true，显示增加按钮；false 移除按钮并释放对应内边距，不关闭键盘增减。
InputNumberOptions.Increment.en: Defaults to true. False removes the increment control and its reserved padding without disabling keyboard stepping.

InputNumberOptions.Decrement.zh: 默认 true，显示减少按钮；横向隐藏后编辑文字靠起始边。
InputNumberOptions.Decrement.en: Defaults to true. Hiding it in horizontal mode aligns the editor text to the start.

InputNumberOptions.IncrementOptions.zh: 增加按钮配置，默认继承字段颜色和尺寸、使用 LinkVariant。按钮按字段布局定位；默认图标始终存在，Avatar 不替代它。
InputNumberOptions.IncrementOptions.en: Increment button configuration, inheriting field color/size and LinkVariant. Geometry follows the field layout. A default icon is always present and is not replaced by Avatar.

InputNumberOptions.DecrementOptions.zh: 减少按钮配置，规则与 IncrementOptions 相同；自定义 Style 在字段按钮布局和部件样式之后执行。
InputNumberOptions.DecrementOptions.en: Decrement button configuration with the same defaults as IncrementOptions; its Style runs after field geometry and part styling.

InputNumberOptions.IncrementIcon.zh: 覆盖增加图标。默认横向加号、纵向上箭头；显式图标不旋转，IncrementOptions.Leading 优先。
InputNumberOptions.IncrementIcon.en: Overrides the increment icon. Defaults are plus horizontally and chevron-up vertically; explicit icons are not rotated. IncrementOptions.Leading takes precedence.

InputNumberOptions.DecrementIcon.zh: 覆盖减少图标。默认横向减号、纵向下箭头；DecrementOptions.Leading 优先。
InputNumberOptions.DecrementIcon.en: Overrides the decrement icon. Defaults are minus horizontally and chevron-down vertically; DecrementOptions.Leading takes precedence.

InputNumberOptions.IncrementDisabled.zh: 仅禁用增加按钮，不禁用键盘或滚轮；控件只读、禁用或无法继续增大时同样不可用。
InputNumberOptions.IncrementDisabled.en: Disables only the increment control, not keys or wheel. Read-only, disabled and no-larger-value states also disable it.

InputNumberOptions.DecrementDisabled.zh: 仅禁用减少按钮；键盘与滚轮仍按字段范围工作。
InputNumberOptions.DecrementDisabled.en: Disables only the decrement control; keys and wheel continue to follow field bounds.

InputNumberOptions.OnValueChange.zh: 有效编辑、Enter 对齐或实际增减使 Optional 数值变化时调用一次；同值、边界空操作和外部赋值不通知。
InputNumberOptions.OnValueChange.en: Called once per actual Optional numeric change from valid editing, Enter normalization or stepping. Equal values, bound no-ops and external assignments do not notify.

InputNumberOptions.OnChange.zh: 原生扩展：报告文字编辑及清空，增减和外部赋值使用 OnValueChange 规则，不等同 Nuxt 的 change 事件。
InputNumberOptions.OnChange.en: Native extension reporting text edits and clearing. Stepping and external assignments follow OnValueChange semantics; this is not Nuxt’s change event.

InputNumberOptions.OnSubmit.zh: 原生扩展：按 Enter 时收到规范化或恢复后的文本；失焦保留草稿。
InputNumberOptions.OnSubmit.en: Native extension: Enter reports normalized or restored text; blur retains the draft.

InputNumberOptions.UI.zh: Root、Editor、Leading、Trailing，以及 IncrementSlot / DecrementSlot 有效；增减部件作用于按钮。
InputNumberOptions.UI.en: Styles Root, Editor, Leading, Trailing and IncrementSlot / DecrementSlot; the latter two target the controls.

InputNumberOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置整个字段、真实编辑器和前后配件；增减按钮使用各自 Options.Style 或 UI 部件。
InputNumberOptions.Style.en: Synchronously styles the whole field, real editor and leading/trailing accessories; configure step controls through their own Options.Style or UI parts.

InputNumberOptions.Password.zh: 原生扩展：只遮罩编辑器文字，不改变数值和步进；Nuxt InputNumber 没有对应参数。
InputNumberOptions.Password.en: Native extension masking editor text without changing values or stepping; Nuxt InputNumber has no equivalent prop.

InputNumberOptions.Loading.zh: 原生扩展：显示加载配件，不自动禁用数值编辑或增减。
InputNumberOptions.Loading.en: Native extension showing a loader without automatically disabling editing or stepping.

InputNumberOptions.Clearable.zh: 原生扩展：清空草稿并将数值变为未设置；只读时不显示清空按钮。
InputNumberOptions.Clearable.en: Native extension clearing the draft and unsetting the number; hidden while read-only.

InputNumberOptions.MaxLength.zh: 原生扩展：按 UTF-16 单元限制文字编辑，不限制外部数值格式化后的位数。
InputNumberOptions.MaxLength.en: Native extension limiting text edits in UTF-16 units, without truncating formatted external values.

InputTagsOptions.MaxTags.zh: 标签总数上限，≤0 不限；达到上限时拒绝新增，但现有标签仍可删除。
InputTagsOptions.MaxTags.en: Maximum tag count; non-positive values are unlimited. A full list rejects additions but permits removal.

InputTagsOptions.MaxLength.zh: 按 UTF-16 单元限制编辑草稿，0 不限；该字段覆盖嵌入 InputOptions 中的同名设置，不限制批量粘贴的标签长度。
InputTagsOptions.MaxLength.en: Limits draft UTF-16 units, with zero unlimited. Overrides the embedded InputOptions field; does not limit the length of tags added by batch paste.

InputTagsOptions.Separators.zh: 分隔符字符集合，空值使用逗号；键入与启用后的批量粘贴均使用它，不支持正则。
InputTagsOptions.Separators.en: Set of delimiter characters, defaulting to comma. Used for typing and enabled batch paste, without regular expressions.

InputTagsOptions.DeleteIcon.zh: 每个标签的删除图标，默认 X；不改变删除按钮的本地化名称或键盘行为。
InputTagsOptions.DeleteIcon.en: Per-tag delete icon, default X, without changing its localized name or keyboard behavior.

InputTagsOptions.ConvertValue.zh: 新增前转换已去除首尾空白的字符串，再执行重复和数量检查。函数应只返回转换结果。
InputTagsOptions.ConvertValue.en: Transforms trimmed new strings before duplicate and count checks. The function should only return the converted value.

InputTagsOptions.DisplayValue.zh: 只格式化可见标签和删除按钮名称，不改变绑定值、去重或稳定身份；可能在每次构建调用。
InputTagsOptions.DisplayValue.en: Formats labels and delete-button names without changing bound values, deduplication or identity; may run on every build.

InputTagsOptions.OnAddTag.zh: 每个成功新增的标签通知一次；参数是转换后的值。
InputTagsOptions.OnAddTag.en: Called once per added tag with its converted value.

InputTagsOptions.OnRemoveTag.zh: 每个用户删除的标签通知一次；外部更新切片不通知。
InputTagsOptions.OnRemoveTag.en: Called once per user-removed tag; external slice updates do not notify.

InputTagsOptions.OnInvalid.zh: 重复、超限或转换为空时报告被拒绝的候选；空白输入不触发。不会自动添加业务错误文本。
InputTagsOptions.OnInvalid.en: Reports candidates rejected as duplicates, over-limit values or empty conversion results. Blank input does not emit and no business error text is added automatically.

InputTagsOptions.OnTagsChange.zh: 值实际变化时收到切片副本；一次批量粘贴最多通知一次，单项事件按候选分别通知。
InputTagsOptions.OnTagsChange.en: Receives a slice copy when values change. A paste batch emits at most once; per-item events report individual candidates.

InputTagsOptions.OnChange.zh: 原生草稿事件，收到添加处理前的编辑文字；标签变化使用 OnTagsChange。
InputTagsOptions.OnChange.en: Native draft event receiving edited text before addition handling; use OnTagsChange for tag values.

InputTagsOptions.OnSubmit.zh: 按 Enter 时报告提交的草稿，组件已先尝试添加；非空 AddOnTab 不触发此回调。
InputTagsOptions.OnSubmit.en: Reports the draft submitted with Enter after attempting addition. AddOnTab does not emit this callback.

InputTagsOptions.UI.zh: Root 为整字段，Body 为标签与编辑器的换行区域；Editor / Leading / Trailing、Item / Label / Close / Indicator 分别配置输入配件和标签部件。
InputTagsOptions.UI.en: Root is the whole field and Body the wrapping tag/editor region. Editor / Leading / Trailing style input parts; Item / Label / Close / Indicator style tags.

InputTagsOptions.Style.zh: root 现在指整个字段；其余参数为真实编辑器与前后配件。标签部件通过 UI 配置。
InputTagsOptions.Style.en: root now refers to the whole field; other arguments are the real editor and accessories. Configure tag parts through UI.

InputTagsOptions.Clearable.zh: 原生扩展：只清空草稿，保留已有标签。
InputTagsOptions.Clearable.en: Native extension clearing only the draft and retaining existing tags.

InputTagsOptions.Password.zh: 原生扩展：只遮罩编辑草稿，已提交标签仍显示正常标签文字。
InputTagsOptions.Password.en: Native extension masking only the draft; submitted tags remain visible.

PinInputOptions.Highlight.zh: 默认 false；true 为全部格子添加当前颜色边框。字段错误优先，焦点外圈仍只属于当前格。
PinInputOptions.Highlight.en: Defaults to false. True adds a color border to every cell. Field errors take precedence and only the current cell receives the focus outline.

PinInputOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Item、Label、SeparatorSlot。Root.Gap / Padding 与分隔符字体、字号、内边距参与总尺寸计算。
PinInputOptions.UI.en: Styles Root, Item, Label and SeparatorSlot. Root gap/padding and separator font, size and padding contribute to total geometry.

PinInputOptions.Style.zh: 同步接收 Root、每个 Item / Label 和各 SeparatorSlot；修改原始宽高时需自行协调父级布局。
PinInputOptions.Style.en: Synchronously receives Root, every Item / Label and each SeparatorSlot. Coordinate parent geometry when overriding raw dimensions.

PinInputOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户修改后传回规范化字符串，实际变化时一次；初值、外部赋值和长度/模式裁剪不通知。
PinInputOptions.OnChange.en: Reports a normalized string once per actual user change. Initialization, external updates and length/mode truncation do not notify.

PinInputOptions.OnComplete.zh: 用户修改后的字符数达到 Length 时调用一次；再次修改完整内容可再次通知，不自动提交。
PinInputOptions.OnComplete.en: Called once when a user change reaches Length. Further edits to a full value can emit again; it does not submit automatically.

PinInputOptions.Placeholder.zh: 空格子中的占位文字；当前编辑格不显示，长文字保持单行截断。
PinInputOptions.Placeholder.en: Placeholder for empty cells, omitted in the active editing cell; long text is truncated to one line.

InputRatingOptions.Label.zh: 评分控件的可访问名称；不会在星标旁额外绘制文字。
InputRatingOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the rating; no extra text is drawn beside the icons.

InputRatingOptions.Max.zh: 0 使用默认 5，其余接受 1–20。模型静默限制到 0–Max；仅支持整数评分，没有半星 step。
InputRatingOptions.Max.en: Zero uses 5; other values must be 1–20. The model clamps silently to 0–Max. Only integer ratings are supported, without a fractional step.

InputRatingOptions.Disabled.zh: 阻止指针和键盘修改，并继承字段及祖先禁用状态。
InputRatingOptions.Disabled.en: Blocks pointer and keyboard edits and inherits field and ancestor disabled state.

InputRatingOptions.ReadOnly.zh: 阻止修改和悬停预览，保持正常颜色、默认光标及 Tab 焦点。网页只读评分则禁用内部 radio 项。
InputRatingOptions.ReadOnly.en: Blocks edits and hover preview while retaining normal colors, the default cursor and Tab focus. Web read-only ratings disable their radio items.

InputRatingOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary。Neutral 图标使用 Highlighted，焦点外圈使用 InvertedBackground；字段错误优先使用 Error。
InputRatingOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary. Neutral uses Highlighted for icons and InvertedBackground for the focus ring. Field errors use Error.

InputRatingOptions.Size.zh: XS–XL 图标为 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 28 DIP，随文字缩放；默认 MD，并继承字段尺寸。
InputRatingOptions.Size.en: XS–XL icons are 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 28 DIPs and follow text scale. Defaults to MD and inherits field size.

InputRatingOptions.Orientation.zh: 默认横向，横向方向键遵循 RTL；纵向使用上下键。另一轴无效，首尾停止。
InputRatingOptions.Orientation.en: Defaults to horizontal, with horizontal arrows following RTL. Vertical uses Up / Down. The other axis is ignored and navigation stops at the ends.

InputRatingOptions.Clearable.zh: 默认 false。true 允许点击当前评分或按 Space 清零，并取消悬停预览；清零后再次 Space 选中 1。
InputRatingOptions.Clearable.en: Defaults to false. True allows clicking the current rating or pressing Space to clear it and its hover preview. Space then selects 1.

InputRatingOptions.Hoverable.zh: 默认 false。true 在指针进入星标时预览，间隙内保持，离开或清零后恢复；不修改评分或发出 OnChange。
InputRatingOptions.Hoverable.en: Defaults to false. True previews on entering an item, retains the preview across gaps, and resets on leaving or clearing. It does not change the value or emit OnChange.

InputRatingOptions.Icon.zh: 已评分图标，默认星形。绘制在空图标之上；未设置 EmptyIcon 时两层使用此图标。
InputRatingOptions.Icon.en: Filled icon, defaulting to a star, drawn over the empty icon. When EmptyIcon is unset, both layers use this icon.

InputRatingOptions.EmptyIcon.zh: 底层未评分图标，默认沿用 Icon；不同图形可能在评分图标周围仍然可见。
InputRatingOptions.EmptyIcon.en: Background empty icon, defaulting to Icon. A different shape may remain visible around the filled overlay.

InputRatingOptions.OnChange.zh: 一次实际用户改值通知一次；悬停、重建、外部赋值或 Max 裁剪不通知。
InputRatingOptions.OnChange.en: Called once per actual user change. Hover, rebuilds, external assignment and maximum clamping do not emit it.

InputRatingOptions.UI.zh: 支持 root、item、indicator、icon、emptyIcon。Root 间距和内边距参与尺寸；IconSlot 的颜色优先于 Indicator。
InputRatingOptions.UI.en: Supports root, item, indicator, icon and emptyIcon. Root spacing contributes to size; IconSlot foreground overrides Indicator.

InputRatingOptions.Style.zh: 当前构建内同步配置 Root、Item、Indicator、IconSlot、EmptyIconSlot；Item 阴影可覆盖默认焦点外圈。
InputRatingOptions.Style.en: Synchronously styles Root, Item, Indicator, IconSlot and EmptyIconSlot during the current build. Item shadow can override the default focus ring.

ListboxOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary，实例配置优先于组件主题；Neutral 焦点外圈使用 InvertedBackground，字段错误使用 Error。
ListboxOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary; instance settings override the component theme. Neutral uses InvertedBackground for focus, and field errors use Error.

ListboxOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD，继承 FormField；同时控制选项、头像默认尺寸、圆点、筛选框和加载图标。
ListboxOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD and inherits FormField size. Applies to rows, default avatar and chip sizes, filter input and spinner.

ListboxOptions.Highlight.zh: 无焦点时也显示颜色边框；禁用样式和实例 Root 样式仍适用。
ListboxOptions.Highlight.en: Show the colored border even without focus. Disabled appearance and instance Root styles still apply.

ListboxOptions.Loading.zh: 用加载图标替换选项内容，阻止选择和列表导航；筛选框仍可编辑。SelectMenu 自身 Loading 的行为不同。
ListboxOptions.Loading.en: Replace options with a spinner and block selection and list navigation. The filter remains editable. SelectMenu Loading has different behavior.

ListboxOptions.Filter.zh: 默认 false；显示筛选输入框。隐藏输入框仍使用已有查询词筛选，IgnoreFilter 才会跳过筛选。
ListboxOptions.Filter.en: Defaults to false. Show the filter input; hiding it keeps filtering by the retained query. IgnoreFilter bypasses filtering.

ListboxOptions.FilterInput.zh: Filter=true 时配置内置 Input；未设置时使用组件尺寸、颜色、None 外观及本地化占位文字。OnChange / OnSubmit 与列表行为组合执行。
ListboxOptions.FilterInput.en: Configure the Input when Filter is true. Defaults inherit size/color, use None and a localized placeholder. OnChange and OnSubmit compose with list behavior.

ListboxOptions.FilterFields.zh: nil 默认仅 label；支持 label、description、value/id、group。显式空列表不匹配非空查询。不区分大小写与组合附加符号，依次按完全匹配、前缀、包含排序。
ListboxOptions.FilterFields.en: Nil defaults to label. Supports label, description, value/id and group; an explicit empty list matches no nonempty query. Case and combining marks are folded; matches rank exact, prefix, then substring.

ListboxOptions.SearchTerm.zh: 可选的持久查询指针；nil 使用 ListboxState.Query。外部赋值不触发搜索变化通知，重建后 Query 镜像当前值。
ListboxOptions.SearchTerm.en: Optional persistent query pointer; nil uses ListboxState.Query. External assignments are silent and Query mirrors the value after building.

ListboxOptions.IgnoreFilter.zh: 直接显示应用提供的选项，保留查询词和搜索通知，适用于外部筛选。
ListboxOptions.IgnoreFilter.en: Show application-provided options without local filtering, retaining the query and notifications.

ListboxOptions.SelectedIcon.zh: 覆盖默认 Check 选中图标；只在选中行显示，Indicator 配置其样式。
ListboxOptions.SelectedIcon.en: Override the default Check shown on selected rows. Indicator styles the icon.

ListboxOptions.OnHighlight.zh: 用户方向键、前缀检索或悬停使高亮 ID 发生变化时通知；初始化、外部选中值与配置重建不通知。
ListboxOptions.OnHighlight.en: Notify when navigation, typeahead or hover changes the highlighted ID. Initialization, external selection and configuration rebuilds are silent.

ListboxOptions.OnSearchTermChange.zh: 用户编辑查询时通知；外部赋值不通知。SelectMenu 的选择、关闭或清空重置也会在查询实际变化时通知。
ListboxOptions.OnSearchTermChange.en: Notify on user query edits, not external assignments. SelectMenu also notifies when selection, dismissal or clear actually resets a query.

ListboxOptions.Height.zh: 原生列表总高度，包含筛选框。未设置或非正数时纵向默认 224 DIP、横向 64 DIP；SelectMenu 内部按可用空间计算。
ListboxOptions.Height.en: Native total list height, including the filter. Unset/nonpositive values default to 224 DIP vertically or 64 horizontally; SelectMenu computes available space internally.

ListboxItem.Kind.zh: ListboxOption 为默认可选项；ListboxLabel 和 ListboxSeparator 为不可选择的结构行，仍需要唯一 ID。
ListboxItem.Kind.en: ListboxOption is the default selectable item. ListboxLabel and ListboxSeparator are structural rows and still need unique IDs.

ListboxItem.Avatar.zh: 选项前导头像，Icon 优先；未设置头像尺寸时随行尺寸调整。
ListboxItem.Avatar.en: Leading avatar; Icon takes precedence. Unset avatar size follows the row.

ListboxItem.Chip.zh: 选项前导圆点；Icon 和 Avatar 优先，未设置尺寸时随行尺寸调整。
ListboxItem.Chip.en: Leading chip; Icon and Avatar take precedence. Unset size follows the row.

ListboxItem.Options.zh: 可选的单项动作与样式配置；放在指针中以保留 ListboxItem 的可比较性。
ListboxItem.Options.en: Optional per-item action and styles, stored behind a pointer to keep ListboxItem comparable.

ListboxItemOptions.OnSelect.zh: 在改值前调用；事件包含 ID 和此前是否选中。PreventDefault 取消本次改值和组件 OnSelect，也保留菜单打开状态。
ListboxItemOptions.OnSelect.en: Called before selection changes with ID and previous selection state. PreventDefault cancels the change and component OnSelect, keeping a menu open.

ListboxItemOptions.UI.zh: 覆盖本项部件样式，使用 Listbox 的部件名；即使在 SelectMenu 内，前导和尾部仍用 leading / trailing。
ListboxItemOptions.UI.en: Override this item using Listbox part names. Leading/trailing stay leading/trailing even inside SelectMenu.

SelectMenuOptions.SearchInput.zh: 默认 true；控制搜索框是否显示。false 时仍按保留的 Query 或 SearchTerm 筛选。
SelectMenuOptions.SearchInput.en: Defaults to true. Controls visibility only; false still filters by the retained Query or SearchTerm.

SelectMenuOptions.Filter.zh: 继承字段，在 SelectMenu 中不生效；用 SearchInput 控制搜索框。
SelectMenuOptions.Filter.en: Inherited but unused by SelectMenu. Use SearchInput to control the search field.

SelectMenuOptions.FilterInput.zh: 配置弹层搜索 Input，替代只提供占位文字的简单配置；默认 None，尺寸和颜色随菜单。搜索框中 Enter 可直接激活高亮项。
SelectMenuOptions.FilterInput.en: Configure the popup Input beyond its placeholder. Defaults to None and menu size/color. Enter in search directly activates the highlighted item.

SelectMenuOptions.FocusSearch.zh: 默认 true；打开后优先聚焦可用搜索框。false、隐藏或禁用搜索框时聚焦列表；不生成 HTML autofocus。
SelectMenuOptions.FocusSearch.en: Defaults to true. Focus an available search field on open; false, hidden or disabled search focuses the list. No HTML autofocus is generated.

SelectMenuOptions.SearchTerm.zh: 可选持久查询指针；nil 使用 SelectMenuState.Query。组件重置会同步写入此指针。
SelectMenuOptions.SearchTerm.en: Optional persistent query pointer; nil uses SelectMenuState.Query. Component resets update this pointer too.

SelectMenuOptions.FilterFields.zh: nil 默认仅 label；支持 label、description、value/id、group。显式空列表不匹配非空查询。不区分大小写与组合附加符号，依次按完全匹配、前缀、包含排序。
SelectMenuOptions.FilterFields.en: Nil defaults to label. Supports label, description, value/id and group; an explicit empty list matches no nonempty query. Case and combining marks are folded; matches rank exact, prefix, then substring.

SelectMenuOptions.ResetModelValueOnClear.zh: 默认 true；清空按钮重置选中值。false 保留选中值，但按钮仍清除查询词并发出 OnClear；删除搜索文字本身不会清空选中值。
SelectMenuOptions.ResetModelValueOnClear.en: Defaults to true. Clear resets selection; false retains it but still clears the query and emits OnClear. Deleting search text alone does not clear selection.

SelectMenuOptions.ClearOptions.zh: 配置尾部清空 Button；默认 Neutral / Link、零内边距及本地化名称，Size 随菜单。仅在 Clearable 且有选择并显示尾部时出现。
SelectMenuOptions.ClearOptions.en: Configure the trailing clear Button. Defaults to Neutral/Link, zero padding, a localized name and menu size. Requires Clearable, a selection and visible trailing content.

SelectMenuOptions.ClearIcon.zh: 清空按钮的图标，默认 X；ClearOptions.Leading 优先。
SelectMenuOptions.ClearIcon.en: Clear button icon, default X; ClearOptions.Leading takes precedence.

SelectMenuOptions.OnClear.zh: 用户执行清空按钮后通知一次；在查询及允许的选中值重置后执行。
SelectMenuOptions.OnClear.en: Notify once after a user clear action, after the query and any permitted model reset.

SelectMenuOptions.OnOpenChange.zh: 用户打开、选择关闭、Escape 或外部点击导致开关实际变化时通知一次；应用直接修改 State.Open 不通知。
SelectMenuOptions.OnOpenChange.en: Notify once for an actual user open/close, selection dismissal, Escape or outside dismissal. Direct State.Open changes are silent.

SelectMenuOptions.Loading.zh: 显示触发器旋转图标及原生弹层加载文字；已有结果仍可选择。禁用交互需使用 Disabled。
SelectMenuOptions.Loading.en: Show a trigger spinner and native popup loading status. Existing results remain selectable; use Disabled to prevent interaction.

SelectMenuOptions.Leading.zh: 触发器前导图标，优先于 Avatar；默认加载图标位于前导时替换它。
SelectMenuOptions.Leading.en: Trigger leading icon, before Avatar in precedence; a leading loader replaces it.

SelectMenuOptions.Avatar.zh: 触发器前导头像，显式 Leading 或前导加载图标优先；未指定 Size 时随菜单尺寸。
SelectMenuOptions.Avatar.en: Trigger avatar, replaced by Leading or a leading loader. Unset size follows the menu.

SelectMenuOptions.Trailing.zh: 触发器尾部图标，默认 ChevronDown；尾部加载图标或可见清空按钮优先。
SelectMenuOptions.Trailing.en: Trigger trailing icon, default ChevronDown. A trailing loader or visible clear button takes precedence.

SelectMenuOptions.ShowTrailing.zh: 默认 true；false 隐藏整个尾部，包括箭头、尾部加载图标和清空按钮。
SelectMenuOptions.ShowTrailing.en: Defaults to true. False hides all trailing content, including arrow, trailing loader and clear button.

SelectMenuOptions.LoadingTrailing.zh: 将加载图标放在尾部；默认位于前导。不会像 Button 一样禁止菜单交互。
SelectMenuOptions.LoadingTrailing.en: Place the loader at the trailing end instead of the default leading position. Unlike Button, it does not disable menu interaction.

SelectMenuOptions.UI.zh: Root / Trigger / Leading / Label / Trailing 配置触发器；ItemLeadingSlot / ItemLabelSlot / ItemTrailingSlot、Body、Description、Indicator 配置选项；Header 配置组标题，Popup.UI 配置面板。
SelectMenuOptions.UI.en: Root/Trigger/Leading/Label/Trailing style the trigger. ItemLeadingSlot/ItemLabelSlot/ItemTrailingSlot, Body, Description and Indicator style rows. Header styles group labels; Popup.UI styles the panel.

CalendarOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary，实例优先于组件主题；Neutral 的选中填充和焦点使用 InvertedBackground，字段错误使用 Error。
CalendarOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary; instance settings override the theme. Neutral uses InvertedBackground for selection/focus; field errors use Error.

CalendarOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD，继承 FormField；日格 XS–XL 为 24 / 28 / 32 / 36 / 40 DIP，随文字缩放，星期、标题和导航按钮同步调整。
CalendarOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD and inherits FormField. Day cells are 24/28/32/36/40 DIP for XS–XL and follow text scaling; weekdays, heading and controls scale too.

CalendarOptions.Variant.zh: 默认 Solid；支持 Solid、Outline、Soft、Subtle，用于选中日期。
CalendarOptions.Variant.en: Defaults to Solid. Supports Solid, Outline, Soft and Subtle for selected dates.

CalendarOptions.ReadOnly.zh: 保留日期和导航视图的浏览、焦点及翻页，阻止用户改值；外部模型仍可更新。
CalendarOptions.ReadOnly.en: Retain browsing, focus and paging in all views while preventing user value changes. External updates still apply.

CalendarOptions.PreventDeselect.zh: 默认 false；重复选择同一单日或未完成范围的起点可取消。true 保留原值，不重复通知 OnChange。
CalendarOptions.PreventDeselect.en: Defaults to false. Re-select a single date or an unfinished range start to clear it. True retains the value without another OnChange.

CalendarOptions.IsDateUnavailable.zh: 将日期标为不可用并显示删除线；方向键仍可到达，但不能选为端点。不同于 IsDateDisabled，禁用日期会被方向键跳过。
CalendarOptions.IsDateUnavailable.en: Mark dates unavailable with a strike. Arrows can reach them, but they cannot be endpoints. IsDateDisabled dates are skipped by arrow navigation.

CalendarOptions.AllowNonContiguousRanges.zh: 默认 false；true 允许范围经过 IsDateUnavailable 日期。禁用日期仍拒绝，除非 IsDateHighlightable 明确允许该内部日期；端点始终必须可选。
CalendarOptions.AllowNonContiguousRanges.en: Defaults to false. True permits unavailable interior dates. Disabled dates remain rejected unless explicitly allowed by IsDateHighlightable; endpoints must always be selectable.

CalendarOptions.MaximumDays.zh: 包含两个端点的范围天数上限；0 不限制。仅 Range=true 时生效，超出范围的候选会禁用。
CalendarOptions.MaximumDays.en: Inclusive range-day limit; 0 is unlimited. Applies only to Range and disables candidates beyond the limit.

CalendarOptions.FixedDate.zh: 默认 CalendarNoFixedDate；完整范围可固定起点或终点。跨过固定端时按新日期更新该端，避免产生反向范围。
CalendarOptions.FixedDate.en: Defaults to CalendarNoFixedDate. A complete range can fix its start or end; crossing the fixed endpoint updates that endpoint to keep the range ordered.

CalendarOptions.WeekStart.zh: 沿用原生默认周日，可显式设置 time.Monday 等；不自动随语言切换。
CalendarOptions.WeekStart.en: Retains the native Sunday default. Set time.Monday or another weekday explicitly; locale changes do not reset it.

CalendarOptions.WeekdayFormat.zh: 默认 CalendarWeekdayNarrow；Short 使用 Mon 等缩写，Long 使用完整星期名称。固定列宽下过长文字会裁剪。
CalendarOptions.WeekdayFormat.en: Defaults to CalendarWeekdayNarrow. Short uses names such as Mon; Long uses full names. Long labels clip to the fixed column width.

CalendarOptions.FixedWeeks.zh: 默认 true，始终六周；false 根据当月实际日期显示四至六周。
CalendarOptions.FixedWeeks.en: Defaults to true for six weeks. False uses four to six weeks as needed.

CalendarOptions.WeekNumbers.zh: 默认 false；周序号跟随 WeekStart。周日采用包含 1 月 1 日的第一周，其他起点采用包含 1 月 4 日的第一周；周一符合 ISO 周序号。
CalendarOptions.WeekNumbers.en: Defaults to false. WeekStart controls numbering: Sunday uses the week containing January 1; other starts use January 4. Monday follows ISO week numbering.

CalendarOptions.NumberOfMonths.zh: 0 默认显示一个月，支持 1–12；以 State.Month 为首月，空间不足时换行，9999 年末按剩余月份缩减。
CalendarOptions.NumberOfMonths.en: 0 defaults to one month; supports 1–12. Starts at State.Month, wraps when space is limited, and truncates at the end of year 9999.

CalendarOptions.PagedNavigation.zh: 默认 false；true 让日视图的月份按钮按 NumberOfMonths 翻页。键盘 PageUp / PageDown 仍按月移动，Shift 按年移动。
CalendarOptions.PagedNavigation.en: Defaults to false. True pages day-view month buttons by NumberOfMonths. PageUp/PageDown still move one month; Shift moves one year.

CalendarOptions.MonthControls.zh: 默认 true；控制日视图前后月按钮。月、年导航视图始终提供对应翻页按钮。
CalendarOptions.MonthControls.en: Defaults to true for day-view month buttons. Month/year navigation views always expose their page controls.

CalendarOptions.YearControls.zh: 默认 true；显示日视图前后年按钮。
CalendarOptions.YearControls.en: Defaults to true for previous/next-year buttons in the day view.

CalendarOptions.ViewControl.zh: 默认 true；标题在日、月、年导航视图之间切换，选择月或年只导航，不修改 DateSelection。
CalendarOptions.ViewControl.en: Defaults to true. The heading cycles day, month and year navigation views. Choosing a month or year only navigates and does not change DateSelection.

CalendarOptions.ViewControlOptions.zh: 配置标题按钮，默认 Neutral / Ghost、跟随日历尺寸；关闭 ViewControl 时显示普通文字。
CalendarOptions.ViewControlOptions.en: Configure the heading button, default Neutral/Ghost with calendar size. Disabling ViewControl shows plain text.

CalendarOptions.YearsPerPage.zh: 年导航每页数量，0 默认 12，支持 1–120。初次进入按十年起点排列；数量较少时确保当前年份可见。
CalendarOptions.YearsPerPage.en: Year-navigation page size: 0 defaults to 12, supports 1–120. Initially decade-aligned; small pages keep the current year visible.

CalendarOptions.OnChange.zh: 仅用户操作使 DateSelection 实际变化时通知一次；浏览、配置重建及外部赋值不通知。
CalendarOptions.OnChange.en: Notify once only when a user action changes DateSelection. Browsing, rebuilding and external assignments are silent.

CalendarOptions.OnMonthChange.zh: 用户导航或选择使首个显示月份实际变化时通知；外部设置 State.Month、外部选中值或布局配置调整不通知。
CalendarOptions.OnMonthChange.en: Notify when user navigation or selection changes the first displayed month. External Month/model assignments and layout adjustments are silent.

CalendarOptions.OnViewChange.zh: 用户切换导航视图时通知一次；外部设置 State.View 不通知。
CalendarOptions.OnViewChange.en: Notify once on a user navigation-view change. External State.View assignments are silent.

CalendarOptions.UI.zh: Root、Header、HeadingSlot、Body、GridSlot、GridRowSlot、WeekDaySlot、WeekNumberSlot 和 Item 配置原生部件；Item 用于日、月、年单元格。
CalendarOptions.UI.en: Style Root, Header, HeadingSlot, Body, GridSlot, GridRowSlot, WeekDaySlot, WeekNumberSlot and Item. Item applies to day, month and year cells.

CalendarOptions.PreviousMonth.zh: 配置前月按钮；默认 Neutral / Ghost，Size 随日历，越过边界时禁用。
CalendarOptions.PreviousMonth.en: Configure the previous month button; defaults to Neutral/Ghost and calendar size. Boundary constraints still disable it.

CalendarOptions.PreviousMonthIcon.zh: 覆盖前月图标；未设置时按 RTL 镜像默认图标，显式图标保持原样。按钮配置中的 Leading 优先。
CalendarOptions.PreviousMonthIcon.en: Override the previous month icon. Only defaults mirror in RTL; explicit icons are preserved. The button configuration’s Leading takes precedence.

CalendarOptions.NextMonth.zh: 配置后月按钮；默认 Neutral / Ghost，Size 随日历，越过边界时禁用。
CalendarOptions.NextMonth.en: Configure the next month button; defaults to Neutral/Ghost and calendar size. Boundary constraints still disable it.

CalendarOptions.NextMonthIcon.zh: 覆盖后月图标；未设置时按 RTL 镜像默认图标，显式图标保持原样。按钮配置中的 Leading 优先。
CalendarOptions.NextMonthIcon.en: Override the next month icon. Only defaults mirror in RTL; explicit icons are preserved. The button configuration’s Leading takes precedence.

CalendarOptions.PreviousYear.zh: 配置前一年按钮；默认 Neutral / Ghost，Size 随日历，越过边界时禁用。
CalendarOptions.PreviousYear.en: Configure the previous year button; defaults to Neutral/Ghost and calendar size. Boundary constraints still disable it.

CalendarOptions.PreviousYearIcon.zh: 覆盖前一年图标；未设置时按 RTL 镜像默认图标，显式图标保持原样。按钮配置中的 Leading 优先。
