CalendarOptions.PreviousYearIcon.en: Override the previous year icon. Only defaults mirror in RTL; explicit icons are preserved. The button configuration’s Leading takes precedence.

CalendarOptions.NextYear.zh: 配置后一年按钮；默认 Neutral / Ghost，Size 随日历，越过边界时禁用。
CalendarOptions.NextYear.en: Configure the next year button; defaults to Neutral/Ghost and calendar size. Boundary constraints still disable it.

CalendarOptions.NextYearIcon.zh: 覆盖后一年图标；未设置时按 RTL 镜像默认图标，显式图标保持原样。按钮配置中的 Leading 优先。
CalendarOptions.NextYearIcon.en: Override the next year icon. Only defaults mirror in RTL; explicit icons are preserved. The button configuration’s Leading takes precedence.

CalendarOptions.IsMonthDisabled.zh: 在月导航视图中禁用指定月份，键盘会跳过；日视图仍使用 IsDateDisabled。
CalendarOptions.IsMonthDisabled.en: Disable periods in the month navigation view and skip them with arrows. The day view still uses IsDateDisabled.

CalendarOptions.IsMonthUnavailable.zh: 在月导航视图中标记不可用，显示删除线并阻止进入；不改变已有日期值。
CalendarOptions.IsMonthUnavailable.en: Mark a period unavailable in the month navigation view with a strike, preventing entry without changing the existing date value.

CalendarOptions.IsYearDisabled.zh: 在年导航视图中禁用指定年份，键盘会跳过；日视图仍使用 IsDateDisabled。
CalendarOptions.IsYearDisabled.en: Disable periods in the year navigation view and skip them with arrows. The day view still uses IsDateDisabled.

CalendarOptions.IsYearUnavailable.zh: 在年导航视图中标记不可用，显示删除线并阻止进入；不改变已有日期值。
CalendarOptions.IsYearUnavailable.en: Mark a period unavailable in the year navigation view with a strike, preventing entry without changing the existing date value.

CalendarOptions.IsDateHighlightable.zh: 允许范围经过指定的内部日期，优先于该内部日期的禁用或不可用标记；端点仍必须可选。仅 Range=true 时使用。
CalendarOptions.IsDateHighlightable.en: Allow specified interior range dates, overriding their disabled or unavailable marker. Endpoints must still be selectable. Used only for Range.

CalendarOptions.PreviousPage.zh: 同步计算前后页的目标日期，接收首个显示月份；无效日期禁用相应按钮。此回调可能在构建时多次执行，不应有 I/O 或提交副作用。
CalendarOptions.PreviousPage.en: Synchronously compute the target page from the first displayed month. Invalid dates disable the button. May run repeatedly during construction; do not perform I/O or submissions.

CalendarOptions.NextPage.zh: 同步计算前后页的目标日期，接收首个显示月份；无效日期禁用相应按钮。此回调可能在构建时多次执行，不应有 I/O 或提交副作用。
CalendarOptions.NextPage.en: Synchronously compute the target page from the first displayed month. Invalid dates disable the button. May run repeatedly during construction; do not perform I/O or submissions.

CalendarOptions.BuildDay.zh: 同步构建日单元格的非交互内容，接收对应日期；尺寸、可访问名称和操作由容器管理，不能保存 Element 或 Context。
CalendarOptions.BuildDay.en: Synchronously build noninteractive day cell content from its date. The container owns size, accessible name and actions. Do not retain Element or Context.

CalendarOptions.BuildMonth.zh: 同步构建月导航单元格的非交互内容，接收对应日期；尺寸、可访问名称和操作由容器管理，不能保存 Element 或 Context。
CalendarOptions.BuildMonth.en: Synchronously build noninteractive month cell content from its date. The container owns size, accessible name and actions. Do not retain Element or Context.

CalendarOptions.BuildYear.zh: 同步构建年导航单元格的非交互内容，接收对应日期；尺寸、可访问名称和操作由容器管理，不能保存 Element 或 Context。
CalendarOptions.BuildYear.en: Synchronously build noninteractive year cell content from its date. The container owns size, accessible name and actions. Do not retain Element or Context.

CalendarOptions.BuildWeekday.zh: 替换星期内容，接收 time.Weekday；列宽和完整星期名称语义仍由日历提供。
CalendarOptions.BuildWeekday.en: Replace weekday content using time.Weekday. Calendar retains column width and the full accessible weekday name.

CalendarOptions.BuildHeading.zh: 替换默认标题和视图切换按钮，接收当前月份及视图；自定义动作通过持久 CalendarState 更新状态。
CalendarOptions.BuildHeading.en: Replace the default heading and view button, receiving the current month and view. Custom actions update persistent CalendarState.

InputDateOptions.Highlight.zh: 保持颜色边框，包括 None；Neutral 使用反转背景色。错误状态优先。
InputDateOptions.Highlight.en: Keeps a colored border, including None; Neutral uses the inverted background color. Invalid state takes precedence.

InputDateOptions.Step.zh: 分别设置各分段的循环步长，0 使用 1，负值无效；不向相邻分段进位。
InputDateOptions.Step.en: Per-segment cycling steps. Zero uses one and negative values are invalid; stepping does not carry into adjacent segments.

InputDateOptions.PlaceholderValue.zh: 为空分段的首次调整提供参考值，不是字符串占位，也不会直接写入业务值。
InputDateOptions.PlaceholderValue.en: Seeds the first adjustment of an empty segment; it is not a placeholder string and does not initialize the model.

InputTimeOptions.Highlight.zh: 保持颜色边框，包括 None；Neutral 使用反转背景色。错误状态优先。
InputTimeOptions.Highlight.en: Keeps a colored border, including None; Neutral uses the inverted background color. Invalid state takes precedence.

InputTimeOptions.Step.zh: 分别设置各分段的循环步长，0 使用 1，负值无效；不向相邻分段进位。
InputTimeOptions.Step.en: Per-segment cycling steps. Zero uses one and negative values are invalid; stepping does not carry into adjacent segments.

InputTimeOptions.PlaceholderValue.zh: 为空分段的首次调整提供参考值，不是字符串占位，也不会直接写入业务值。
InputTimeOptions.PlaceholderValue.en: Seeds the first adjustment of an empty segment; it is not a placeholder string and does not initialize the model.

InputDateOptions.OnValueChange.zh: 仅 InputDate：有效单日或空值实际变化时通知一次；外部赋值静默。范围使用 OnRangeChange。
InputDateOptions.OnValueChange.en: InputDate only: once for an actual accepted date or empty-value change. External assignments are quiet; ranges use OnRangeChange.

InputDateOptions.OnRangeChange.zh: 仅 InputDateRange：分段或日历改变范围时通知一次；清空两端只通知一次。
InputDateOptions.OnRangeChange.en: InputDateRange only: once when segments or the calendar change the range; clearing both endpoints sends one notification.

InputDateOptions.SeparatorIcon.zh: InputDateRange 的分隔图标，默认减号；BuildSeparator 优先。
InputDateOptions.SeparatorIcon.en: Range separator icon; defaults to minus. BuildSeparator takes precedence.

InputDateOptions.BuildSeparator.zh: 同步构建范围分隔内容；不保存 Context 或 Element，使用非交互内容。
InputDateOptions.BuildSeparator.en: Synchronously builds non-interactive range separator content. Do not retain Context or Element.

InputTimeOptions.Granularity.zh: TimeHour / TimeMinute / TimeSecond；默认由 Seconds 决定。只影响可见分段，保留隐藏单位与业务值。
InputTimeOptions.Granularity.en: TimeHour, TimeMinute or TimeSecond; the default follows Seconds. Only visible segments change; hidden units and the model are retained.

InputTimeOptions.Min.zh: 可选的完整时间下界，包含边界；显式 00:00:00 有效。不能大于 Max。
InputTimeOptions.Min.en: Optional inclusive lower bound for the complete time. Explicit 00:00:00 is valid and must not exceed Max.

InputTimeOptions.Max.zh: 可选的完整时间上界，包含隐藏分钟和秒；不支持跨午夜的反向区间。
InputTimeOptions.Max.en: Optional inclusive upper bound, including hidden minutes and seconds. Reversed overnight intervals are not supported.

InputTimeOptions.IsTimeUnavailable.zh: 同步纯谓词；返回 true 的时间不可提交，草稿和最后有效值保留。
InputTimeOptions.IsTimeUnavailable.en: A synchronous pure predicate; true rejects a commit while retaining the draft and last accepted value.

InputTimeOptions.StepSnapping.zh: 默认 false；离开已编辑分段时按 0 起点四舍五入到有效步长，12 小时制按完整小时计算。只读、禁用或仅改变显示设置时不对齐。
InputTimeOptions.StepSnapping.en: Defaults to false. On leaving an edited segment, rounds from zero to a valid step; hours use the full 24-hour value. Read-only, disabled and display-only changes do not snap.

DateStep.Year.zh: 当前分段的循环步长，0 使用 1，必须非负。
DateStep.Year.en: Cycling step for this segment; zero uses one and the value must be nonnegative.

DateStep.Month.zh: 当前分段的循环步长，0 使用 1，必须非负。
DateStep.Month.en: Cycling step for this segment; zero uses one and the value must be nonnegative.

DateStep.Day.zh: 当前分段的循环步长，0 使用 1，必须非负。
DateStep.Day.en: Cycling step for this segment; zero uses one and the value must be nonnegative.

TimeStep.Hour.zh: 当前分段的循环步长，0 使用 1，必须非负。
TimeStep.Hour.en: Cycling step for this segment; zero uses one and the value must be nonnegative.

TimeStep.Minute.zh: 当前分段的循环步长，0 使用 1，必须非负。
TimeStep.Minute.en: Cycling step for this segment; zero uses one and the value must be nonnegative.

TimeStep.Second.zh: 当前分段的循环步长，0 使用 1，必须非负。
TimeStep.Second.en: Cycling step for this segment; zero uses one and the value must be nonnegative.

ColorPickerOptions.Label.zh: 整体名称及 RGBA 字段名称前缀；留空时继承 FormField。内部原生控件名称随窗口语言变化。
ColorPickerOptions.Label.en: Group name and RGBA field prefix; inherits FormField when empty. Internal native control names follow the window language.

ColorPickerOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD；XS/SM/MD/LG/XL 的默认 SV 边长为 152/160/168/176/184 DIP，并跟随密度和文字缩放。字段和原生面板使用同一尺寸。
ColorPickerOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD. XS/SM/MD/LG/XL give default SV sides of 152/160/168/176/184 DIP, scaled by density and text scale. The fields and native panel share the size.

ColorPickerOptions.Throttle.zh: 未设置使用 50 毫秒，显式 0 逐次通知，必须非负。只合并 OnChange，模型即时更新；保留末次值。外部赋值、禁用、移除回调或卸载时取消待发通知。
ColorPickerOptions.Throttle.en: Unset uses 50 ms; explicit zero notifies every actual change. Must be nonnegative. Only OnChange is coalesced; the model updates immediately and the trailing value is retained. External assignment, disabling, removing the callback or unmounting cancels pending work.

ColorPickerOptions.OnChange.zh: 报告实际颜色变化，受 Throttle 控制；外部赋值和重新填入原通道值静默。回调接收当前合并后的颜色快照。
ColorPickerOptions.OnChange.en: Reports actual color changes subject to Throttle. External assignments and restoring the same channel are quiet. Receives the current coalesced color snapshot.

ColorPickerOptions.UI.zh: Root 为整体，Panel 为原生面板，Body 为 RGBA 容器，Item 为通道行，Label 为通道字母。内部 SV、轨道和 HEX 没有公开部件。
ColorPickerOptions.UI.en: Root styles the whole component, Panel the native panel, Body the RGBA container, Item each channel row and Label its letter. Internal SV, tracks and HEX parts are not exposed.

ColorPickerOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置 Root / Panel / Body / Item / Label，最后覆盖对应部件的主题和 UI；不能保存 Element。
ColorPickerOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures Root, Panel, Body, Item and Label after their theme and UI styles. Do not retain Element.

TableOptions.Label.zh: 原生表格的辅助技术名称；空值先继承 FormField，再使用 Caption。
TableOptions.Label.en: Accessible table name; an empty value inherits FormField, then Caption.

TableOptions.Caption.zh: 表格描述文字，默认不占布局空间。BuildCaption 可显示可见标题；显式 Label 优先作为名称。
TableOptions.Caption.en: Accessible description, hidden from layout by default. BuildCaption adds visible content; explicit Label takes priority for the name.

TableOptions.Height.zh: 默认 320 DIP，包含可见标题；表头固定，正文在内部滚动。
TableOptions.Height.en: Defaults to 320 DIP including any visible caption; the header stays above the internally scrolling body.

TableOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用表格的鼠标和键盘交互，并继承 FormField 与祖先禁用状态。
TableOptions.Disabled.en: Disables mouse and keyboard interaction, also inheriting FormField and ancestor disabled state.

TableOptions.EmptyText.zh: 无数据时显示在表头下方；空字符串使用当前语言的默认消息。BuildEmpty 可替换内容。
TableOptions.EmptyText.en: Displayed below the header when no rows exist; empty uses the localized default. BuildEmpty replaces the content.

TableOptions.ManualSorting.zh: 默认 false。启用后只更新排序状态并通知，行顺序由 SetRows 提供；适合应用处理服务端排序。
TableOptions.ManualSorting.en: Defaults to false. When enabled, sorting updates state and notifications while SetRows supplies row order, suitable for application-managed server sorting.

TableOptions.Loading.zh: 默认 false。显示表头下的加载线并保留现有行；无数据且配置 BuildLoading 时替换空内容。
TableOptions.Loading.en: Defaults to false. Shows a loading line below the header while preserving rows; with no data and BuildLoading, replaces empty content.

TableOptions.LoadingColor.zh: 加载线颜色，未指定时使用组件主题或 Primary。
TableOptions.LoadingColor.en: Loading-line color; defaults to the component theme or Primary.

TableOptions.LoadingAnimation.zh: 默认 TableLoadingCarousel，另有 CarouselInverse、Swing、Elastic；减少动态效果时显示静态线。
TableOptions.LoadingAnimation.en: Defaults to TableLoadingCarousel; CarouselInverse, Swing and Elastic are also available. Reduced motion shows a static line.

TableOptions.BuildCaption.zh: 可见标题内容，在原生表格上方构建；Caption 字符串仍用于辅助技术说明。
TableOptions.BuildCaption.en: Builds visible content above the native table; Caption still supplies its accessible description.

TableOptions.BuildEmpty.zh: 无数据时在表头下构建内容，优先于 EmptyText。
TableOptions.BuildEmpty.en: Builds empty content below the header, taking precedence over EmptyText.

TableOptions.BuildLoading.zh: 仅在 Loading 且没有数据时构建；未提供时仍显示空内容和加载线。
TableOptions.BuildLoading.en: Built only while Loading with no rows; when absent, empty content and the loading line remain visible.

TableOptions.OnSortChange.zh: 用户更改排序后通知一次，参数是独立的排序列表。外部赋值及移除无效排序列不通知。
TableOptions.OnSortChange.en: Notifies once after a user sort change, with an independent sort slice. External changes and invalid-column cleanup do not notify.

TableOptions.OnSelectionChange.zh: 用户更改选中集合后通知一次，参数为按字符串排序的稳定 ID；外部选择和 SetRows 清理静默。
TableOptions.OnSelectionChange.en: Notifies once when user input changes the selected set, with stable IDs sorted lexically. External selection and SetRows pruning remain silent.

TableOptions.OnActivate.zh: Enter 或双击激活行，返回稳定 ID。没有绑定 List.Selected 时自动使用组件内部活动行。不同于 Nuxt 的单击 select。
TableOptions.OnActivate.en: Activates a row on Enter or double-click and returns its stable ID. Uses an internal active row when List.Selected is unset. This differs from Nuxt’s single-click select.

TableOptions.OnChange.zh: 保留原生表格的综合变化通知，可能包含选择、排序或列布局等；需要分类时使用专用回调。
TableOptions.OnChange.en: Retains native combined change notifications, which may cover selection, sorting or column layout. Use dedicated callbacks for specific model changes.

TableOptions.UI.zh: 公开 root、caption、body、panel、item、label、empty、loading、indicator。item/label 是单元格内容，不能独立修改原生表头或整行。
TableOptions.UI.en: Exposes root, caption, body, panel, item, label, empty, loading and indicator. item/label style cell contents; native headers and whole rows are not separate parts.

TableOptions.Style.zh: 当前构建的同步部件回调，在 UI 之后运行，不保存 Element。列的 Style 最后应用于其 item/label。
TableOptions.Style.en: Synchronous current-build part callback, applied after UI; do not retain Element. Column Style runs last on its item/label.

TableColumn.Sortable.zh: 未设置时由 Compare 是否存在决定；显式 false 关闭排序。true 且无 Compare 时必须启用 ManualSorting。
TableColumn.Sortable.en: Defaults to whether Compare exists; explicit false disables sorting. True without Compare requires ManualSorting.

TableColumn.Fixed.zh: 禁止移动列和调整列宽；不会冻结滚动列。
TableColumn.Fixed.en: Prevents column reordering and resizing; it does not pin a scrolling column.

TableColumn.Compare.zh: 返回负数、零或正数进行本地排序；比较器捕获的数据变化后调用 InvalidateSort，SetRows 已自动使排序失效。
TableColumn.Compare.en: Returns negative, zero or positive for local sorting. Call InvalidateSort when captured comparator inputs change; SetRows invalidates sorting automatically.

TableColumn.Width.zh: 列宽，单位 DIP；0 分配其他列剩余空间。用户设置保存在 List.Columns.Widths。
TableColumn.Width.en: Column width in DIP; zero shares remaining space. User sizes are stored in List.Columns.Widths.

TableColumn.MinWidth.zh: 最小列宽；原生列实际最小值为 16 DIP。
TableColumn.MinWidth.en: Minimum column width; native columns have an effective minimum of 16 DIP.

TableColumn.MaxWidth.zh: 最大列宽；0 不限制上限。
TableColumn.MaxWidth.en: Maximum column width; zero means no upper limit.

TableColumn.UI.zh: 仅支持 item 和 label，在表格的同名 UI 之后应用。
TableColumn.UI.en: Supports item and label only, applied after table-level UI for those parts.

TableColumn.Style.zh: 列单元格 item/label 的同步构建回调，在表格 Style 之后运行。
TableColumn.Style.en: Synchronous item/label callback for this column, applied after table Style.

TreeOptions.Label.zh: 树的辅助技术名称；空值继承 FormField.Label。
TreeOptions.Label.en: Accessible name of the tree; an empty value inherits FormField.Label.

TreeOptions.Height.zh: 默认 320 DIP，正文使用内部虚拟滚动。
TreeOptions.Height.en: Defaults to 320 DIP with internally virtualized scrolling.

TreeOptions.EmptyText.zh: 根列表为空时显示；空值使用当前语言的默认消息。
TreeOptions.EmptyText.en: Displayed when the root list is empty; an empty value uses the localized default.

TreeOptions.Color.zh: 默认 Primary；选中项使用该颜色，Neutral 使用 Highlighted，焦点轮廓使用 InvertedBackground。
TreeOptions.Color.en: Defaults to Primary. Selected text uses this color; Neutral uses Highlighted with an InvertedBackground focus outline.

TreeOptions.OnExpandedChange.zh: 用户操作实际改变展开状态后通知一次，参数为按字符串排序的展开 ID。取消、外部 SetExpanded 和初始化不通知。
TreeOptions.OnExpandedChange.en: Notifies once after a user action changes expansion, with expanded IDs sorted lexically. Cancellation, external SetExpanded and initialization are silent.

TreeOptions.BuildLeading.zh: 替换每行的默认前导图标；同步接收 TreeItemState，内容应无独立交互。
TreeOptions.BuildLeading.en: Replaces each row’s default leading icon; synchronously receives TreeItemState and should contain no independent interaction.

TreeOptions.BuildTrailing.zh: 替换每行的默认尾部图标；整行和方向键仍负责展开。内容应无独立交互。
TreeOptions.BuildTrailing.en: Replaces each row’s default trailing icon; row and arrow-key expansion remain available. Content should not introduce independent interaction.

TreeOptions.PropagateSelect.zh: 仅 Multiple=true 时生效：选择或取消父节点会影响已加载的可用后代，禁用节点阻断传播。
TreeOptions.PropagateSelect.en: Applies only with Multiple=true: selecting or deselecting a parent affects loaded, enabled descendants and stops at disabled nodes.

TreeOptions.BubbleSelect.zh: 仅 Multiple=true 时生效：根据可用子项更新父项。部分选中按后代混合状态判断；与 PropagateSelect 同开时优先采用此规则。
TreeOptions.BubbleSelect.en: Applies only with Multiple=true: updates parents from enabled children. Mixed state follows descendant selection and takes precedence when PropagateSelect is also enabled.

TreeOptions.UI.zh: 支持 root、list、item、leading、label、trailing、indicator、empty。indicator 是祖先竖线；item 是行内样式区域。
TreeOptions.UI.en: Supports root, list, item, leading, label, trailing, indicator and empty. indicator styles ancestor guides; item is the row’s styled surface.

TreeOptions.Style.zh: 当前构建的同步部件回调；不能保留 Element。节点 Style 最后应用于其支持的部件。
TreeOptions.Style.en: Synchronous callback for current-build parts; never retain Element. Node Style runs last for its supported parts.

TreeOptions.TrailingIcon.zh: 父分支默认 ChevronDown，展开旋转 180 度。节点 TrailingIcon 优先；已加载的空分支不补图标。
TreeOptions.TrailingIcon.en: Defaults to ChevronDown for parent branches, rotated 180 degrees when expanded. Node TrailingIcon takes precedence; loaded empty branches receive no fallback icon.

TreeOptions.OnLoad.zh: 未加载分支可见并展开时，以票据调用一次。后台工作由应用管理，结果通过 Window.Update 调用 CompleteLoad；不要保存构建期对象。
TreeOptions.OnLoad.en: Called once with a ticket when an unloaded branch is visible and expanded. The application owns background work and returns results via Window.Update/CompleteLoad; do not retain build objects.

TreeNode.UI.zh: 支持 item、leading、label、trailing，覆盖全局和树实例同名 UI；不改变祖先分组竖线。
TreeNode.UI.en: Supports item, leading, label and trailing, overriding theme and tree-instance UI. Does not change ancestor group guides.

TreeNode.Style.zh: 当前节点部件的同步回调，在树实例 Style 之后运行。
TreeNode.Style.en: Synchronous callback for this node’s parts, applied after tree-instance Style.

TreeNode.Icon.zh: 显式前导图标优先于默认文件夹；空值且分支有子项或尚未加载时补默认文件夹。BuildLeading 优先。
TreeNode.Icon.en: Explicit leading icon overrides fallback folders. With no icon, nonempty or unresolved branches get a folder. BuildLeading takes precedence.

TreeNode.TrailingIcon.zh: 显式尾部图标；分支展开时旋转，叶节点不旋转。BuildTrailing 优先。
TreeNode.TrailingIcon.en: Explicit trailing icon; rotates for expanded branches, not leaves. BuildTrailing takes precedence.

TreeNode.Children.zh: nil 表示普通叶节点，非 nil 空列表保留空分支语义；Lazy=true 且 Children=nil 时等待 OnLoad。
TreeNode.Children.en: Nil denotes a regular leaf; a non-nil empty slice retains empty-branch semantics. Lazy=true with nil Children waits for OnLoad.

TreeState.Outline.zh: 保存展开 ID、原生 List 滚动/焦点和 Indent；旧 Outline.Rows/Item/Depth 不再更新。
TreeState.Outline.en: Stores expanded IDs, native List scrolling/focus and Indent. Legacy Outline.Rows/Item/Depth are no longer populated.

TreeState.Selection.zh: 稳定节点 ID 集合；外部修改不触发 OnChange，SetNodes 清理不存在的 ID。
TreeState.Selection.en: Stable selected node IDs. External edits do not emit OnChange; SetNodes prunes missing IDs.

TreeState.Active.zh: 独立于选择的键盘高亮 ID；重排时保留，折叠后回到可见祖先。
TreeState.Active.en: Keyboard-highlight ID, separate from selection. Preserved on reorder and moved to a visible ancestor on collapse.

TreeState.RowBuilds.zh: 最后一次构建中的行回调数，用于观察虚拟化；不代表全部数据处理成本。
TreeState.RowBuilds.en: Row callback count in the last build, useful for observing virtualization; it does not measure all data-processing work.

TreeEvent.ID.zh: 本次选择或展开动作的稳定节点 ID。
TreeEvent.ID.en: Stable node ID for this selection or expansion action.

TreeEvent.Selected.en: Whether the node was selected before the action.

TreeEvent.Expanded.en: Whether the node was expanded before the action.

TreeItemState.ID.zh: 当前构建节点的稳定 ID。
TreeItemState.ID.en: Stable ID of the node being built.

TreeItemState.Level.zh: 从 1 开始的层级；TreeState.Depth 从 0 开始。

TreeItemState.Selected.zh: 当前构建中的选中状态。
TreeItemState.Selected.en: Selection state in the current build.

TreeItemState.Expanded.zh: 当前构建中的展开状态。
TreeItemState.Expanded.en: Expansion state in the current build.

TreeItemState.Indeterminate.zh: 多选联动的部分选中状态；单选或没有启用联动时为 false。
TreeItemState.Indeterminate.en: Mixed selection state for multiple-selection linkage; false in single mode or with no linkage enabled.

TreeItemState.Loading.zh: 该节点是否有正在等待的加载请求。
TreeItemState.Loading.en: Whether this node has a pending load request.

CommandPaletteOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用搜索输入、结果与本组件快捷键，并取消未完成搜索；已显示结果保留。
CommandPaletteOptions.Disabled.en: Disables input, results and component shortcuts; cancels pending search while retaining displayed results.

CommandPaletteOptions.Size.zh: 默认 MD，支持 XS–XL；同步搜索框、列表文字、图标与快捷键尺寸。
CommandPaletteOptions.Size.en: Defaults to MD; XS–XL size the input, result text, icons and key caps.

CommandPaletteOptions.SearchDelay.zh: 查询编辑后的等待时间，默认 0；首次打开、进入子级和 Refresh 立即搜索，旧请求立即取消。
CommandPaletteOptions.SearchDelay.en: Delay after query edits, default 0. Opening, entering children and Refresh search immediately; obsolete requests are canceled immediately.

CommandPaletteOptions.FilterFields.zh: 内置搜索字段：label、description、suffix、keywords；空列表使用全部四项，自定义 Search 不受影响。
CommandPaletteOptions.FilterFields.en: Built-in fields: label, description, suffix and keywords. Empty uses all four; custom Search is unaffected.

CommandPaletteOptions.IgnoreFilter.zh: 内置搜索不按查询词筛选，仍遵循当前子级与结果上限；默认 false。
CommandPaletteOptions.IgnoreFilter.en: Bypasses built-in query matching while retaining the current level and limit; default false.

CommandPaletteOptions.PreserveGroupOrder.zh: 默认 false，按最先匹配项排列分组；true 按索引中的分组顺序。组内保留搜索排序。
CommandPaletteOptions.PreserveGroupOrder.en: False orders groups by their first result; true preserves index group order. Results retain their rank within each group.

CommandPaletteOptions.Autofocus.zh: 默认 true，打开时聚焦搜索框；搜索框隐藏时聚焦结果列表。
CommandPaletteOptions.Autofocus.en: Defaults to true; focuses the search input on open, or the result list when the input is hidden.

CommandPaletteOptions.SearchInput.zh: 默认 true；隐藏搜索框后保留查询词及程序化搜索。
CommandPaletteOptions.SearchInput.en: Defaults to true. Hiding the input retains the query and programmatic search.

CommandPaletteOptions.SearchInputOptions.zh: 配置搜索 Input；默认 None 样式，尺寸继承面板。输入、提交和样式回调与组件行为组合执行。
CommandPaletteOptions.SearchInputOptions.en: Configures the search Input, defaulting to None and the palette size. Input, submit and style callbacks are chained with palette behavior.

CommandPaletteOptions.Back.zh: 默认 true，显示子级返回按钮；关闭只隐藏按钮，空搜索框的 Backspace 仍可返回。
CommandPaletteOptions.Back.en: Defaults to true for the nested back button. Hiding it does not disable empty-input Backspace navigation.

CommandPaletteOptions.BackOptions.zh: 配置独立返回按钮，默认 Neutral / LinkVariant；禁用状态与面板合并。
CommandPaletteOptions.BackOptions.en: Configures the separate back button, default Neutral/LinkVariant; disabled state is combined with the palette.

CommandPaletteOptions.ShowIcon.zh: 默认 true；控制默认搜索图标，SearchInputOptions 中的显式图标或头像仍优先。
CommandPaletteOptions.ShowIcon.en: Defaults to true; controls the fallback search icon. Explicit input icons or avatars take precedence.

CommandPaletteOptions.Icon.zh: 搜索图标，默认 Search；ShowIcon 可隐藏默认图标。
CommandPaletteOptions.Icon.en: Search icon, default Search; ShowIcon can hide the fallback.

CommandPaletteOptions.ChildrenIcon.zh: 子命令图标，默认 ChevronRight，RTL 默认镜像；显式图标保持原样。
CommandPaletteOptions.ChildrenIcon.en: Nested-action icon, default ChevronRight mirrored in RTL; explicit icons are unchanged.

CommandPaletteOptions.BackIcon.zh: 默认 ArrowLeft，RTL 默认镜像；BackOptions.Leading 优先。
CommandPaletteOptions.BackIcon.en: Defaults to ArrowLeft mirrored in RTL; BackOptions.Leading takes precedence.

CommandPaletteOptions.LoadingIcon.zh: 搜索及命令加载图标，默认 LoaderCircle。
CommandPaletteOptions.LoadingIcon.en: Search and action loading icon, default LoaderCircle.

CommandPaletteOptions.SelectedIcon.zh: 结果列表的选中指示图标；默认沿用 Listbox 的 Check。
CommandPaletteOptions.SelectedIcon.en: Selected-result indicator; inherits the Listbox Check default.

CommandPaletteOptions.Loading.zh: 额外显示搜索框加载外观，不禁用结果；实际搜索未完成时组件会阻止执行旧结果。
CommandPaletteOptions.Loading.en: Adds an input loading indicator without disabling results. Actual pending search prevents obsolete-result activation.

CommandPaletteOptions.Loop.zh: 默认 false，结果列表方向键到边界后停止。
CommandPaletteOptions.Loop.en: Defaults to false; arrow navigation stops at result boundaries.

CommandPaletteOptions.HighlightOnHover.zh: 默认 true，悬停更新键盘高亮。
CommandPaletteOptions.HighlightOnHover.en: Defaults to true; hovering updates the active result.

CommandPaletteOptions.EmptyText.zh: 空结果提示；未设置时使用组件语言目录。
CommandPaletteOptions.EmptyText.en: Empty-result text; defaults to the component message catalog.

CommandPaletteOptions.BuildEmpty.zh: 替换无结果且未加载、无错误时的内容；接收当前查询词。
CommandPaletteOptions.BuildEmpty.en: Replaces empty content when neither loading nor in error; receives the current query.

CommandPaletteOptions.OnSearchTermChange.zh: 用户编辑或子级导航清空查询时通知；外部赋值和 SetIndex 静默。
CommandPaletteOptions.OnSearchTermChange.en: Notifies query edits and query clearing during nested navigation; external assignments and SetIndex are silent.

CommandPaletteOptions.OnHighlight.zh: 列表键盘或悬停实际改变高亮 ID 时通知。
CommandPaletteOptions.OnHighlight.en: Reports actual active-ID changes from list keyboard or hover interaction.

CommandPaletteOptions.OnSelectEvent.zh: 叶命令执行前调用；PreventDefault 取消关闭和执行，单项处理器优先。
CommandPaletteOptions.OnSelectEvent.en: Runs before a leaf action; PreventDefault cancels closing and execution. An action handler takes precedence.

CommandPaletteOptions.CloseOnSelect.zh: 默认 true，执行叶命令前关闭；false 允许重复执行并保留面板。
CommandPaletteOptions.CloseOnSelect.en: Defaults to true, closing before leaf execution. False keeps the palette open for repeated execution.

CommandPaletteOptions.Search.zh: 自定义搜索入口；在 UI 线程交付 Results.Complete，换回调后调用 Refresh。此模式自行负责筛选。
CommandPaletteOptions.Search.en: Custom search entry point; deliver Results.Complete on the UI thread and call Refresh after replacing the callback. This mode owns filtering.

CommandPaletteOptions.Limit.zh: 默认 200，上限 1,000；内置搜索和结果显示均应用此限制。
CommandPaletteOptions.Limit.en: Defaults to 200, capped at 1,000; applies to built-in search and displayed results.

CommandPaletteOptions.UI.zh: Root 为模态面板，Panel 为结果容器，Editor 为搜索框，BackSlot 为返回按钮；其余为列表与单项部件。
CommandPaletteOptions.UI.en: Root styles the modal panel, Panel the results container, Editor the input and BackSlot the back button; other slots target list and item parts.

CommandPaletteOptions.Style.zh: 按当前构建的部件调用；不能长期保存收到的 Element。
CommandPaletteOptions.Style.en: Called for parts in the current build; received Elements must not be retained.

CommandAction.Prefix.zh: 标签前缀，仅显示，不参与默认搜索。
CommandAction.Prefix.en: Label prefix, display only; excluded from default search.

CommandAction.Suffix.zh: 标签后缀，参与默认搜索并显示匹配高亮。
CommandAction.Suffix.en: Label suffix, included in default search and match highlighting.

CommandAction.Placeholder.zh: 进入该子级后使用的搜索占位文字。
CommandAction.Placeholder.en: Search placeholder after entering this action’s children.

CommandAction.Kbds.zh: 独立快捷键键帽；非空时优先于旧 Shortcut 文本，不注册快捷键。
CommandAction.Kbds.en: Separate key caps; takes precedence over legacy Shortcut text and does not register shortcuts.

CommandAction.Avatar.zh: 命令头像；优先级为 Loading、Icon、Avatar、Chip。
CommandAction.Avatar.en: Action avatar; precedence is Loading, Icon, Avatar, then Chip.

CommandAction.Chip.zh: 命令状态圆点，未设置更高优先级内容时显示。
CommandAction.Chip.en: Action status dot, used when no higher-priority leading content exists.

CommandAction.Loading.zh: 显示加载图标；需要禁止执行时另设 Disabled。
CommandAction.Loading.en: Displays a loading icon; set Disabled separately to prevent execution.

CommandAction.Active.zh: 固定强调外观，不表示可多选的受控值。
CommandAction.Active.en: Persistent visual emphasis, not a controlled multiple-selection value.

CommandAction.OnSelectEvent.zh: 叶命令执行前的可取消回调，优先于全局处理器。
CommandAction.OnSelectEvent.en: Cancelable pre-execution callback for a leaf, overriding the palette handler.

CommandAction.UI.zh: 本命令的部件样式，在组件与实例样式之后应用。
CommandAction.UI.en: Action part styles, applied after component and instance styles.

CommandAction.Style.zh: 本命令当前构建的部件回调，不可保存 Element。
CommandAction.Style.en: Build-local action part callback; do not retain Elements.

CommandAction.Disabled.zh: 禁用该命令及其后代的执行快捷键。
CommandAction.Disabled.en: Disables the action and execution shortcuts for its descendants.

CommandMatch.Highlights.zh: 标签中的 Unicode rune 索引。
CommandMatch.Highlights.en: Unicode rune indexes in the label.

CommandMatch.DescriptionHighlights.zh: 描述中的 Unicode rune 索引。
CommandMatch.DescriptionHighlights.en: Unicode rune indexes in the description.

CommandMatch.SuffixHighlights.zh: 后缀中的 Unicode rune 索引。
CommandMatch.SuffixHighlights.en: Unicode rune indexes in the suffix.

CommandMatch.Action.zh: 匹配命令；索引返回的切片和映射应只读，数据改变时重建索引。
CommandMatch.Action.en: Matched action; treat indexed slices and maps as read-only and rebuild the index for changes.

CommandPaletteState.Open.zh: 显示状态；Close 立即取消，直接设 false 在下一次构建取消。
CommandPaletteState.Open.en: Visibility state; Close cancels immediately, while assigning false cancels on the next build.

CommandPaletteState.Query.zh: 当前层级查询词；直接赋值后在下一次构建搜索，不发送用户编辑通知。
CommandPaletteState.Query.en: Current-level query; direct changes search on the next build without emitting an edit callback.

CommandPaletteState.Results.zh: 仅在 UI 线程更新；过期票据、关闭或返回后的完成结果会被拒绝。
CommandPaletteState.Results.en: Update only on the UI thread; completions for obsolete, closed or exited-level tickets are rejected.

CommandEvent.ID.zh: 即将执行的叶命令 ID；PreventDefault 可取消执行。
CommandEvent.ID.en: ID of the leaf action about to execute; PreventDefault cancels execution.

NavigationOptions.Color.zh: 活动项颜色，默认 Primary；Neutral 使用 Highlighted 文字。
NavigationOptions.Color.en: Active color, default Primary; Neutral uses Highlighted text.

NavigationOptions.Variant.zh: 默认 Soft，对应 pill；LinkVariant 对应 link，没有活动背景。
NavigationOptions.Variant.en: Defaults to Soft (pill); LinkVariant maps to link without an active background.

NavigationOptions.Highlight.zh: 默认 false；横向活动项或纵向子项显示指示线，启用后省略活动 pill 背景。
NavigationOptions.Highlight.en: Defaults to false; adds a line to active horizontal items or vertical children and omits the active pill background.

NavigationOptions.HighlightColor.zh: 未设置时使用 Color；Neutral 使用 InvertedBackground。
NavigationOptions.HighlightColor.en: Defaults to Color; Neutral uses InvertedBackground.

NavigationOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用本导航及子菜单，合并祖先和 FormField 禁用状态。
NavigationOptions.Disabled.en: Disables navigation and submenus, including inherited and FormField disabled states.

NavigationOptions.Compact.zh: 仅纵向生效；有图标或头像时隐藏文字，无配件时保留名称。
NavigationOptions.Compact.en: Only applies vertically; hides text when an icon or avatar exists, otherwise retains the label.

NavigationOptions.Single.zh: 默认 false，纵向同级分支可同时展开；true 限制每级展开一项。
NavigationOptions.Single.en: Defaults to false for multiple open siblings; true limits each vertical level to one open branch.

NavigationOptions.Collapsible.zh: 默认 true；Single 模式下 false 禁止收起唯一展开分支。
NavigationOptions.Collapsible.en: Defaults to true; false prevents closing the open branch in Single mode.

NavigationOptions.TrailingIcon.zh: 分支箭头，单项设置优先；默认关闭向下、打开向上，显式图标不旋转。
NavigationOptions.TrailingIcon.en: Branch arrow, overridden per item; defaults down when closed and up when open. Explicit icons are not rotated.

NavigationOptions.Tooltip.zh: 紧凑纵向提示默认 true，为原生默认值；单项 Optional 可覆盖。
NavigationOptions.Tooltip.en: Compact vertical hints default to true as a native convention; per-item Optional values override it.

NavigationOptions.Popover.zh: 紧凑纵向弹层默认 true；单项 Optional 可覆盖。false 保留原生的行内展开方式。
NavigationOptions.Popover.en: Compact vertical popovers default to true with per-item Optional overrides. False retains native inline expansion.

NavigationOptions.TooltipOptions.zh: 提示配置；紧凑模式未设置位置和延时时使用阅读方向末端、0 延时。
NavigationOptions.TooltipOptions.en: Tooltip configuration; compact defaults fill unset placement and delay with the trailing side and zero delay.

NavigationOptions.PopoverOptions.zh: 完整侧向弹层配置；未传时使用 Hover、224 DIP 宽、150 毫秒关闭延时。传入后使用其 Mode 与 Placement 零值语义。
NavigationOptions.PopoverOptions.en: Complete side-popover configuration. Without it: Hover, 224 DIP width, 150 ms close delay. Supplied Mode and Placement retain their zero-value semantics.

NavigationOptions.PopupPlacement.zh: 显式设置时优先于全局及单项 PopoverOptions.Placement。
NavigationOptions.PopupPlacement.en: When set, takes precedence over global and item PopoverOptions.Placement.

NavigationOptions.OnSelect.zh: 叶项导航前的可取消回调；单项处理器优先，PreventDefault 保留活动 ID 和当前菜单。
NavigationOptions.OnSelect.en: Cancelable callback before leaf navigation; an item handler takes precedence. PreventDefault retains the active ID and menu.

NavigationOptions.OnNavigate.zh: 成功激活叶项时通知；重复选择当前项也调用，父项只展开。
NavigationOptions.OnNavigate.en: Reports successful leaf activation, including repeated activation of the current item; parents only expand.

NavigationOptions.OnExpandedChange.zh: 用户展开或收起后返回全部已展开 ID，按 ID 排序；初始化与外部改值静默。
NavigationOptions.OnExpandedChange.en: Reports all open IDs sorted by ID after user expansion changes; initialization and external edits are silent.

NavigationOptions.UI.zh: Root 仅为本组件根；List 为子级列表、Body 为单项容器、Item 为可操作项，Panel 为弹层。
NavigationOptions.UI.en: Root is the component root; List styles nested lists, Body the item container, Item the trigger and Panel the popup.

NavigationOptions.Style.zh: 当前构建的部件回调；Element 不可长期保存。
NavigationOptions.Style.en: Build-local part callback; Elements must not be retained.

NavigationItem.Avatar.zh: 首部头像，优先于 Icon；未设置尺寸时为 20 DIP。
NavigationItem.Avatar.en: Leading avatar before Icon; defaults to 20 DIP when its size is unset.

NavigationItem.Badge.zh: 末端徽章文字，可用字符串 0；紧凑模式隐藏。
NavigationItem.Badge.en: Trailing badge text, including the string 0; hidden in compact mode.

NavigationItem.BadgeOptions.zh: 徽章配置，默认 SM / Neutral / Outline，与 Badge 文字组合。
NavigationItem.BadgeOptions.en: Badge configuration, default SM/Neutral/Outline, combined with Badge text.

NavigationItem.Chip.zh: 包裹 Icon 的状态圆点，默认 SM；Inset 使用实际字段值，需要上游外观时显式 true。
NavigationItem.Chip.en: Status chip wrapping Icon, default SM; honors Inset. Set it true for upstream inset placement.

NavigationItem.TrailingIcon.zh: 单项末端图标；紧凑模式隐藏，优先于根分支图标。
NavigationItem.TrailingIcon.en: Per-item trailing icon, hidden when compact and overriding the root branch icon.

NavigationItem.Active.zh: 额外活动外观，不修改应用的 active ID。
NavigationItem.Active.en: Additional active styling without changing the application active ID.

NavigationItem.DefaultOpen.zh: 仅首次出现时初始化纵向展开；已有 Expanded 值优先。
NavigationItem.DefaultOpen.en: Initial vertical expansion for a new item; existing Expanded entries take precedence.

NavigationItem.LabelOnly.zh: 静态组标题，仅在展开的纵向导航显示，不参与导航和键盘焦点。
NavigationItem.LabelOnly.en: Static group label shown only in expanded vertical navigation; excluded from navigation and keyboard focus.

NavigationItem.Tooltip.zh: 单项提示开关，显式 false 可覆盖全局；横向提示由此启用。
NavigationItem.Tooltip.en: Per-item hint toggle, including false to override global settings; enables horizontal hints.

NavigationItem.Popover.zh: 单项紧凑弹层开关，显式 false 可覆盖全局。
NavigationItem.Popover.en: Per-item compact popover toggle, including false to override the global value.

NavigationItem.TooltipOptions.zh: 单项完整提示配置，优先于全局。
NavigationItem.TooltipOptions.en: Complete per-item tooltip configuration, overriding global settings.

NavigationItem.PopoverOptions.zh: 单项完整侧向弹层配置，优先于全局；根 PopupPlacement 可进一步覆盖位置。
NavigationItem.PopoverOptions.en: Complete per-item side-popover configuration; root PopupPlacement can still override placement.

NavigationItem.OnSelect.zh: 叶项导航前的可取消事件，优先于根处理器。
NavigationItem.OnSelect.en: Cancelable pre-navigation event for a leaf, overriding the root handler.

NavigationItem.UI.zh: 单项部件样式，在组件与实例样式之后应用。
NavigationItem.UI.en: Item part styles, applied after component and instance styles.

NavigationItem.Style.zh: 单项当前构建的部件回调，不可保存 Element。
NavigationItem.Style.en: Build-local item part callback; do not retain Elements.

NavigationItem.Group.zh: 纵向组标题，同级连续同名项目只显示一次；横向和紧凑模式隐藏。
NavigationItem.Group.en: Vertical group title, shown once for consecutive same-group siblings; hidden horizontally and when compact.

NavigationState.Expanded.zh: 各层纵向分支的展开状态，应用可直接读写；直接改值不会发送 OnExpandedChange。
NavigationState.Expanded.en: Vertical expansion across levels; the application can edit it directly without OnExpandedChange.

NavigationEvent.ID.zh: 即将导航的叶项 ID；PreventDefault 可取消。
NavigationEvent.ID.en: Destination leaf ID; PreventDefault cancels navigation.

DrawerOptions.Handle.zh: 默认 true；独立于 Header 显示，false 隐藏并取消进行中的拖拽，Snap 仍可由应用设置。
DrawerOptions.Handle.en: Defaults to true, independent of Header. False hides it and cancels an active drag; the application can still set Snap.

DrawerOptions.Inset.zh: 默认 false；开启后四周保留 16 DIP 外边距，停靠比例按剩余高度计算。
DrawerOptions.Inset.en: Defaults to false. Adds 16 DIP margins and computes snap fractions from the remaining height.

DrawerOptions.SnapPoints.zh: 严格递增的高度比例，范围 (0,1]；空列表默认 0.5 / 0.85，不支持 px 字符串。
DrawerOptions.SnapPoints.en: Strictly ascending height fractions in (0,1]; empty defaults to 0.5/0.85. Pixel strings are unsupported.

DrawerOptions.DismissDistance.zh: 关闭拖动的距离阈值，默认 80 DIP；0 使用默认值，必须有限且非负。还需达到速度条件；低于最小停靠高度一半也可关闭。
DrawerOptions.DismissDistance.en: Dismissal drag-distance threshold, default 80 DIP; 0 uses the default and values must be finite and non-negative. The speed condition also applies; dropping below half the minimum stop can close independently.

DrawerOptions.DismissVelocity.zh: 关闭拖动的速度阈值，默认 900 DIP/s；0 使用默认值，必须有限且非负。
DrawerOptions.DismissVelocity.en: Dismissal velocity threshold, default 900 DIP/s; 0 uses the default and values must be finite and non-negative.

DrawerOptions.OnSnap.zh: 仅用户操作实际改变停靠索引时通知；边界重复按键、回到原停靠点及外部改值静默。
DrawerOptions.OnSnap.en: Reports actual user changes to the snap index. Repeated boundary keys, returning to the same stop and external changes are silent.

DrawerOptions.CloseButton.zh: 默认 false；传入 Close 配置时默认显示，显式 false 仍优先。
DrawerOptions.CloseButton.en: Defaults to false; supplying Close enables it unless explicitly set false.

DrawerOptions.Footer.zh: 默认纵向排列，与标题、正文一起在 ContainerSlot 内滚动；应用自行关闭不会发送 OnClose。
DrawerOptions.Footer.en: Defaults to a column that scrolls with the header and body inside ContainerSlot. Application-driven closing does not emit OnClose.

DrawerOptions.UI.zh: Panel 为面板，ContainerSlot 为整体滚动内容，Thumb 为拖动区域，Indicator 为可见指示条；另有 Backdrop、Header、Label、Description、Body、Footer、Close。
DrawerOptions.UI.en: Panel styles the sheet, ContainerSlot its scrollable content, Thumb the drag target and Indicator the visible bar; also Backdrop, Header, Label, Description, Body, Footer and Close.

DrawerOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前构建的部件，不能保存 Element；与 UI 相同的部件范围。
DrawerOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures current-build parts, using the same slots as UI; do not retain Elements.

DrawerOptions.Width.zh: 共享 ModalOptions 字段；底部 Drawer 宽度由窗口及 Inset 决定，此字段不生效。
DrawerOptions.Width.en: Shared ModalOptions field; bottom Drawer width comes from the window and Inset, so this field is unused.

DrawerOptions.MaxHeight.zh: 共享字段不生效；高度由 SnapPoints / Snap 和可用窗口高度决定。
DrawerOptions.MaxHeight.en: Unused shared field; height comes from SnapPoints/Snap and available window height.

DrawerOptions.Fullscreen.zh: 共享字段不生效；需要接近全高时配置 SnapPoints，再按 Inset 决定边距。
DrawerOptions.Fullscreen.en: Unused shared field; configure SnapPoints for near-full height and Inset for margins.

DrawerState.Open.zh: 显示状态；显式赋值不会发送 OnClose。关闭期间仍需调用组件以完成动画和焦点恢复。
DrawerState.Open.en: Visibility; explicit assignments do not emit OnClose. Keep rendering during close for animation and focus restoration.

DrawerState.Snap.zh: 从 0 开始的停靠索引；构建时限制到有效范围，外部赋值不发送 OnSnap。
DrawerState.Snap.en: Zero-based snap index, clamped to the valid range during construction; external assignments do not emit OnSnap.

FileUploadOptions.Label.zh: 区域标题及可访问名称；空值使用 FormField 标签或本地化选择名称。
FileUploadOptions.Label.en: Area label and accessible name; empty uses the FormField label or localized picker name.

FileUploadOptions.ChooseLabel.zh: 显式选择按钮名称；默认使用本地化 Choose files。
FileUploadOptions.ChooseLabel.en: Explicit picker button label; defaults to localized Choose files.

FileUploadOptions.Disabled.zh: 禁用选择、拖放和文件动作；同时继承父容器与 FormField 禁用，取消待完成选择并丢弃迟到结果，不自动取消应用传输。
FileUploadOptions.Disabled.en: Disables selection, drops and file actions; inherits parent/FormField disabled, cancels pending selection and discards late results. Application transfers are not canceled automatically.

FileUploadOptions.Icon.zh: 上传区域或选择按钮的图标；默认 Upload。
FileUploadOptions.Icon.en: Upload area or picker button icon; defaults to Upload.

FileUploadOptions.ShowIcon.zh: 默认 true；false 隐藏上传入口图标，不影响文件图标。
FileUploadOptions.ShowIcon.en: Defaults to true; false hides the picker icon without hiding file icons.

FileUploadOptions.FileIcon.zh: 文件预览的回退图标，默认 File；不会读取文件内容。
FileUploadOptions.FileIcon.en: Fallback file preview icon, default File; no file contents are read.

FileUploadOptions.FileImage.zh: 默认 true，允许显示 UploadFile.Avatar；false 只显示 FileIcon。应用负责加载图片及资源寿命。
FileUploadOptions.FileImage.en: Defaults to true, showing UploadFile.Avatar when supplied; false uses FileIcon. The application loads images and owns their lifetime.

FileUploadOptions.FileDelete.zh: 默认 true；隐藏移除按钮不影响正在上传时的取消动作。
FileUploadOptions.FileDelete.en: Defaults to true; hiding removal does not hide the cancel action for running uploads.

FileUploadOptions.FileDeleteOptions.zh: 移除按钮配置；未指定字段继承默认值：网格 Neutral / Solid / XS，列表 Neutral / LinkVariant / 组件尺寸。
FileUploadOptions.FileDeleteOptions.en: Removal button settings; unspecified values retain defaults: grid Neutral/Solid/XS, list Neutral/LinkVariant/component size.

FileUploadOptions.FileDeleteIcon.zh: 移除按钮的回退图标，默认 X；FileDeleteOptions 的 Leading / Trailing 优先。
FileUploadOptions.FileDeleteIcon.en: Removal icon fallback, default X; Leading/Trailing in FileDeleteOptions takes precedence.

FileUploadOptions.Highlight.zh: 默认 false；高亮区域边框，Neutral 使用反色。FormField 错误优先使用错误色。
FileUploadOptions.Highlight.en: Defaults to false; highlights the area border, using inverted color for Neutral. FormField errors take precedence.

FileUploadOptions.Position.zh: 默认 UploadOutside；UploadInside 将列表放进选择区域，只在 UploadArea / UploadList 生效。
FileUploadOptions.Position.en: Defaults to UploadOutside; UploadInside places the list in the area, only for UploadArea/UploadList.

FileUploadOptions.Variant.zh: 默认 UploadArea；UploadButton 仅显示选择按钮，仍使用原生队列模型。
FileUploadOptions.Variant.en: Defaults to UploadArea; UploadButton shows a picker button while retaining the native queue model.

FileUploadOptions.Layout.zh: 默认 UploadGrid；网格保留文件名、状态和进度，UploadList 使用横向文件行。示例默认列表。
FileUploadOptions.Layout.en: Defaults to UploadGrid; cards retain names, status and progress; UploadList uses horizontal file rows. The example uses a list.

FileUploadOptions.Interactive.zh: 默认 true；可点击区域支持 Enter/Space。false 显示独立选择按钮；UploadButton 始终使用按钮。这是原生显式入口约定。
FileUploadOptions.Interactive.en: Defaults to true with Enter/Space activation. False shows a separate picker button; UploadButton always uses a button. This is the native explicit-entry convention.

FileUploadOptions.Dropzone.zh: 默认 true；仅 UploadArea 接收拖放并显示虚线边框。false 不注册文件拖放目标，使用实线。
FileUploadOptions.Dropzone.en: Defaults to true; only UploadArea accepts drops and draws a dashed border. False does not register a drop target and uses a solid border.

FileUploadOptions.Preview.zh: 默认 true；false 只隐藏列表，不清空文件或取消上传。
FileUploadOptions.Preview.en: Defaults to true; false hides the list without clearing files or canceling uploads.

FileUploadOptions.Rules.zh: 检查扩展名/MIME、大小和数量；拒绝项保留原因，不占 MaxFiles 接受数量。不会自动转换为 Dialog.Filters。
FileUploadOptions.Rules.en: Checks extension/MIME, size and count; rejected rows retain reasons and do not consume the MaxFiles limit. Does not automatically populate Dialog.Filters.

FileUploadOptions.Dialog.zh: 原生选择框配置；Multiple 默认 false，仅限制单次选择，队列仍累加。设置 Parent 绑定窗口。Choose 存在时忽略此配置。
FileUploadOptions.Dialog.en: Native dialog options; Multiple defaults to false and controls one selection, while the queue accumulates. Set Parent to attach a window. Ignored when Choose is supplied.

FileUploadOptions.Choose.zh: 后台替代选择器；只返回数据，不能修改 UI。nil 使用原生对话框；空结果为取消，错误写入 State.Error，不改变队列。
FileUploadOptions.Choose.en: Worker override returning data without mutating UI. Nil uses the OS dialog; empty means cancellation, errors populate State.Error without changing the queue.

FileUploadOptions.OnChange.zh: 选择或移除实际改变列表时通知一次，传入列表副本；取消、重复、选择错误及应用直接 Add/Remove/Report 不通知。
FileUploadOptions.OnChange.en: Notifies once when selection/removal changes the list, with a slice copy. Cancellation, duplicates, picker errors and direct application Add/Remove/Report are silent.

FileUploadOptions.OnReject.zh: 本次选择或拖放新增拒绝项时通知一次，先于 OnChange；队列保留拒绝项及本地化原因。
FileUploadOptions.OnReject.en: Notifies once for newly rejected selection/drop entries, before OnChange; rejected rows and localized reasons stay in the queue.

FileUploadOptions.OnCancel.zh: 用户取消正在传输的文件时通知 ID；取消后聚焦选择入口。应用直接 Cancel 不通知。
FileUploadOptions.OnCancel.en: Reports the ID when the user cancels a running transfer and returns focus to the picker. Direct Cancel is silent.

FileUploadOptions.OnRemove.zh: 用户移除后通知 ID，先发送 OnChange，再发送 OnRemove；焦点回到选择入口。
FileUploadOptions.OnRemove.en: Reports the removed ID after OnChange and returns focus to the picker.

FileUploadOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Body、Leading、Label、Description、Trigger、List、Item、ItemLeadingSlot、ItemLabelSlot、StatusSlot、ErrorSlot、ItemTrailingSlot；样式不会关闭交互。
FileUploadOptions.UI.en: Supports Root, Body, Leading, Label, Description, Trigger, List, Item, ItemLeadingSlot, ItemLabelSlot, StatusSlot, ErrorSlot and ItemTrailingSlot; styles do not disable behavior.

FileUploadOptions.Style.zh: 当前构建部件回调，在主题和实例 UI 后执行；不要保存 Element。
FileUploadOptions.Style.en: Current-build part callback after theme and instance UI; never retain Element.

UploadRules.Accept.zh: 扩展名、MIME 或 MIME 类别列表；支持逗号分隔条目、*、*/*、复合后缀及忽略大小写。空或全空白允许所有类型。
UploadRules.Accept.en: Extensions, MIME types or MIME groups; supports comma-separated entries, *, */*, compound suffixes and case-insensitive matching. Empty/blank accepts all.

UploadRules.MaxBytes.zh: 单文件字节上限；非正数不限制。
UploadRules.MaxBytes.en: Per-file byte limit; nonpositive means unlimited.

UploadRules.MaxFiles.zh: 已接受文件总数上限，非正数不限制；拒绝项不计入，失败和取消的已接受项仍计入。
UploadRules.MaxFiles.en: Accepted queue count limit; nonpositive means unlimited. Rejected rows do not count; failed/canceled accepted rows still count.

UploadFile.Avatar.zh: 应用提供的图片、文字或图标配件；FileImage=false 时不显示。组件不自行加载图片。
UploadFile.Avatar.en: Application-provided image, text or icon accessory, hidden by FileImage=false. The component does not load images.

ChartOptions.Label.zh: 图表可访问名称；空值使用系列/扇区标签，仍为空则使用本地化图表名称。
ChartOptions.Label.en: Accessible chart name; defaults to series/slice labels, then the localized chart name.

ChartOptions.Description.zh: 供辅助技术读取的较长说明，不替代动态数据状态文字。
ChartOptions.Description.en: Longer accessible description, separate from the dynamic value status.

ChartOptions.Height.zh: 默认 300 DIP；正值优先，否则可由 AspectRatio 计算。坐标区采用此高度，图例、标题和状态文字另占空间。
ChartOptions.Height.en: Defaults to 300 DIP. Positive values take precedence over AspectRatio. The plot/axes use this height; legends, titles and status text occupy additional space.

ChartOptions.Width.zh: 正值固定组件宽度，0 或负值跟随父容器；所有尺寸必须有限。
ChartOptions.Width.en: Positive values set a fixed component width; nonpositive follows its container. Dimensions must be finite.

ChartOptions.AspectRatio.zh: Height 未设置或非正时，用实际宽度除以该正数计算图表高度；首次未测量宽度暂用 640。
ChartOptions.AspectRatio.en: When Height is nonpositive, a positive ratio derives height from measured width; the first unmeasured frame uses 640.

ChartOptions.XAxis.zh: 默认 true；控制非径向图的 X 刻度与 XLabel，不影响数据或网格。
ChartOptions.XAxis.en: Defaults to true; shows Cartesian X ticks and XLabel without changing data or the grid.

ChartOptions.YAxis.zh: 默认 true；控制非径向图的 Y 刻度与 YLabel，不影响数据或网格。
ChartOptions.YAxis.en: Defaults to true; shows Cartesian Y ticks and YLabel without changing data or the grid.

ChartOptions.XLabel.zh: 非径向图的横轴标题；仅 XAxis 开启时显示。
ChartOptions.XLabel.en: Cartesian X-axis title, shown only when XAxis is enabled.

ChartOptions.YLabel.zh: 非径向图的纵轴标题，在图表上方横向显示；仅 YAxis 开启时显示。
ChartOptions.YLabel.en: Cartesian Y-axis title displayed horizontally above the plot, only when YAxis is enabled.

ChartOptions.Points.zh: 默认 false；在折线上显示采样后的数据点，尺寸由 PointSize 控制；不影响散点图或当前焦点标记。
ChartOptions.Points.en: Defaults to false; draws sampled line points using PointSize. Does not affect scatter marks or the focused-value marker.

ChartOptions.Colors.zh: 可选原生颜色列表；单项显式 Color 优先。未提供时用默认六色；后续轮次按 0.65 比例与背景混色，使用原生色彩插值。
ChartOptions.Colors.en: Optional native palette; explicit item Color takes precedence. Defaults to six colors; later cycles blend with the background using a 0.65 factor and native interpolation.

ChartOptions.Legend.zh: 未设置时仅在系列或扇区总数大于 1 时显示，包含隐藏和零值项目。显式 true/false 优先。
ChartOptions.Legend.en: When unset, shows only for more than one series/slice, including hidden and zero-value items. Explicit true/false takes precedence.

ChartOptions.Tooltip.zh: 默认 true；显示当前焦点值的文本提示。false 不取消焦点、状态文字或选择通知。
ChartOptions.Tooltip.en: Defaults to true; shows a text tooltip for focused values. False preserves focus, status text and selection events.

ChartOptions.TooltipOptions.zh: 提示配置；默认 TopCenter、偏移 12、无延时。Open 指针如需设置必须持久保存。
ChartOptions.TooltipOptions.en: Tooltip options; defaults to TopCenter, offset 12 and no delay. An Open pointer must refer to persistent state.

ChartOptions.Thickness.zh: 圆环厚度，默认 24 DIP；负值限制为 0，0 为空心环边界重合。显式 DonutInnerRadius 优先。
ChartOptions.Thickness.en: Donut ring thickness, default 24 DIP. Negative clamps to zero; zero makes inner/outer boundaries coincide. Explicit DonutInnerRadius takes precedence.

ChartOptions.DonutInnerRadius.zh: 显式内半径比例优先于 Thickness，限制在 0–0.95；不设置时按 Thickness 计算，不再固定为 0.6。
ChartOptions.DonutInnerRadius.en: Explicit inner-radius fraction overrides Thickness and clamps to 0–0.95. Unset derives from Thickness instead of a fixed 0.6.

ChartOptions.Center.zh: 当前构建中的中心内容回调，覆盖绘图区且不拦截指针；可用于圆环文字。不能保存 Element 或 Context。
ChartOptions.Center.en: Current-build center content over the plot, ignoring pointer input; useful for donut text. Never retain Element or Context.

ChartOptions.OnFocusChange.zh: 用户移动指针或键盘改变焦点行/扇区时通知；重复边界按键不重复通知。参数是 ChartSelection。
ChartOptions.OnFocusChange.en: Reports a changed focused X row/slice after pointer or keyboard input; repeated boundary keys are silent. Receives ChartSelection.

ChartOptions.OnSelect.zh: 点击图表或聚焦后按 Enter/Space 时通知，重复激活可再次通知。没有焦点时 Index=-1。
ChartOptions.OnSelect.en: Reports a chart click or Enter/Space activation while focused; repeated activations notify again. Index is -1 when nothing is focused.

ChartOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Body、Description、EmptySlot、List、Item、Label、Indicator、XAxisSlot、YAxisSlot、CenterSlot；提示样式由 TooltipOptions 配置。
ChartOptions.UI.en: Supports Root, Body, Description, EmptySlot, List, Item, Label, Indicator, XAxisSlot, YAxisSlot and CenterSlot. TooltipOptions controls tooltip styles.

ChartSelection.Index.zh: X 行或原始扇区列表的索引；-1 表示没有焦点。
ChartSelection.Index.en: Index in the X rows or original slice list; -1 means no focus.

ChartSelection.SliceID.zh: 扇区稳定 ID；直角坐标图或无焦点时为空。
ChartSelection.SliceID.en: Stable radial slice ID; empty for Cartesian charts or no focus.

CarouselOptions.Label.zh: 轮播的应用名称，用于视口、前后按钮和播放按钮的可访问名称。
CarouselOptions.Label.en: Application label used for accessible viewport, navigation and playback names.

CarouselOptions.Height.zh: 视口默认 180 DIP，必须有限；非正值使用默认值。控制行另占空间。
CarouselOptions.Height.en: Viewport height, default 180 DIP; must be finite. Nonpositive uses the default. Controls occupy additional space.

CarouselOptions.Active.zh: 默认 true，只门控自动播放；false 不禁用手动导航。滚出或被裁剪出可见区域、保持挂载的隐藏面板已会停止自动播放；窗口不活动或应用以其他方式遮挡时使用。不同于 Embla active。
CarouselOptions.Active.en: Defaults to true and only gates autoplay; false preserves manual navigation. Scrolling or clipping out of view and hidden kept-mounted panels already stop autoplay; use it for window inactivity or other hiding, such as covering. Differs from Embla active.

CarouselOptions.Autoplay.zh: 正值为翻页间隔；非正值关闭。悬停、组件内焦点、禁用、不可见、Paused 或减少动态效果时暂停；不会创建后台定时任务。
CarouselOptions.Autoplay.en: Positive duration sets the interval; nonpositive disables autoplay. Hover, focus within the component, disabled, hidden, Paused or reduced motion stops scheduling; no background timer jobs.

CarouselOptions.Wrap.zh: 默认 false；循环按钮、键盘和自动播放，拖拽始终有边界。false 时自动播放停在末项，不自动回到首项。
CarouselOptions.Wrap.en: Defaults to false; loops buttons, keys and autoplay, while dragging remains bounded. Without wrapping, autoplay stops at the final slide.

CarouselOptions.Arrows.zh: 默认 false；显示圆形 Outline / Neutral 前后按钮，固定在视口内侧 16 DIP。空列表不显示。
CarouselOptions.Arrows.en: Defaults to false; round Outline/Neutral navigation buttons sit 16 DIP inside the viewport. Hidden for empty lists.

CarouselOptions.Dots.zh: 默认 false；每项一个定位按钮，当前项有选中状态。原生按钮不是完整 ARIA tablist。
CarouselOptions.Dots.en: Defaults to false; one seek button per item with selected state. Native buttons do not implement the full ARIA tablist pattern.

CarouselOptions.Prev.zh: 前一项按钮配置。默认 Outline / Neutral，未指定尺寸遵循 Button 默认值；边界禁用优先，显式配件可以替代默认箭头。
CarouselOptions.Prev.en: Previous button options. Defaults to Outline/Neutral; unspecified size follows Button defaults. Boundary disabling wins; explicit accessories can replace the fallback arrow.

CarouselOptions.Next.zh: 后一项按钮配置，默认规则同 Prev。
CarouselOptions.Next.en: Next button options with the same defaults as Prev.

CarouselOptions.PrevIcon.zh: 前一项回退图标；默认 ArrowLeft，RTL 为 ArrowRight，纵向为 ArrowUp。Prev 的显式 Leading / Trailing 优先。 显式图标保持原样，示例自行按方向选择。
CarouselOptions.PrevIcon.en: Previous fallback icon: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight in RTL, ArrowUp vertically. Explicit Leading/Trailing in Prev wins. Explicit icons are rendered as supplied; the example chooses them by direction.

CarouselOptions.NextIcon.zh: 后一项回退图标；默认 ArrowRight，RTL 为 ArrowLeft，纵向为 ArrowDown。Next 的显式 Leading / Trailing 优先。 显式图标保持原样，示例自行按方向选择。
CarouselOptions.NextIcon.en: Next fallback icon: ArrowRight, ArrowLeft in RTL, ArrowDown vertically. Explicit Leading/Trailing in Next wins. Explicit icons are rendered as supplied; the example chooses them by direction.

CarouselOptions.WatchDrag.zh: 默认 true；false 不注册拖动，不影响键盘、箭头、圆点与自动播放。切换方向会取消进行中的拖拽。
CarouselOptions.WatchDrag.en: Defaults to true; false does not register dragging and preserves keys, arrows, dots and autoplay. Direction changes cancel an ongoing drag.

CarouselOptions.StopOnInteraction.zh: 默认 true；Autoplay>0 时箭头、键盘和完成拖拽将 Paused 设为 true，需 Play 恢复。false 保留原来的交互后自动恢复策略；圆点只定位。
CarouselOptions.StopOnInteraction.en: Defaults to true; with Autoplay>0, arrows, keys and completed drags set Paused=true until Play. False retains automatic resumption after interaction. Dots only seek.

CarouselOptions.OnChange.zh: 用户操作或自动播放实际改变索引时通知一次；外部赋值、列表删除造成的索引限制和重复边界操作不通知。
CarouselOptions.OnChange.en: Notifies once when user input or autoplay changes the index. Direct changes, clamping after deletion and repeated boundary actions are silent.

CarouselOptions.UI.zh: 支持 Root、Body、Item、Previous、Next、Actions、List、Indicator、Trigger、EmptySlot；List 是圆点行，Trigger 是播放/暂停按钮。
CarouselOptions.UI.en: Supports Root, Body, Item, Previous, Next, Actions, List, Indicator, Trigger and EmptySlot. List is the dots row; Trigger is the play/pause button.

CarouselItem.UI.zh: 单项仅支持 Item 部件，在组件主题与实例样式之后应用。
CarouselItem.UI.en: Per-item Item part only, applied after component theme and instance styles.

CarouselItem.Style.zh: 当前构建的 Item 回调，在组件 Style 后执行；不要保留 Element。
CarouselItem.Style.en: Current-build Item callback after the component Style; do not retain Element.

CarouselItem.Build.zh: 同步构建当前或相邻页；相邻页禁用交互，但仍执行回调。应用数据需持久保存，业务操作通过动作触发。
CarouselItem.Build.en: Synchronously builds the current or neighboring page. Neighbors are disabled but still built. Persist application data and trigger work through actions.

CarouselState.Index.zh: 从 0 开始的位置；删除后自动限制到有效范围，重排后由应用决定索引。直接设置不发送 OnChange。
CarouselState.Index.en: Zero-based position, clamped after deletion. The application decides the index after reordering. Direct assignment does not emit OnChange.

MarqueeOptions.Label.zh: 原生可访问名称；滚动区域可聚焦并按 Space 暂停。
MarqueeOptions.Label.en: Native accessible name; focus the region and press Space to pause.

MarqueeOptions.Orientation.zh: 默认 Horizontal。Vertical 字段为 true 时也使用纵向；水平运动随 RTL 镜像。
MarqueeOptions.Orientation.en: Defaults to Horizontal. Vertical=true also selects vertical layout; horizontal movement mirrors in RTL.

MarqueeOptions.Vertical.zh: 兼容的纵向开关，与 Orientation=Vertical 取或。
MarqueeOptions.Vertical.en: Legacy vertical switch, combined with Orientation=Vertical using OR.

MarqueeOptions.Reverse.zh: 默认 false；在当前语言方向的基础上反转运动。
MarqueeOptions.Reverse.en: Defaults to false; reverses motion relative to the current text direction.

MarqueeOptions.PauseOnHover.zh: 默认 false。开启后悬停暂停；焦点和 Paused 始终暂停。
MarqueeOptions.PauseOnHover.en: Defaults to false. Hover pauses when enabled; focus and Paused always pause.

MarqueeOptions.Repeat.zh: 未设置为 4，显式 0 不构建内容，负数无效。每次构建会调用内容回调 Repeat 次，单份内容滚动时可能留白。网站预览限 0–100。
MarqueeOptions.Repeat.en: Unset means four; explicit zero builds no content and negative values are invalid. The callback runs Repeat times per build; one copy may leave a gap. Website previews allow 0–100.

MarqueeOptions.Speed.zh: 原生速度，单位 DIP/秒；非正值采用默认 32，必须有限。上游 CSS 默认每周期 20 秒。暂停请用状态或 Active。
MarqueeOptions.Speed.en: Native speed in DIP/s; nonpositive values use 32 and values must be finite. Upstream CSS defaults to 20 seconds per cycle. Pause through state or Active.

MarqueeOptions.Gap.zh: 内容项目及相邻副本的默认间距，非正值使用主题缩放后的 64 DIP，必须有限。Body.Gap 可单独覆盖内部项目间距。
MarqueeOptions.Gap.en: Default item/copy gap; nonpositive values use theme-scaled 64 DIP and values must be finite. Body.Gap separately overrides item spacing.

MarqueeOptions.Height.zh: 容器高度，非正值使用 44 DIP，必须有限；纵向时应用应留出足够高度。
MarqueeOptions.Height.en: Container height; nonpositive values use 44 DIP and values must be finite. Allow enough space for vertical content.

MarqueeOptions.Active.zh: 未设置为 true；false 停止动画调度，手动暂停状态保留。滚出或被裁剪出可见区域、保持挂载的隐藏面板已会停止运动；应用以其他方式遮挡或窗口不活动时由应用同步。
MarqueeOptions.Active.en: Unset means true; false stops scheduling and retains manual pause state. Scrolling or clipping out of view and hidden kept-mounted panels already stop the motion; applications supply other hiding, such as covering, and window activity.

MarqueeOptions.Overlay.zh: 默认 true，两端各三分之一渐隐到主题背景；显式 false 关闭。
MarqueeOptions.Overlay.en: Defaults to true; each outer third fades into the theme background. Explicit false disables it.

MarqueeOptions.ContentKey.zh: 内容变化时更新此键，将偏移和动画时间重置。
MarqueeOptions.ContentKey.en: Change this key when content changes to reset the phase and animation clock.

MarqueeOptions.UI.zh: Root 配置容器；Body 配置每一份展示内容。主题、实例 UI、Style 依次覆盖。
MarqueeOptions.UI.en: Root styles the container and Body every content copy. Theme, instance UI and Style apply in that order.

MarqueeOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置 Root 或 Body，不保留 Element 或在回调中执行异步任务。
MarqueeOptions.Style.en: Synchronously styles Root or Body; do not retain Elements or launch asynchronous work here.

SplitterOptions.Label.zh: 分隔条的可访问名称；为空时使用本地化 Divider / 分隔条。
SplitterOptions.Label.en: Accessible divider name; empty uses localized Divider.

SplitterOptions.Orientation.zh: 默认 Horizontal；Vertical=true 时也使用纵向，水平位置及方向键随 RTL 镜像。
SplitterOptions.Orientation.en: Defaults to Horizontal; Vertical=true also selects vertical layout. Horizontal position and arrows mirror in RTL.

SplitterOptions.Vertical.zh: 兼容的纵向开关；true 时第一面板在上方。
SplitterOptions.Vertical.en: Legacy vertical switch; true places the first pane above the second.

SplitterOptions.Percent.zh: 默认 false，绑定值使用 DIP；true 为 0–100，表示第一面板占两个面板可分配空间的比例，不包括分隔条。
SplitterOptions.Percent.en: Defaults to false for DIP; true uses 0–100 for the first pane share of available pane space, excluding the divider.

SplitterOptions.Disabled.zh: 只锁定分隔条，面板中的控件仍可编辑。要禁用全部内容，应禁用父容器。
SplitterOptions.Disabled.en: Locks only the divider; pane controls remain editable. Disable an ancestor to disable all contents.

SplitterOptions.Min.zh: 绑定值下界，默认 0，与绑定值单位相同；显式 0 有效。面板物理最小尺寸另受原生布局约束。
SplitterOptions.Min.en: Lower bound, default zero, in the bound value unit; explicit zero is supported. Physical pane minimums are a separate layout constraint.

SplitterOptions.Max.zh: 绑定值上界，DIP 默认 1e7，百分比默认 100；显式 0 有效，但不能小于有效 Min。
SplitterOptions.Max.en: Upper bound: 1e7 in DIP or 100 in percentage mode. Explicit zero is valid but must not be below effective Min.

SplitterOptions.KeyboardResizeBy.zh: 显式值与绑定值使用相同单位，0 禁用方向键调整；未设置时每次移动主题缩放后的 10 DIP。Home/End 仍可定位边界。必须有限且非负。
SplitterOptions.KeyboardResizeBy.en: Explicit values use the bound unit; zero disables arrow resizing. Unset moves theme-scaled ten DIPs. Home/End still reach limits. Must be finite and nonnegative.

SplitterOptions.OnChange.zh: 指针或键盘实际改变模型时通知一次。范围边界重复输入和外部赋值后的静默限制不通知。
SplitterOptions.OnChange.en: Notifies once for an actual pointer/keyboard model change. Repeated boundary input and external-value clamping are silent.

SplitterOptions.UI.zh: Root、Leading、Trailing、SeparatorSlot、Indicator 分别配置容器、两个面板、8 DIP 拖拽区域和 1 DIP 中间线；拖拽区域不额外占用布局空间。
SplitterOptions.UI.en: Root, Leading, Trailing, SeparatorSlot and Indicator style the container, two panels, eight-DIP hit area and one-DIP line. The hit area adds no layout gap.

SplitterOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置实际部件，优先级高于主题和实例 UI；不能保留构建期 Element。
SplitterOptions.Style.en: Styles actual parts synchronously after theme and instance UI; never retain a build-scoped Element.

SidebarOptions.Description.zh: 展开和窄窗口菜单中的描述，默认空；HeaderContent 替换默认标题和描述。
SidebarOptions.Description.en: Description while expanded or mobile, empty by default. HeaderContent replaces the default title and description.

SidebarOptions.Actions.zh: 同步构建展开状态或窄窗口菜单的标题操作，接收当前 SidebarScope；收起时不显示。
SidebarOptions.Actions.en: Synchronously builds header actions while expanded or mobile, with the current SidebarScope; hidden while collapsed.

SidebarOptions.UI.zh: 实际部件为 Root、Header、Label、Description、Actions、Trigger、Body、Footer、SeparatorSlot；弹层还包含 Panel、Backdrop、Close。
SidebarOptions.UI.en: Actual parts are Root, Header, Label, Description, Actions, Trigger, Body, Footer and SeparatorSlot; overlays also expose Panel, Backdrop and Close.

SidebarOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置当前实际部件，优先于主题和实例 UI；不要保留 Element。
SidebarOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures actual parts after theme and instance UI; never retain Elements.

SidebarOptions.ReturnFocus.zh: 覆盖弹层关闭，以及零宽或跨断点移除聚焦内容后的焦点目标；完全隐藏内部入口时应提供外部按钮。
SidebarOptions.ReturnFocus.en: Overrides return focus on overlay close and when zero-width or breakpoint changes remove focused content. Supply an external opener when hiding all internal controls.

SidebarOptions.HeaderContent.zh: 替换默认标题和描述；桌面 Toggle 与 Actions 仍由组件构建。优先于旧 Header。
SidebarOptions.HeaderContent.en: Replaces the default title and description; desktop Toggle and Actions remain component-owned. Takes precedence over legacy Header.

HeaderOptions.Title.zh: 标题，默认空；非空时显示原生一级标题。不会自动链接到网页首页。
HeaderOptions.Title.en: Title, empty by default; nonempty content becomes a native level-one heading. No home-page link is created.

HeaderOptions.Description.zh: 原生扩展说明文字，默认空。
HeaderOptions.Description.en: Native description text, empty by default.

HeaderOptions.Leading.zh: 同步构建前导区域；Leading 样式作用于实际容器，切换时保留动作区域身份。
HeaderOptions.Leading.en: Synchronously builds leading content. Leading styles its actual container; toggling it retains action-region identity.

HeaderOptions.Actions.zh: 同步构建操作区域，默认间距 6 DIP；可以组合按钮、编辑器或外部菜单入口。
HeaderOptions.Actions.en: Synchronously builds actions with a six-DIP default gap; compose buttons, editors or an external menu opener.

HeaderOptions.UI.zh: Root、Leading、Body、Label、Description、Actions 分别配置根、前导、标题文字容器、标题、描述和操作区。
HeaderOptions.UI.en: Root, Leading, Body, Label, Description and Actions style the root, leading area, title wrapper, title, description and actions.

HeaderOptions.Style.zh: 同步设置实际部件；主题、实例 UI、Style 依次覆盖。
HeaderOptions.Style.en: Synchronously styles actual parts after theme and instance UI.

FooterOptions.Text.zh: 页脚文字，默认空，允许在可用宽度内换行；使用 Label 部件设置外观。
FooterOptions.Text.en: Footer text, empty by default, wrapping within available width. Style it through Label.

FooterOptions.Actions.zh: 同步构建可换行的操作区域，默认内部间距 6 DIP；Actions 的样式和边距作用于整个操作容器。
FooterOptions.Actions.en: Synchronously builds a wrapping action region with a six-DIP default gap. Actions styles and padding apply to its container.

FooterOptions.UI.zh: 实际部件为 Root、Label、Actions；默认根内边距为水平 20、垂直 12 DIP，无顶部边线。
FooterOptions.UI.en: Actual parts are Root, Label and Actions. Root padding defaults to 20 DIP horizontally and 12 vertically, with no top border.

FooterOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置 Root、Label 或 Actions，优先于主题和实例 UI。
FooterOptions.Style.en: Synchronously configures Root, Label or Actions after theme and instance UI.

FooterColumnsOptions.MinColumnWidth.zh: 首选最小列宽，默认 160 DIP，非正值使用默认；列与链接仍受可用宽度约束。必须有限。
FooterColumnsOptions.MinColumnWidth.en: Preferred minimum column width, default 160 DIP; nonpositive values use the default. Columns and links still fit available width. Must be finite.

FooterColumnsOptions.OnNavigate.zh: 可用链接被激活且单项 OnSelect 未取消时，通知其 ID；禁用项不通知。
FooterColumnsOptions.OnNavigate.en: Notifies the ID when an enabled link activates and item OnSelect did not cancel it. Disabled entries are silent.

FooterColumnsOptions.UI.zh: Root、Body（每列）、Label（标题）、List、Item（链接）、ItemLeadingSlot、ItemLabelSlot。默认间距分别为列间 32、标题/列表 24、链接间 16 DIP。
FooterColumnsOptions.UI.en: Root, Body (each column), Label (title), List, Item (link), ItemLeadingSlot and ItemLabelSlot. Default gaps are 32 DIP between columns, 24 between title/list and 16 between links.

FooterColumnsOptions.Style.zh: 同步配置实际部件；单项 UI 覆盖组件 UI，单项 Style 最后执行。
FooterColumnsOptions.Style.en: Styles actual parts synchronously; item UI overrides component UI and item Style runs last.

FooterColumn.ID.zh: 列的稳定非空 ID，在当前列表中唯一；改变顺序或标题时保留。
FooterColumn.ID.en: Stable nonempty column ID, unique in the list; retain it when changing order or title.

FooterColumn.Title.zh: 列标题；非空时为原生三级标题。
FooterColumn.Title.en: Column title; nonempty content becomes a native level-three heading.

FooterColumn.Items.zh: 仅使用 NavigationItem 的 ID、Label、Icon、Active、Disabled、OnSelect、UI、Style。OnSelect 可用 PreventDefault 取消根 OnNavigate；单项样式使用 Item、ItemLeadingSlot、ItemLabelSlot。
FooterColumn.Items.en: Uses only NavigationItem ID, Label, Icon, Active, Disabled, OnSelect, UI and Style. OnSelect can PreventDefault to cancel root OnNavigate. Item styles use Item, ItemLeadingSlot and ItemLabelSlot.
